name: Center Camp
description: Welcome to the Heart of Black Rock City — a bustling crossroads where creativity, connection, and curiosity collide. Entirely reimagined through the spirit of participatory urban renewal, the Center Camp neighborhood is more than a landmark — it’s a living, breathing world of worlds. While the Temple invites release, and The Man calls for transformation, The Heart asks: What will you nourish, cherish, and carry with you? Wander down the pathways that lead into Center Camp Plaza, and you’ll find a dynamic convergence of theme camps, interactivity, and mythic mischief. At its core stands The Canopy: the largest tensile shade structure on Earth — a circular acre of possibility where something extraordinary is always happening. Under The Canopy, you’ll encounter a kaleidoscope of experiences, from morning meditations and afternoon adventures to guest performances, curious corners, late-night shenanigans, rejuvenating refreshments, and everything in between. It’s a hub of expression, experimentation, and wonder — and the perfect place to begin (or completely reroute) your Black Rock City journey.

name: Snuggles
description: A cozy, consent-forward oasis designed for meaningful human connection. Step into a softly lit lounge where guided hug exchanges, peer massage sessions, partner stretch, and love letter writing invite you to slow down and connect. Enjoy curated mezcal tastings, sunrise cuddle meditation, and a midweek sound bath experience in a welcoming, multicultural space. We create structured yet playful containers where participation, respect, and Radical Inclusion come first. Come soften, connect, and co-create a moment of warmth in the dust.
landmark: Lit Camp Snuggles sign & glowing Tree Tree

name: The Airship
description: A steampunk inspired bar camp that's returning to the Playa for our third year. Our little crew of miscreants, scoundrels, and artists want to gift some fun and frivolity to the Playa in the form of themed bar night and a lounge for relaxing!

name: Down Low Club

Also, since 2009, hosting the 24/7 interactivity in our DOWN LOW CLUB TENT, providing a discreet, enclosed and air-conditioned space for erotic play between consenting 18+ adult men & male-identified individuals.

name: Camp Gotalotgoinon

Creating together and experiencing multi-sensory art that inspires connection and growth. Come play games, solve a puzzle, get your dance on, add to the collaborative string art or come relax and take it all in at the tub. Whoever and whatever you create is art and we look forward to sharing ours with you and experiencing yours.

name: Orphan Asylum
description: Orphan Asylum is a hodgepodge crew of misfits who come together through careful planning, organization and a dash of straight anarchy to create a unique social experiment that has not been terrible yet so far.We rely on the kindness of strangers, and making them not so strange (or stranger, depending) by the end of the burn, as well as providing sanctuary to strangers on playa in need of a desert home. We don't charge dues and are instead entirely donation-based from our past and current orphans.Folks donate everything from money to org support to moral support to technical/skill support. Before the burn, we take in new camp members on an application-basis.
landmark: Large lit up Orphan Asylum sign and banners

name: Feed tHE ARTists
description: Started in 2007 with Larry Harvey's blessing and support, FTA has fed tens of thousands of artists, musicians, dancers, builders, makers, dabblers, and generally curious wandering travelers. FTA actively models the concept of creating community through the sharing of delicious meals at BRC and all over the world. We are striving to elevate food to an art form, serving as a primary resource for playa food safety, kitchen design, and unforgettable cooking. You never know what we'll be cooking up next - and, whatever it may be, you are invited to prepare it with us and share a meal of some of the finest food ever gifted on the playa!

name: The Shuttle Home

Centered around a shaded Tea Lounge, we host tea ceremonies, consent workshops, guided conversations, and intimate gatherings designed to encourage meaningful connection.Our camp invites participants to slow down, share stories, and recharge in a warm and inclusive environment. With comfortable seating, soft lighting, and a relaxed atmosphere, The Shuttle Home serves as a grounding point for those seeking presence, reflection, and authentic human interaction.Come by for tea, stay for connection, and leave feeling restored.

name: Hello Mom!

We provide stationary, stamps, and Polaroid pictures to help you write a letter home, which we then mail from the BRC post office. We serve Mom's apple pie and Dad's fresh watermelon from our cozy living room to snack on while you write. Or, if writing isn't your thing, stop by for a bit of motherly/fatherly advice or even just a shoulder to cry (or celebrate) on. We love parental figures of all types!

name: Kuker Camp
description: BULGARIAN KUKER Mutant Vehicle is based on the Kukeri Ritual Dancers - a millenia old tradition from Bulgaria, Eastern Europe. Kukeri are people wearing elaborate self-made fur costumes and hideous animalistic masks. Every year in the end of winter/the beginning of spring Kukeri dance to scare away evil spirits and bring joy, happiness and prosperity for the whole village throughout the year. In addition to just having the festive and carnival-like appearance, we have infused our ancient MUTANT PET with a modern soul - mixing ancient bagpipe melodies and live drum beats with various electronic music styles.

Our camp is simple: good people, tasty pours, and real connection where strangers become friends in the dust. We're also the artists behind the Serendipity Machine, an interactive art installation designed to spark meaningful encounters on the playa. Small in size but big in heart, we exist to spread warmth, wonder and a little unexpected magic.

name: Black Rock City Pickleball Club

Learn the game in minutes, cheer from the sidelines, or rotate into your next match, no experience or equipment required. Rally at sunrise, dink at dusk, or glow under the lights after dark. Movement, connection, and a little friendly competition await.

Programming is consistent and accessible, giving everyone the chance to join in and take part.By day, expect movement and workshops. By night, music, dancing, and shared experiences bring the camp together. Norse Code is a space to show up, connect, and celebrate together.

name: French Fruits

When you stop by, you will not only get something refreshing to eat, you will also learn the name of that fruit in French, hear a little about how it is used in French cooking, and leave with a small taste of the culture and warmth that we carry from home. Get off your bike, sit down in the shade, enjoy a piece of fruit, and let us share a little bit of France with you. Everyone is welcome, always.

name: Mist Connections
description: Misconnections is a tiny temple to bad timing, chaotic crushes, and emotional side quests. Stumble in, get aggressively misted, and accept an irresponsible amount of shave ice while you write anonymous notes to the hottie from the porta line, the stranger who rescued your bike, or the person you trauma?bonded with at sunrise.
landmark: Large Mist Connections sign on the frontage

name: SomeDay Isle ...
description: Tiki Bar, Broth'l, Hammock Hangout , and Burn Barrel Gathering SpaceInspiration Destination and Late Night Orientation Staytion.We will captivate you with our main event Mai Tai, You Tie, We all Tie Amateur Shibari. We offer late night fireside music, games, and chats and an always open protected lounge and hammock chill dome. Our Broth'l is a 24/7 hydration and nutrition station with hot and cold water, tea, coffee, broth, ramen, and electrolytes.We are a fun, active, engaging band of responsible hooligans with a comfy camp space to share. We encourage fun playtime but, as importantly, we educate and demonstrate Burning Man core principles. We offer avenues for creating art and personal expression, and we encourage Dreams. SomeDay Isle ... ?
landmark: 4 tall Bright Green flags & 12' SomeDay Isle sign

name: Symbio
description: Drop your responsibilities at the door and check into SYMBIO. Expect playful chaos, questionable life advice, and zero supervision as you reconnect with your inner child (who probably makes worse decisions than you do). Snacks, silliness, and spontaneous magic included.
landmark: 2 containers infront of a big tent. Lit up logo

name: Avant Garden
description: We are a small Burning Man camp focused on creating community and connection both on and off Playa. We maintain a camp size of around 20 members, mostly based in the San Francisco/Bay Area.At night on Playa, our Brothel will serve hot, steamy broth to people who want a cozy place to hang out and warm up.
landmark: Neon Avant Garden sign, beige EMT structure

name: Elixai Dust Tribe
description: We are a welcoming dance and lounge camp offering a shaded daytime gathering space and curated electronic music experiences in the evenings. During the day, our frontage functions as a comfortable rest and connection zone with seating, hydration, and open conversation. In the evenings, we host thoughtfully programmed DJ sets focused on melodic house and groove oriented sounds in a contained and respectful environment.Our camp is open to all who wish to participate, dance, or simply relax. We prioritize inclusion, consent culture, and sound awareness while creating an energizing but intentional atmosphere. Stop by to move, meet new friends, and share the moment.
landmark: N/A

name: Lands Beyond
description: Lands Beyond is a haven for strivers and adventurers always seeking the unknown. We invite you to step beyond your comfort zone and explore new experiences with us. A globally minded camp with Mexican flair, we welcome Burners into our cosmic neon-lit domes for tasty micheladas, delicious mezcalitas and refreshing aguas frescas.Our programming includes ecstatic dance, breathwork, dynamic meditation, and cacao ceremonies, offering moments for both celebration and reflection. If you feel like slowing down, wander into our Cosmic Souk, where you can relax on comfortable cushions while sampling unusual treats and concoctions from across the galaxy.Come for the fluorescent cosmic crèpes and refreshing micheladas?stay for our black-light international Day of the Dead party!
landmark: Multicolored neon and black light domes.

name: Cheezy Oasis
description: Indulge in the tantalizing allure of irresistibly cheezy goodness that delicately melts in your mouth. Join us to savor this exquisite experience of cheesy delight. Alternatively, embark on a flavorful adventure and roll the dice for a delectable drink that promises to energize your day like never before. Feeling adventurous? Grab the mic and unleash your inner comedian, songbird, or entertainer extraordinaire. The stage is yours to own! If mornings aren't your thing or you've burned the midnight oil, why not join us for a pick-me-up coffee and delightful conversation to start your day right? And remember--Stay Cheezy.
landmark: neon camp name and purple sheeting

name: Antiix
description: ANTIIX where we are Anti-Icks and always up for kicks. A Shady place to meet for drinks, laughs, chats, music, who knows what else!
landmark: Front Lit Lanterns and Bar with Flat top Deck

name: Three of Cups
description: Cmon down to the tarot swamp to get swampy and get tarot'd.
landmark: beacon and the 3 of cups sign

name: Cult of the Magic Lady
description: Come to our Cult, we have snacks! The snacks are babies, but don't worry, they are alcoholic. We also have a church, for your physical wellbeing and personal gains. And we feed on your shame. We also have a library.
landmark: Large sign that says "Cult of the Magic Lady"

name: Unicorner
description: A family-friendly haven for creativity, light-hearted fun, sharing, and magic! Come lounge in our stuffy pile and color in the UniDome and get a prescription at the Unicorn Advice Booth interactive installation!Unicorner is created by a crew of hearty shenaniganists who have several goals on the playa: having lots of FUN, spreading lots of LOVE, and championing the 10 Principles of Burning Man in the most positive and supportive manner possible. We host daily activities of all sorts at the Unicorner (many of which are kid- and family-friendly) and encourage art, music, radical self-expression, and community!
landmark: Unicorn Advice Booth - 5x5' wood structure

name: InfiniTea
description: If fate finds you at our sparkling Tea Spot floating upon the vast desert ocean, come and take a sip of InfiniTea!
landmark: TeaSpot Art Car, Circular led Portal Sculpture

name: Axis of Stillness
description: A quiet presence amid the storm - an 8-foot mosaic pyramid rises from the playa, its hand-crafted glass panels glowing with color-shifting light from within. Axis of Stillness is an invitation to pause, breathe, and find your center. Built by a family of makers and 18-year Burning Man veterans, the installation celebrates the art of mosaic and the power of stillness. Come find the eye of the hurricane.
landmark: RGBW pyramid+sign, teal glass mosaic art car

name: Patsy's Hangout
description: Patsy's Hangout is a fabulous lounge in the gayborhood where you can connect with old friends and make new ones while enjoying refreshing beverages. Enjoy high-energy tunes, good company and a comfortable space all day, every day. Stop by for our daily recurring activities including: Patsy's Classical Morning Brew: Serving coffee and tea with classical chill music every morning and Patsy's Bar: Serving cold beverages, and lots of ice, every day. Participate in our daily special events including Patsy's Closet on Monday and Patsy's Nail Salon and bad wine tasting on Tuesday. And, our dueling pianos (well keyboards actually) are back and will be performing their very popular all-requests sing along, and groove along happy hour shows Tuesday Wednesday and Thursday. Remember: You're Fabulous!
landmark: Large metal/tarp structure with "PATSY'S" signage.

name: Off the Dome
description: Come explore & express yourself at Off the Dome! Formerly known as Freestyle Palace, Off the Dome is back in the playa Wonderland for its second decade as the original musical imagination sanctuary: the Playa Talent Incubator. Our namesake DIY Jam Dome is powered by the talent and creativity Black Rock City's citizens. Our stage, mics & instruments are available for singing, rapping and making impromptu music. Off the Dome hosts the hip hop visionaries: Black City All-Stars and Black Rock City Regional Air Guitar Championships - now in its 12th year, as well as the Galactivators. We are all about the magical love of performance! Come play & perform with other performers and creators at our innovative haven. At Off the Dome, do it live at Home in BRC.
landmark: Neon pink green and orange dome, lit at night

name: Grateful Burners
description: Grateful Burners - your neighborhood pit stop. We're serving up mid-day iced coffee and providing a high-pressure "Dust-Off" station for weary travelers. Come evening, relax in our shaded plaza for classic concert videos (i.e. Marley, Dead, Talking Heads, Pink Floyd etc.) and chill visuals.
landmark: Large wooden sign with Grateful Burners name

name: Fantastic Sams
description: Camp Fantastic Sams serves breakfast in the morning, debauchery in the afternoon, and drinks in the evening. We are a LGBT+ camp, and we have a comfy "cuddle puddle" for after dark (and during the daytime).
landmark: Big Fantastic Sams sign, and the big wedding tent

name: Après-Ski
description: Shimmering on the horizon is a sight that shouldn't exist: a pocket of Swiss mountain magic in the middle of a prehistoric lake bed. An Alpine outpost where high-altitude hospitality meets the Playa dust.By day, seek refuge in our Ski Cabin Wine Bar. We're gifting crisp Swiss pours and mountain vibes to the soundtrack of Euro-house. Feeling bold? Take on the Ski Pass Challenge? and who knows where you may end up.. Perhaps in a fluffy fur lined speakeasy?Follow the scent of roasting potatoes and Alpine funk to our doorstep for an interactive feast of bubbling cheese and laughter. Whether you're here for the vintage, the challenge, or the midnight melt, the mountains are calling... and they taste like home.
landmark: 2 large red ski cabins/gondolas - lit up at night

name: Lily Pad Lounge
description: Home of LilyPod support camp. Have support for other small art cars, particularly those based off golfcarts. Also salve and frog-related things.
landmark: Tall flagpole with Frogs, plus the lilypad car

name: Airstreameri and What Not
description: Home to Playa's Best Postcards! Come create one-of-a-kind art postcards filled with love and playa magic for the people you cherish back in the default world.
landmark: Giant silver peace sign

name: El Pulpo Magnifico
description: This is where the giant, flaming metal octopus lives.
landmark: El Pulpo Magnifico flag

name: No Holes Barred Comedy Club
description: We know you missed us! We're back to make you laugh! Start your day with some coldbrew and comic strips, chill out in our giggle inducing Meditation Sessions, learn how to make friends and strangers laugh, and cry, in our variety of Story Telling and Stand Up, and comedy related Workshops, then test your new skills at Open Mic. Got beef with your campmates? Join us for "Judge Django" to argue your case and redeem your reputation! And of course, the main event! Every night! Laugh your butthole off at our Pro Stand Up Comedy Special! All Holes Welcome!
landmark: Blue & orange semi, neon comedy club sign

name: More Is More
description: Reality is a suggestion. Excess is a plan. Climb our wood tower, enjoy drinks and DJ with us daily.
landmark: Wood tower and at night LED rope helium balloon

name: Knotty Peckers
description: Come get knotty at our woodland scout-themed camp blending playful nostalgia with sexy human connection and participation. Enjoy the welcoming forest outpost where Burners can gather, learn, laugh, and earn bespoke scout-style badges by participating in camp activities like: S'mores, Axe-Throwing, Paddle Play, Dirty Girl Scout drinks, and more.
landmark: Log pole camp sign "Knotty Peckers"

name: Stoop
description: Serving top-shelf, neighborly vibes, Stoop is a place where you belong. Our art is hosting. Welcome home! We've created a place for neighbors to gather, share stories, express their art, and make new friends while sipping a delicious cocktail and eating a grilled cheese, blueberry pancake, or whatever we've got going on the grill.
landmark: Blue box truck with blue 10x10x10 shading.

name: Size Doesn't Matter
description: We are a small camp but we pack a punch! You might stop by to grab a pair of sunglasses, and before you know it, you'll be running a 1/2 marathon with us!
landmark: Sunny the BIG Bear w/sunglasses

name: Red Rooster Ranch
description: The Red Rooster Ranch art car celebrates the fun and frivolity of Nevada's tawdry past and present association with saloons and Cat Houses. Come join us for a ride and enjoy a libation in our tiny saloon!
landmark: Little red Saloon or the Red Rooster Ranch art car

name: Camp Codename
description: Join Camp Codename for Cookies, Connection and Comeraderie!
landmark: Camp Codename Sign and What Brings You Joy Booth

name: Black Rock Adventures Bus Stop!
description: Providing accessible Playa tours in our adventure rig, with room for about 10 - 13 Burners, leaving from our BUS STOP! art installation on the Playa. Tours go daily at 9am, return you to the BUS STOP! and last about 2hrs. Or meet us at camp prior to the tour! Contact us for info about special tours and pick ups/drop offs, and if you are interested in camping with us or driving tours. To find our camp - look for tall grey feather flag with a big " ! "on it! or check our website for our location closer to the Burn. Come ride with us!
landmark: Tall grey Feather Flag with a "!" on it

name: DJ University
description: Step into a participatory music campus where beginners become DJs and strangers become collaborators. Start in the rhythm circle, learn the fundamentals of mixing, build your own set, and take the stage for a live showcase supported by the community. Open deck hours, guided workshops, and an optional music creation lab invite you to move from observer to creator. Whether you have never touched a DJ controller or are ready to refine your sound, this is your chance to contribute to the pulse of Black Rock City. Walk away and return, saying, "I DJ'd at Burning Man!".
landmark: DJ University sign, colorful Mary Pickford RV

name: The Hand Lovers Lounge
description: A soft landing space for hands, lovers, lovers of hands, and everything in between!
landmark: Small Purple Geodesic Dome

name: Aurora
description: Konnichiwa, pardner. Whether you're coming home from a long night in the saddle or just mounting up for the day, join us for a fresh bowl of ramen that'll soothe both body and soul. Sidle up to our cozy bar, share a tale with a stranger, and settle your spirit to the sweet sounds of smooth grooves.
landmark: Aurora sign, flat top bar shade structure

name: Irrelephant Bird Camp
description: Colorful eyebrows? CHECK! Dunking Contest? CHECK! Bad Movies? CHECK! Yacht rock? Jock rock? Not rock? Check, check, and check! Trying to get a handle on what we do here at Irrelephant Bird Camp? Don't even try it. Just come by and get a little silly with us, touch base with reality, or take a nap on the beach.
landmark: Surf lounge w/ a illuminated sign w/ our name/logo

name: Phantasmagoria Camp
description: Escape to our 3-story temple with breathtaking views , sipping on our signature cocktails crafted with love. Unwind in our shady oasis, designed to rejuvenate your body and soul on hot desert days. Join us for sunset weddings every day, and groove to our daily music program featuring a unique sound system —. Come recharge and find your vibe with us!
landmark: Double tower three story temple

name: Simian Akademy
description: Looking for a truly unique interactive experience? Come visit the Olfactorium where our Mistress of Scent will concoct a custom perfume just for you, based on your unique, personal preferences.So you've had a flat bike tire on the playa and like a good burner, you brought a spare to replace it. What to do with that old, limp inner-tube? Take it to "Sexy Treads" sustainability station and convert it into fabulous fetish wear! Tools, supplies, and examples (and more flat tubes) are on-hand to create a sexy, strappy harness!Cranky from the heat? New best friend getting on your nerves already? You need to CHILL THE FUCK OUT AND COLOR! Relax and color your frustrations away. Choose your favorite, beautifully embellished swear word, or perhaps a picture of unicorns being total assholes!
landmark: 2 white pyramids, colored @night, & monkey cutouts

name: Joyism
description: N/A.
landmark: Joyism Flags

name: DraKasha
description: This theme camp has no description.

name: 7 Sirens Cove
description: A pirate bohemia since 2011 where merrymaking, mermaid lounging, dancing rhythms and mischief run aground. Beware, it is futile to resist the 7 Siren's call!
landmark: Pirate Ship and lit dome

name: Synapse Conduit
description: We are Phó - Cup. Your midnight Phó restaurant Come find up in deep playa on Wednesday and Thursday night. Relax, eat and drink and then take your dusty ass out for some fun at the next shiny object!!
landmark: Synapse Conduit sign

name: Duane's Whirld
description: DuanesWhirld is enjoying our 20th consecutive year en Playa, with many of our campers trekking from Vermont.Our camp supports the mutant vehicle Fluffy -- accessible public transit masquerading as a cloud wafting across the playa. A wheelchair lift and Braille rails accommodate that many more Burners into the artcar experience.We enjoy mass-gifting our fellow Burners with Deep Playa Beer Delivery (quenching the late afternoon thirst in the heat) and 'Smores (late nights in deep playa to ease the chill with warm gooey treats.) Each of those gatherings generates micro-community among those Burners brought together. Look for Fluffy!!
landmark: 26-foot box truck with Budget Fuck signage

name: Black Hole Literary Society
description: COME PLAY!! Grow old, not up. By day rest in our shady lounge and hydrate, color, knit, play games and talk. After dark, lose yourself in our immersive 360 degree 3-D black-light experience! Watch the moths dance in their special disco club. Come flow to some vibey tunes, create a visual masterpiece on our Giant Bright Light, and warm yourself at our campfire. Join us late on Thursday night for 'Elvis Hour' around 8 pm followed by a night of music with words through the decades and psychedelic rock. Friday we welcome ALL for our annual Shabbat potluck at sundown - bring some food to share or simply come and enjoy! We dig high fives, interpretive dance, and hula hoops, meaningful conversation, and old-school burners. WELCOME HOME! We've missed you. Let's share and play.
landmark: Giant Brite Lite, Three tents. 30 foot lit pole.

name: Metal Detected
description: Calling all metalheads! Real metal is a rare find in the dust, so we built a stage for it to amalgamate. We provide the instruments and mics for anyone to meet up, plug in and jam, or scream through nightly karaoke. We host primal screaming and metal detecting events and welcome all genres and skill levels to keep the stage alive. Come metal detecting and leave as detected metal.
landmark: Light-up walkthrough metal detector

name: Baby Boomer Burners
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: "Baby Boomer Burners"... Banner on the Tent

name: Camp Do Nothing
description: Camp Do Nothing - the camp that's actually doing the opposite of its name! Come take in a 360 view of the playa on our swing (yep, you'll be hanging 35 feet upside down!), climb on and into the foam dome, or come have a seat and some conversation with burners from all over.
landmark: 360 swing

name: Stars And Bikes
description: Bike Repair! 12 to 4 pm Monday through Saturday. Professional mechanics with tools, parts, and skills to fix all your bike problems. Shaded waiting area with seating and a self-service station for those who are radically self reliant! Roll on in, both you and your bike deserve some love.
landmark: large red structure with red white and blue signs

name: T.B.C.
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Red lights and truss structure. TBC logo

name: DragonCamp Armory
description: This is a HIGHLY participatory workshop where women will learn to make and decorate their own sexy Armor Bikini to keep, wear, and share on the Playa. Recyclable aluminum is used to hand hammer a custom fit costume using traditional hand metal working techniques used for props in films and space operas. Patterns are provided in a variety of sizes. The thin sheet aluminum is cut by hand and then pounded into custom form at our special work stations. When done, the armor can be decorated with various baubles, bangles and jewelry bits which we supply, Bikinis are secured with nylon thong. We have offered this workshop for several years and they are amazingly popular. Many have told us it is their favorite thing they have done at Burningman. We also offer Body painting and Dinosaur Rides.
landmark: Yellow flags with dragons

name: Saharaa Camp
description: Trance. Tradition. Transformation.Ancestral echoes rising,From the Atlas to the Playa.
landmark: red large stretch tent

name: PolyParadise
description: PolyParadise has been influencing the Hearts & Minds and Washing the Bodies of Playa Citizens from '2:00 - 10:00' since 1999 celebrating 28 years in BRC in 2026. Polyamory involves openness to multiple loving relationships, with honesty among all partners. We welcome ALL Poly & Poly Friendly folks to camp within our borders. PolyParadise 2026 welcomes the Twisted Swan | Temple of Bacchus as part of your Playa Experience. PolyParadise is NOT a Swinger Camp. Being Poly or Practicing Poly is NOT a requirement for camping with us, but being OPEN MINDED about other people's lifestyle choices IS!!
landmark: 10' Black Metal Man with Heart/Infinity Heart

name: Snacklandia
description: Snacklandia is a whimsical camp serving up surprise snack and drink pairings through our interactive Spinning Wheel.Each spin brings a random delight?salty, sweet, spicy, or maybe a group hug. New this year is our Nail Art Station, where Burners can express their favorite Burning Man principles through creative, glitter-filled nail art. With daily tastings, playful workshops, and spontaneous fun, Snacklandia invites you to come curious and leave deliciously surprised.
landmark: Snacklandia Sign

name: Slayer!
description: Come sip heavy metal themed craft cocktails while banging your head to the finest metal tunes on the playa at our Heavy Metal Happy Hour. Slinging drinks until 6:66PM.
landmark: 4 black SLAYER flags flying over 2 huge skeletons.

name: Bar Fallover
description: Your local bar. Your home away from home when at home. Offering questionable advise and altered philosophies.
landmark: Multicolour Shade with 3 prominent Red Flags

name: Awesomesauce
description: We are a Unicorn ranch decorated in bright fuchsia pink, lights and unicorns. We run an afternoon and early evening bar, called The unStable, serving our unique 'Unicorn Tears' and a dress up bar. We also host daily events such as Square Dancing, Advice, & Crafting.
landmark: Fuchsia Pink frontage

name: Costco Soulmate Trading Outlet
description: The playa's original and longest-running soulmate trading outpost. Come experience our unparalleled matching system, honed over 27 years of no-frills soulmate trading. Trained interviewers dig deep to find your perfect match ? whether that's a new best friend, a kindred spirit, or someone who challenges everything you thought you knew. Interviews & Shenanigans Monday through Friday. Bring a soul to trade.
landmark: Large army tents with COSTCO sign at entrance

name: Sharkey's Bar and Lounge
description: Sharkey's Oasis: The unrivaled "Preferred Party Beyond the Porto-Potties, where Peni and Pagina frolic on the Pre-Playa Plaza Playground!" Our mission? To delight you with delectable libations, provide respite under our shady canopy, serenade you with tunes in the lounge, and bestow upon you exhilarating and daring drinking games! ???
landmark: Golden Gate archway with Sharkey's sign

name: Camp Stranger Things
description: Bringing our strange art to playa since 2019. If you are looking for us, you just found us. Check out the map and look for our art out on playa, A Cosmos Within. Come by and say Hello if you love what we do.
landmark: Camp Stranger Things sign

name: Camp DIY
description: Camp DIY offers daily Agua Fresca (non-alcoholic) refreshments Monday to Friday of Burn Week. We also have crafty supplies for you to "Pimp Your Cup".
landmark: "Camp DIY" signs, overhead, lighted at night.

name: Homebrew 4A Homebrew
description: We are a daytime bar with cold home brewed beverages, games and a friendly welcoming atmosphere. Enjoy a cold beer (incl. non-alcoholic), cider, mead, soda, and gluten free served daily from 10am until after dark. We have a pool table and daily events including our Playa famous pickle party! Bring your keg and we will refrigerate and tap it, or bring a bottle to share. We have daily pop up events that happen based on the hosts spontaneity. We are adding table games into the mix this year.
landmark: pink dinosaur

name: IcyHands Chillzone
description: We seek out the weary, the overheated and the disconnected to offer our signature Icy Hands experience. The instantaneous sense of relief, joy and connection turns recipients into PARTICIPANTS and makes them part of a larger whole. Icy Hands epitomizes "the gift that keeps on giving" by coaching recipients through providing the experience to others. Hands are cooled to near freezing temperatures by means of a simple block of ice, then with full positive consent of the recipient, those hands are placed upon the neck and jaw, providing an immediate sense of cool, calm and connection. Block of Ice: $7. Memories, endorphins, friendship and dopamine rush: PRICELESS.
landmark: Blue and turquoise tie-dye tapestries and flags

name: Putt Putt Palace
description: Putt Putt Palace hosts a, 24/7, glow in the dark miniature golf corse and holds daily tournaments. Come stop by for our early am coffee bar and our open every afternoon Putt Putt Bar where we serve both spirits and non-alcoholic beverages.
landmark: Moon Dome

name: Future Turtles
description: The Turtles are a chaotic bunch of friends camping together at Burning Man since 2018 without any drama, death, or injury. Visit the Turtle Café for a cold (or hot) drink to make new friends and meet old friends. Check out the view from our observation decks.We are, mostly, happy mutants: nerds, engineers, programmers, gaymers, creators and artists, scientists and philosophers. A lot of us know our way around Python, Monty Python, LED circuits, and computer science. We are a gay camp. Everyone is welcome, but we work actively to create a safe gay haven in a heteronormative world.Participation is our number one value. We don't have spectators, tourists, or sparkle-ponies.
landmark: Containers painted with blue and white waves

name: Camp P3
description: Join us as we spiral ever outward in unending discovery of where the highway of radial participation intersects with the great canal of radical inclusion. Camp P3 is 'be your best self' boutique clothing gifters, and Nitro Coffee moguls hell bent on emblazoning your brain. We are also simply the hosts of the world's largest white Wedding Dress Wednesday procession complete with a mass wedding ceremony? Don't ask us, we don't even know what our camp name means? Perhaps it means something different to each of us. Come visit us and find out what P3 means to you.
landmark: Priscilla RV and camp name signs at the bar front

name: Bad Boy's Discover Your Kinks
description: Introductions to BDSM for the Vanilla but Curious and those new to the Kink community.
landmark: 12x20 foot white Dungeon with Bad Boy sign at top

name: VorteXXX
description: This theme camp has no description.

name: Foam Home presents FOAMADELIC
description: Foam Home presents FOAMADELIC to Black Rock City!! The Foamy Homies will foam blast & rinse sparkly clean burners, and collectively activate an altar for humanity & all life! Complete with mandatory consent training, practicing true Inclusivity for everyone! - Groups of 60 at a time for a total of 2000 people a day. Wednesday through Saturday from 12-1pm for families with kids, and 1-4:20pm for all.
landmark: All-sphyr ontop big tan tent & huge solar arrays

name: Spaced Out
description: Visitors are invited to step into a creative space where they can slow down, explore, and take part in collaborative art. At the center of the camp is a large drawing installation that evolves throughout the week as participants add marks, gestures, and symbols to a shared canvas. Guided meditation to drawing sessions and informal conversations invite people to explore ideas around art, music, storytelling, and imagination. Anyone can join in, regardless of artistic experience, and contribute to the artwork as it grows over the course of the week.
landmark: Metal stage with shade fabric and drawing panels

name: Sphere Vision
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Brown tent w/ yellow trailer

name: Hotline Camp
description: Hotline invites burners to share secrets, advice, jokes, or late-night thoughts with the city. Pick up a receiver and you might hear a confession, a story, epic hold music, a stranger on the other end, or good old snark.Throughout the week we host themed daytime parties with DJs, music, and a welcoming space to gather under the shade. Stop by to get advice, leave a message, dance for a bit, or see who's on the other line.
landmark: Hotline Camp Neon Sign and 35 foot solar schoolbus

name: Tower69
description: A supportive camp for TOWER69 Mutant Vehicle. Hop on board! While we are on duty, you will not drown in the desert of loneliness!
landmark: Big neon palm on top RV

name: Swan Forest
description: Swan Forest is the heart and soul of our camp, where creativity, community, and transformation come together. Named after both the Prodigal Swan and the Forest House art cars, our camp serves as a space for artistic expression, connection, and shared experiences. The Prodigal Swan, with its dynamic sound and light displays, invites exploration and interaction, while the Forest House brings a sense of nature and futurism to our environment. Together, these art cars provide a unique space for immersive experiences, where all are welcome to engage in a vibrant, inclusive community.
landmark: Two Large flags w/ Swan logo and Forest House

name: Black Rock Observatory Theme Camp
description: Black Rock Observatory is a mobile astronomical observatory dedicated to showing people just how amazing the universe is. Started at Burning Man in 2014, we have expanded beyond the borders of Black Rock City to educational institutions and events all along the West Coast.
landmark: Black Rock Obs sign, telescopes, space tapestries

name: DK50 Trash Fence Camp
description: Hi, we are an art support camp supporting the Trash Fence Souveneirs project - come find it on inner playa and share your art. We love you. And stop by camp to also create a moment of art immersion.
landmark: BRIGHT orange 'stand' with trash fence decor

name: CatLand
description: Burning Man's haven for feline enthusiasts. Join us for themed parties featuring tacos, late night hotdogs, kareoke and craft activities all centered around our beloved cats. Indulge in our open bar, where camaraderie flows as freely as the drinks. We promise you a purrr-fect escape into our feline universe. Experience magic of CatLand, where the spirit of Burning Man meets the playful spirit of cats.
landmark: Free WiFi robot art & cat silhouette flare

name: X marks the spot
description: The place where the treasures of family and friends are found. We camp together to enjoy a week of sharing, creativity and beauty. We gather here to reconnect with old friends and make new friends. We like being a small part of this huge community.
landmark: X marks the spot banners / flags

name: Bumpbed
description: Bumping those beats across the playa far and wide.
landmark: 4 pillar art car w/thousands LEDs &shade structure

name: Alice in Slumberland
description: The oldest Alice themed bar on the playa is back, but much less Alice-themed than you'd expect!Known for intricate cocktails and zany decor, this year the bar returns and it will be nastier than nasty.The extremely obvious speakeasy for a one time event, and we promise you won't believe what you will see behind the bar !We offer our classic chill lounge with Tarot readings wednesday afternoon, you know what to expect for the rest of the week or for the rest of your life.Hungry and want to party all together ? Carbs meet chaos. We serve raviolis while DJs spin some tunes. Party with us until 23:00 fueled by pasta and playa magic on Wednesday.
landmark: aluminet wall with a bar at the front

name: Burning Sensation
description: Through fiery flavors and spicy conversation, Burning Sensation awakens participants to the immediacy of the moment. At Fire Bar, guests are invited to sample gourmet hot sauces that challenge their resolve, while washing the heat down with bracing fireball cocktails. Rooted in inclusivity, we center BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ voices and bodies at our Playa Vybz party - while creating a space where all are invited to feel, engage, and burn brightly. Come experience hearts, tongues and souls on fire at Burning Sensation!
landmark: metal flame sign with a dancing devil

name: Alternative Energy Zone (AEZ)
description: A camp where you can come learn about how you can create a solar system to take care of your power needs large or small. 11am daily. Get a cocktail or pancakes, learn to figure draw and even get a positive attitude adjustment. We have Wifi gifted from the BM Org, shade and technical support from Solar to Excel...
landmark: 45' Tower with AEZ on it.

name: SP Station
description: Home station for the SP Express mattress cabana train!
landmark: Wooden ziggurat and "Mesa" sign out front!

name: Hel's Diner
description: Hel's Diner is a food serving, flame throwing mutant vehicle creation that's part of Camp Porta!
landmark: Red and White tents

name: Hobo Camp
description: Hobo Camp celebrates train-hopping culture and its community and resourcefulness. Our ambience and events include dust-bowl era music, attire, and vignettes. We are LGBTQ+ & allied.
landmark: Maroon colored box car, outhouse in front

name: Hookers & Peggers Naughty Cafe
description: Come for the coffee and stay for the fun! Test your skill on our 10' Hooker & Pegger game, or launch a dildo to drench your buddy in our dunk tank! Don't forget to take a complimentary porno mag while you're at it.
landmark: 10' tall purple ring & hook game w lit disco ball

name: Dusty Mule Saloon and Playground
description: We offer the vibe of belly laughs all day, everyday. Inside our vibrant dome with misters, you'll find a welcoming bar offering boozy cocktails or one of our chilled non-alcoholic options with a boogie music theme. Dome interior games include Yard Yahtzee, Pin the Man on the Ass, Truth or Jenga, Cards Against Humanity, Monopoly, etc. Venture through tunnels connecting smaller domes to our main dome for added adventure. Our playground features an array of interactive games sure to entertain all, from large-scale Connect 4 to Rubber Ring Toss Your Cookies and Shut Your Cornhole. LED Tetherball and hydraulic teeter-totters in What Goes Up Must Come Down add to the carnival-like atmosphere. Laughter is the universal love language of friends.
landmark: Vibrantly colored 30ft dome, with two 10ft domes

name: Dust Stars Collective
description: Stop by for a refreshing boost in the dust at our dual hydration station. We offer fresh iced coffee to jumpstart your mornings and spicy micheladas to celebrate the midday sun. Relax in our comfortable shaded lounge while enjoying chill beats and great company. Our space is a welcoming gift for all citizens looking to cool down and connect with the neighborhood.
landmark: Silver shade with Dual Hydration sign

name: Fusion Valley
description: Fusion Valley, founded in 1999, is a long-running playa living room where sweet and slightly surly geeks and artists gather in the dust. Stop by to cool off in our shade, play board games, charge up, weave through our human slalom course, or grab the mic during a pop-up radio moment. By night, roll up to our drive-in for delightfully questionable cinema. Come for the mischief, stay for the connection.
landmark: An atom shaped lit sign and rooftop screen

name: AAA Astro Accessible Arcade
description: A Space Age-inspired camp featuring accessible arcade games, immersive experiences, and a community space designed for radical inclusion. Think retro-futurism meets playa magic where everyone can play, connect, and experience wonder.
landmark: the double peaked circus tent

name: Lotus Dome & Café
description: The Lotus Dome & Cafe offers spaces for folks to recharge, reconnect, and recenter their bodies and minds.Our camp has two main spaces. The Lotus Dome is our quieter mindfulness center, home to offerings like yoga, guided meditation, breathwork, movement workshops, flow workshops, spiritual offerings, and mindfulness-related talks. It's a calm place to stretch, breathe, meditate, reflect, or simply take a moment for yourself.The Lotus Cafe is our shaded social lounge, where folks can cool off, connect, and enjoy iced cold brew coffee and tea. The Cafe also hosts hands-on creative workshops like screen printing, bracelet making, and other art-based offerings.Whether you're looking for a quiet reset, a cool drink, a creative activity, or a friendly place to land, we'd love to welcome you to our camp!
landmark: A medium sized dome with multiple Buddhist Statues

name: Tarwater
description: Looking for Answers to All Life's Questions? Just took for the mannequin caged in a travois: There you'll find Lady S's Boutique, Cut throat Bowling, The World Tree, miscellaneous games and the welcoming denizens of Tarwater. You'll also recognize us by the crusty old Rat Taxi, parked in front.
landmark: The mannequin in a travois and the World Tree

name: Firefly Solar
description: Our camp is founded on clean energy and we are committed to helping Burning Man become a community energized by renewable resources. This year, we are expanding Firefly Solar, 100kW solar system with 372 kWh battery storage. We also plan to host a panel discussion on sustainability & renewable energy for the Burning Man community. Have an interest in solar or need to charge? Come check us out! .
landmark: FIREFLY sign (rainbow painted, lighted at night)

name: Kaif
description: Step into the cool ambiance of our cozy KAIF Lounge, a haven where relaxation, creativity, and connection come to life. Unwind with a refreshing expertly crafted cocktails. Immerse yourself in spiritual practices, or sip and dance your way into bliss. Whether you seek movement, mindfulness, or just a moment to savor, KAIF Lounge is your escape on the Playa.
landmark: wooden letters - KAIF

name: Amazone
description: Draws its spirit from the Amazon - the largest river system on Earth and one of the most biodiverse places in existence. We are a Brazilian-rooted community that honors South American heritage while welcoming people from all over the world into our family. We believe in showing up fully: to work, to celebrate, to heal, and to connect. Our camp is built around that commitment, offering a rich mix of ceremonial and embodied experiences: Amazonian plant medicine, ice plunges, vibroacoustic therapy, ecstatic dance, cacao ceremonies, and the kind of music and food that makes strangers feel like family.Come for the pizza. Stay for the community. 2026 marks our 10th burn. We have every reason to celebrate and we intend to.
landmark: green/yellow feathered headdress portal

name: Prismaticamp
description: Various artists coming together to offer LED knowledge, personal reflection experiences, dice games, & good vibes.
landmark: 16' high geodesic LED dome on 2'x4' legs

name: Atmosbhear
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Costco-sized bear with heart lights & large grill

name: Treble Makers
description: Long day on playa? With a daily wine, music, and cheese pairing at sunset, you'll be able to enjoy some of life's most indulgent pleasures. Our artists are grass-fed, our red wine is selected and served by beret-wearing french busboys, and we will show you the difference between cheese and fu**ng fromage.If you want to get to the next level of indulgence come enjoy the somatic gyrations delivered to your weary core by the one-and-only Buffer Bush. Swing on by and we will help you hit that higher note, we got your back!
landmark: Big red and beige shade - poofer tower at night

name: Funky Town
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Tessellated shade with 2-story wooden DJ booth

name: Burning Man Studios
description: Burning Man Studios is a diverse group of crazies from across the country and across space and time that love movies, bad writing, and self-expression in all its forms. Come by for a drink, some shade, or just to tell us a story. Bar is open every day and random shenanigans all day long.
landmark: Burning Man Studios Polaroid Photo Frame out front

name: House Of Skin
description: Welcome to "House of Skin." Come get your daily rub down of sunscreen or grab some sunscreen and ChapStick to go on your next adventure. We are a safe space for all and also have many fun things to distract you from your original mission. Come sleep on our trampoline, hang out the fire, participate in our tether ball tournament, get your BRC passport stamp, pick something out from our free store, and enjoy something to drink from our alcohol free bar. I would to tell you more, but I am not going to. Come f*ck around and find out.
landmark: "House of Skin" signs

name: Celestial Alchemy
description: The practice of inner transformation and parallels with the cosmic realms, a diverse camp that celebrates the love and connection of a transcendent humanity. Join us for 10 Principle themed heartfelt yoga and conscious breathwork to revitalize your Burn spirit. We gift cold tea and herbal elixirs for your sweet pleasure. Our celestial moon art piece is visible during dusk and early nighttime, accompanied by soft beats and easeful smiles. We look forward to morning movement and moonlit kisses with you.
landmark: Colorful signs that are placed in front of camp

name: Bikini Bottom(less)
description: Campy, colorful, and delightfully ridiculous...join some of the best-known sea creatures on the playa.Start your day with morning Tai Chi, then drift over for our daily bottomless mimosas (you and your drink can be bottomless if desired). Feeling athletic? Try the Naked Beer Mile: four beers, one mile, zero clothes, maximum glory.In the afternoons we transform into an Under the Sea Prom, complete with spiked punch, karaoke, campy accessories, and a photo setup so you can capture the most wonderfully absurd prom pictures for your scrapbook.Sequins, scales, fins, pearls, and questionable life choices encouraged.
landmark: Big banner with camp name on it

name: Castra Ursi
description: A fully solar-powered camp exploring what a fuel-free future on Playa can look like.This year we present The Last Ocean, an interactive installation built from reclaimed ocean and ocean-bound plastic. Step onto the platforms and walk, run, and dance across a solar-powered sea of light as the surface responds to movement with shifting waves of color.The entire artwork and camp operate 100% on solar energy with no fuel or petrol used in any capacity. Solar panels are integrated directly into the space, making the renewable energy system that powers the experience visible to everyone who visits.Castra Ursi also shares open diagrams and build information showing how our solar and battery systems work, helping other camps explore how to build their own fuel-free infrastructure.
landmark: Look for the field of solar panels and glowing art

name: OHF- One Human Family
description: From Macedonia to Florida, our camp welcomes everyone to chill in our comfortable space and recharge. Coffee and Tea offered daily along with Conch Blowing, Yoga, Jewelry making and great discussions. Come join us as One Human Family.
landmark: BIG Baner saying ONE HUMAN FAMILY

name: Do not confuse here
description: Not confusing area. We support the Beacon of Confusion.
landmark: Thought bubble LED sign

name: AerialKnotics
description: We teach, we share, we tie people up and might set them on fire, we impact with pleasure. Our passion is gifting our BDSM knowledge including beginner to intermediate rope bondage and impact play classes, aerial bondage Shibari performances, and daily meditation with a Kinky Monk. Waste your precious time in our dungeon— please BYOFUT (Bring Your Own Fucked Up Toys).
landmark: 14' wide illuminated AerialKnotics signs, 10' high

name: Frybread and Friends
description: Stop by and share Frybread treats and relax in our lounge area open bar Throw axes at our ax throwing targets. We also feature non alcoholic drinks.
landmark: 4x6 banner Frybread and Friends

name: Two Lanterns
description: Best weddings on the playa, with all the trimmings! Department of Wedding Planning is in our camp, consult with the experts.
landmark: camp sign, flashing red beacon on wedding dome

name: Waffles & House
description: We serve up delicious Waffles, with all your favorite toppings, ice cold drinks, and bumping House music for your dancing pleasure all week long! Don't forget to come by on Friday for a syrup licking good time, as that's when we host our world-famous Waffolympics!
landmark: 20' bright yellow lit up WAFFLES & HOUSE sign

name: Darkwad Patrol
description: The mission of our theme camp is to increase nighttime safety in BRC by reducing the number of injuries and damage caused by collisions with inadequately lit burners, bikes and structures. To accomplish this mission we gift lights to dark burners and their bikes and engage in community outreach efforts to promote the importance of remaining visible at night. Darkwad Patrol hosts lighting workshops about the many ways to accessorize your bike and body with lights. We also provide a 24-hour Light-Share Drop Box where burners can gift lights to fellow burners and dark burners can take the lights they need.
landmark: Giant Light Bulb

name: Camp Nafas
description: A Persian-inspired oasis celebrating freedom, secularity, equality, and the spirit of shared humanity. Inspired by the Persian tradition of hospitality and gathering, our camp invites Burners to connect through tea, music, poetry, dance, and conversation. Visitors can participate in cultural experiences such as Persian calligraphy, language mini-lessons, poetry readings, and communal tea ceremonies. Through these interactive offerings, we create a welcoming space where people can slow down, breathe, and share meaningful moments with others. Camp Nafas brings the warmth of Persian culture to the playa while embracing Burning Man's principles of participation, gifting, and radical inclusion.
landmark: Persian Lanterns, cushions

name: Sake To Me
description: Sake To Me - your friendly playa servers of various chilled and flavored sake. There's plenty of sake and chill in our shaded, cushion-ish area, plus giant Jenga and other games for all!
landmark: "Sake To Me" blue neon sign

name: Diptown
description: Discover the essence of Eastern Europe at BARBORIS, where we serve only the finest Russian, Ukrainian, and Eastern European vodkas. Our cozy, intimate bar offers a unique experience with dozens of vodka brands, each served in ice-cold shot glasses for the perfect chill. Immerse yourself in the authentic atmosphere, savor the rich flavors, and participate in traditional drinking rituals. Learn what sets traditional vodka apart from the rest. Join us at BARBORIS for a journey of taste and tradition, where every sip tells a tale.
landmark: diptown sign on pergola

name: Playa Jazz Cafe
description: A celebration of Jazz Music featuring nightly concerts and jam sessions,  daytime educational workshops, and a lively bar serving coffee and cocktails.
landmark: Green Dome and Neon Playa Jazz Cafe sign

name: Kumaya
description: Cozy up in our 24/7 library lounge filled with pillows, blankets, books and art. Write, doodle, or read the journals lying all around, filled with the stories of visitors from past burns. Eat a pancake at our morning disco party. Pilgrimage with us to deep playa at sunrise for tea and tunes. Get some deep rest in our meditative sound bath or simply lounge and connect with fellow travelers < 3.
landmark: Big white dome

name: Cuttlefish Homebase
description: Come find the Cuttlefish (and Flash the Tortoise) back at their lair and say hi!
landmark: Inflatable cuttlefish

name: Apotheneum
description: Defined as a "place of divine elevation" it is a visual, sonic and haptic instrument intended to "transport" visitors through participatory immersion. Comprised of two nested chambers made of back-to-back LED nets (13,940 nodes in all), Apotheneum presents multiple canvases for collaborating visual artists and an immersive sound system for collaborating sound artists. Measuring 40 x 40 x 40 feet, Apotheneum's cubic antechamber envelops a thirty-foot "inner sanctum" that opens to the sky and is anchored by a 24-foot pressure-sensing "bed" on which visitors are invited to recline, and be transported.At night, evoking aspects of the natural world: wind, fire, lightning, rain, stars, gravity, people and animals, Apotheneum encourages inward contemplation through multi-sensory somatic immersion.
landmark: Large 30-foot translucent dome

name: The Shittest Camp
description: Our camp celebrates one of the most universal human experiences: poop. Through humor, art, and playful activities, we aim to normalize conversations around bodily functions and remind everyone that we all share the same basic human needs.Our camp features a toilet-themed bar, a quirky camp museum, and a variety of interactive activities including DJ sets, comedy, scavenger hunts, and creative workshops. Everything is centered around bathroom humor and lighthearted fun.We welcome everyone to stop by, laugh with us, and participate in the wonderfully ridiculous side of being human.
landmark: Camp flag - a roll of toilet paper, toilet bar

name: AdramaNation
description: An all inclusive and diverse camp focusing on a drama free and fun filled burn. Delicious delicacies, hydration, art, weddings, burnercise, and good company are to be found with us. Whether you need a safe space to escape your drama or a place to meet new friends, you're always welcome here.
landmark: Pink flower topped poles at the front & pink tent

name: Don't STOP
description: Black Rock City is a place where small things can derail your day or night and we want to support our fellow burners by offering small necessities [ex. tampons, condoms, sunscreen, or glowy things] from our Don't STOP Gift Box, or a drink with inspired conversation. Additionally, we offer opportunities to restore through Yoga and breathwork and learn how to repair your bike.
landmark: White shade structure with the Don't Stop banner

name: Kombuchachacha
description: Kombucha: (n) kom-BOO-cha. Renowned playa aphrodisiac. You may not get the booch you want but you will definitely get the booch you need. Cha Cha: (n) Intricate Latin American dance. The home of con+sent. Come meet our chicken(s). Relax, refresh and cha cha the day away. 4 stars on yelp 2025.
landmark: tall red and black flags flanking our sign

name: Cuddle Oasis
description: Too hot? Too Cold? Partied out? Need a break? Need a cuddle or two? or Ten? You have come to the right place! Come relax under our many shade structures. Enjoy afternoon Sound baths. Come by after a night of parting on the Playa and relax on our rugs to healing electronic sounds.Follow the large lighted Palm trees at night and come enjoy a drink at the bar and ask about our daily activities.
landmark: 4 large Palm Trees and Cuddle Oasis flags

name: UnStable
description: We are a Mutant vehicle Support Camp for an MV named "Chester."We will be sharing resources and supporting an art support camp called, "Apotheneum." They are a large scale interactive light and sound installation.
landmark: Street signs with horse information on them

name: Wonder Camp
description: The Department of Wonder is our on-playa bike shop. We offer bike repair service and education every day of the event through man-burn.
landmark: Tall flag poles, dept of wonder sign

name: The Surge
description: Come charge your small devices at THE SURGE's bar or living room. Join us for cold-brew coffee, morning meditation, education, conversation in our comfortable living room with a water mister, or grab a tasty brew or shot (or NA cocktail) at our fabulous bar. Join us for our Cancer Survivor circle on Tuesday and Thursday mornings at 11am. Come to our workshop How to become Solar Powered on Wednesday at noon. Come meditate with us at 10 am.
landmark: SURGE lit sign and solar panels above the bar

name: Naacb
description: NAACB (National Association for the Advancement of Colored Burners).
landmark: White archway frontage and large black sculpture.

name: Powder Palace
description: Bringing a winter chill to the Playa and looking forward to sharing some of our winter delights. Come by for snowshoe races and our apres-ski dance party!
landmark: Large wooden snowshoes and telemark skis!

name: Black Rock Socks
description: Come by for Chocolate Roulette, Tea and Shock Collar Karaoke for a magical time.
landmark: Look for the RV painted as the ocean

name: Karma Love Camp
description: A welcoming oasis designed for connection, relaxation, and playful interaction. We offer body art, unique experiences, dance, gifting, and a friendly space to simply be. Our camp is a chill rest stop where you can relax, recharge, and connect with new friends. Whether you're looking to join a fun event or just hang out and chat, Karma Love Camp is here to share joy and genuine community with everyone.
landmark: teepee shape 15 foot tall starlight space illusion

name: Dune Dwellers
description: Mutant Vehicle Support Camp for The Wandering Playhouse.
landmark: "The Wandering Playhouse parking" Sign

name: Dilated Peoples
description: The Eye Spa at Dilated PeoplesDust in your eyes? Step into the sanctuary of Dilated Peoples for a total sensory reset.Surrender to a choreographed journey designed to expand your inner vision. Sink into a reclining chair as we indulge your senses with chilled cucumbers, cooling gel masks, and the restorative scent of weighted lavender. Our camp family anchors the experience with caring touch and an immersive soundscape to help you truly let go.Offering tranquility and sensory restoration Monday?Wednesday afternoons.
landmark: white (illuminated) DILATED PEOPLES lettering

name: Altitude Lounge
description: Come lounge on our tower anytime, any day. Get the best view of the playa and see what you helped create. Enjoy our down-tempo beats leading into sunset.
landmark: 50' scaffolding tower with Altitude Lounge sign

name: Bearwhalea
description: They frame the wildest theories upon the most irrelevant facts, or upon the merest fancies. Mr. Darwin thinks that whales may be bears which have enormously increased their bulk, washed their paws into fins by constant swimming, and stretched their mouths by keeping them open to catch insects in the water. So also he thinks that men and women may have been developed out of monkeys, monkeys out of mushrooms, and mushrooms out of " monads," or little clots of jelly. Where is the proof? Where is a single instance of a bearwhale, or a man-monkey, to be seen? Of course there is not one.
landmark: 10' wooden platform, bearwhale sign, bone statue

name: rEVOLUTION
description: A camp of old and new friends. We believe that through evolution, we can create a revolution. We reserve the right to change, to be agents of change and to commit to the Burning Man principles each time we return after our revolution around the sun. We offer food, beverages, healing through Gamma Breath Work, opportunities to communicate with anyone and fun through dance. West Coast Swing and Martinis. Hot dogs, Chili Cheese Dogs, Veggie Dogs, and Gin & Tonic and flavored water. We feed your body, soul and sense of freedom. There are no requirements to visit us, only the ability to participate, act on immediacy and be open to both revolution and evolution. Come join us to eat, dance, breath and create!
landmark: Large rectangular white structure with rEVOLUTION

name: Magic Lantern Society
description: The Magic Lantern is a wandering inn, located at the end of all worlds. Sumptuously-appointed with antiques, curiosities, games, and mysterious old books, we are a space created for deeper human connection, and a warm and inviting sanctuary for the weary and curious traveller.Our centerpiece is our unique Trading Booth, where stories and secrets are the only accepted currency. Anyone can step up to don our shopkeeper's hat?we believe in erasing the boundaries between host and traveller.
landmark: Garlic-shaped canvas tent

name: Studio and Spa
description: Come to BRC Studio and Spa to not only to receive a massage or have your sensual, erotic or daring fine-art photo taken, but join one of our workshops and take some new skill back to the default word. Either way, walk away with a unique photo print, or a new skill, or at least relaxed!
landmark: Dome with the sign "BRC Studio & Spa"

name: Xpat Alien
description: Xpat Alien has searched far and wide, through many galaxies, to find a new place to rest our travel weary heads. Earth fits the bill and we have decided to stay.We bring with us the Crop Circle Cantina, complete with 80' of circular shade, phenomenal DJs spinning epic tunes, a bar top with stripper poles for dancing shenanigans, six 3-butt benches to relax on, Colorado brewed craft beer and root beer on tap, and glasses full of ice filled with our own Alien Punch.
landmark: Silver and blue space ship canopy

name: Hakuna Matata
description: Building art objects and art cars to light up the Playa Nocturnal Kaleidoscope!Promoting mindful and safe cruising. SLOW DOWN!!!Leave No Trace.
landmark: 53' dry-van with neon "Hakuna Matata" text

name: Servants of the Secret Fire
description: Been bringing dazzling LED and fire art to playa while hosting fire spinning jams and flow workshops since 2015. Come check out our library, dance to our DJ sets, or snuggle into the cuddle puddle beneath a glowing canopy of >14000 LEDs - look for the burgundy/red/orange/yellow dome!
landmark: dome with burgundy/red/orange/yellow coverings

name: Bone Voyage
description: Welcome to the official backstage hub for the Bone Voyage mutant vehicle! While our vessel is out cruising the dust, our support camp serves as the critical base to refuel and keep the gears turning. We don't host public events in camp, as our gift to Black Rock City is entirely mobile and out on the open playa. However, if you spot our Mammoth Skull Flags or our Bony Bus, give us a wave...we're probably just gearing up for another wild expedition!
landmark: Four 30ft flag poles: black flag and mammoth skull

name: Hello, Brooklyn
description: Hello Brooklyn is a vibrant and eclectic camp where urban cool meets whimsical creativity. Our Playa neighborhood combines the charm of Brooklyn with the playful flair of a Florida Panhandle trailer park. With radical inclusion, spontaneity, and community spirit, we create a welcoming camp filled with connection, creativity, and endless surprises.
landmark: large white tent lit like the 4th of July

name: Wetspot
description: Established in 2010 and based in Reno, NV, Wetspot is a playa favorite saloon for daytime fun and libations. We invite you to come kick in our doors and let us fill your cup with an ice-cold draft beer or our legendary Skip-and-Go Naked cocktail. Feeling like your burn needs a little more, burn? We've got you covered with a shot of our spicy tequila. You just might end up on the Wall of Flame! Drinking not your thing? That's okay too! Wetspot is about making new friends in an open-to-all setting. Dancing and laughter are guaranteed. Cheers!
landmark: Large Saloon Doors and Wetspot Flag

name: Sunrise Tavern
description: Come for the bacon, stay for the sunrise. You gnome you'll like ;).
landmark: Army trucks, letters, flames, and other cool shit

name: Star Jelly
hometown: San Francisco, San Diego, Park City
description: A loosely knit collection of individuals operating as a singular organism. Traveling space and time to learn and share with you all at Burning Man. Come by to enjoy our wonderlawn oasis and traverse the sparkly gates to the new you. Or enjoy some general shenanigans in our Jelly Dome. We'll also be giving out Gold Stars, so come by to share your tales of why you deserve a Gold Star!!! Fun for all ages!
landmark: Jellyfish dome and the light up star

name: Pickleback Oasis
description: Take a break from the hot sun and stop in for a cold Pickleback. Relax and meet new friends under our shade structure.
landmark: 2-Black Pickleback Flags

name: Reno Housewives
description: Costuming BRC since 1998. Looking for the perfect outfit for that party? ASK US -- From frumpy to fabulous, we have you covered.
landmark: Boutique w/ pink "Biggest Little Boutique" signs

name: VW Bus Camp
description: You are heartily invited to camp and participate with VW Bus Camp for Axis Mundi arriving on the Playa in an old VW Bus or other unique camper. VW Bus Camp is a wonderful and enduring Burning Man theme camp which has been placed and participated on the Playa every Burn since 1998. First, make sure to change out your leaky fuel lines, check your tires, carry a fire extinguisher and pack lots and lots of spare parts and join us participating in Bus Camp's many interactive projects. Yes, we still have a tie dye party amongst other cool stuff. This is a wonderful opportunity for you to bring out your own projects to share and to teach us all something new. Welcome Home and see you in the dust!
landmark: Old VW Campers

name: Glorious Gilded Alchemy
description: Back for more gloriously gilded shenanigans. IYKYK.
landmark: Large circular light display, and the MOM sign.

name: Embers
description: Our Desert Oasis Bar and Lounge offers craft cocktails alongside our popular self-postcard station, where participants write messages to their future selves that we mail before ticket sales as reminders of playa magic. Join us for daily morning yoga sessions, smutty poetry readings, and UV paint dance parties under our powerful blacklight system. Stop by our Playa Confessional booth to record your deepest burn revelations, then return for Absolution Happy Hour where we broadcast the previous day's confessions while serving themed forgiveness cocktails. NEW THIS YEAR come for the drinks stay for the hotdog glory hole, you know you're curious...
landmark: 20' lit octagon with "EMBERS" roof panels

name: Blood & Sugar
description: A mildly chaotic clubhouse dedicated to the strange art of keeping humans functioning with a little help from treats, movement, and friends. Stop by for Bloody Mary mornings, gummy bears, yoga, and conversations that range from heartfelt to weird to unhinged. This space celebrates resilience, curiosity, and mutual support. Wander in and help us keep things balanced.
landmark: Red Blood & Sugar banner with warm string lights.

name: Kinky Pizza
description: Hot slices, Hot flogging, and Hot fire. It's only kinky the first time...
landmark: Kinky Pizza LED lit sign

name: Dusty Beavers
description: We are the Dusty Beavers. We are a camp at Burning Man. We are from Québec, Canada and France. We bring love, joy and maple goodies to Burning Man!
landmark: Winter SnowMan

name: Pinhole Project
description: Come create large format pinhole photography to capture art installations and the community in the desert! We have built a darkroom every burn since 1999. We host art-making workshops every morning. We take the workshop on an art tour using old-school pinhole cameras loaded with photographic paper. This allows participants to slow down, observe their surroundings more closely, and truly immerse themselves in the process of capturing images. Plus, the unique aesthetic of pinhole photography adds a distinctive charm to the photographs, making them truly special mementos of the experience.
landmark: Art gallery full of giant pinhole paper negatives

name: Endstation
description: Camp Endstation is your last stop before nowhere. Grab a ticket from our dispenser, find a seat, and see what happens. Some days it's a conversation workshop with strangers, other days a tarot reading you didn't plan on. When night falls, the Disorient Express takes over with beats, incense, and tea. Or catch the Loco Motive for a sunrise party before the heat hits. Between events, the tent is open, the tea is hot, and there's always a seat.

name: Honey Pot Tea House

Whether you stop by for an activity or just to relax and connect, you'll find a community that feels like home.Don't miss our Punk night! Lose yourself in a night of music, mischief, and mayhem under the stars.Come share stories, make memories, and, of course, indulge in our signature purple tastings. You never know what magic awaits!

name: Bad Asstronauts

Our DJs will blow your mind with electrifying beats on our upgraded sound system to bring you an incredible new audio and visual experience. Quench your thirst with our extraordinary elixirs crafted by our skilled mixologists at the Moontang Bar. Step into our chill lounge, the Planetarium, where you can find tranquility while gazing at celestial wonders projected above. We look forward to continuing to be the best gateway to the galaxy on playa since 2015.

name: Camp Come Find Us CCFU

Come flow with us and find your journey! We will create a laid-back and spontaneous atmosphere, and our offerings will be inspiring and fulfilling. name: Kamp Kit

Drop in during the week for a cognitive assessment and maybe a brain massage or two. Submit an unwanted memory for ceremonial destruction in the MDU-7, our clinical apparatus that is proven to be 100% effective except for ????????? and ???????????????????.Monday: memory journaling. Wednesday: memory auction. Friday: Memory Burn ceremony. The tone is institutional, the forms are voluminous and the experience is real. Walk-ins welcome. Walk-outs vary.

We will be providing hot ramen & drinks after the burn.

description: A collective of musicians and dancers dedicated to creating classical and contemporary productions on playa and sharing their art with the citizens of Black Rock City. We are a mix of professional and recreational artists and their supporters from all over the world.

name: Flat Tire Cafe
description: Welcome to Flat Tire Cafe, your oasis in the dust! Join us every weekday from 10AM to 2PM for iced coffee and expert bicycle repair services. Nestled under a vibrant, colorful shade canopy, our camp offers a haven of relaxation and fun, day or night for all ages! Dive into our interactive game lounge, where laughter and camaraderie flow as freely as our coffee. Whether you're seeking refuge from the sun, a quick bike fix, or just a place to chill and meet new friends, Flat Tire Cafe is your go-to spot. Open to all burners, we're here to make your journey smoother and your days brighter. See you under the canopy!Note: We do not fix electric bikes. Sorry OG bikes only!
landmark: Large Flat Tire Cafe Sign and Wheel!

name: Frozen Oasis
description: Home of the Dust City Symphony. Shelter from the storm and relax under the misters with a yummy frozen slushy drink and a live classical music performance.

name: Impromptu Tomato
description: Your neighborhood coffeeshop serving The Playa's Most Adequate Coffee every morning. Bring your cup. Milks, sugars, light snacks, shade, and good conversation provided. Find us by the giant tomato - our gently cooled and ventilated chill space.

name: Yummm
description: Yummm is a camp dedicated to creating Yummmy (non-food) moments for everyone on playa!
landmark: Scaffolding tower and Yummm sign

name: Betty's Bike Shop
description: Bring your broken bike to our camp and With Consent we will help you get to a Happy Ending. We want you Fixed so you can return that familiar and intimate friend back where it belongs. Right Between your legs! A functional Playa Bike; now that's a Happy Ending! Limited Hours of Happiness so Cum Early for Best Results.
landmark: Betty's Shop Sign on Front of 20x20 White Tent

name: Lovin' Oven
description: In the middle of the desert: hot, dry and dusty; we bake bread. All week, every morning. Just for you!Let us feed, host and entertain you. Enjoy freshly baked bread served with tasty toppings, including some vegan loaves everyday; freshly brewed mint tea and unbelievably good vibes! Chill out on the suspended cuddle puddle or day beds, have a dance with DJs changing daily, hang out in the shade or come back and chill in the quiet at night. The Lovin Oven welcomes you ALL.
landmark: 20" High neon sign saying 'Lovin Oven'

name: Weird Steel
description: A dynamic Burning Man camp where steel artistry takes center stage. We are a collective of passionate artists and creators dedicated to pushing the boundaries of creativity through the medium of steel and steel-framed art installations. From Rhino Redemption, Medusa, and The Flower Tower, Fire Cathedral, Brass Ring just to name a few. Our camp is a celebration of innovation, imagination, and the transformative power of art.
landmark: Rhino Redemption or Grilled Cheese & Advice Palace

name: Vomiting Sparrows
description: We serve the best Bloody Mary on the playa. We entertain, we make friends, we make fun, we welcome all. Keep an eye and ear open for our special events. Chirp Chirp Blarf!
