name: The Organization
description: Whether you are tired and in need of energy, or simply heading out on the playa and in need of a drink, stop by our camp for an espresso martini (or simply an iced coffee or non-alcoholic beverage)! Meet and chat with fellow burners while you sit in our shade, lay down in our hammock, rest in our cuddle puddle or jump on our trampoline.
landmark: Light up 8 foot circle Espresso Martini yin-yang

name: Oh mi Gato Rat Cafe!
description: Oh Mi Gato Rat Cafe, formerly known as Oh Mi Gato Hat Cafe, formerly known as Oh Mi Gato Cat Cafe, delighting your senses with a combination of Colombian coffee, relaxing yoga movements, really cool hats and Latino party vibes. Drinks, art and music. What else do you need to find your inner beast.
landmark: multiple big heads and hats

name: Camp Piper
description: A ragtag group of international babes who all appreciate the elegant screeching and sophisticated whine of the bagpipe. Currently seeking a bagpipe player! Our camp was founded in 2014 when most of us (being virgin burners) stranded on the playa at the same place, same time. We all woke up to the beautiful sound of the bagpipe. Every since we have been warming wandering souls on the Playa. Stop by for a drink, a hug, and a belly laugh. Sparkles, y'all!
landmark: flag with Camp Piper on it

name: Après Ski Injury
description: An interactive camp offering an Après-Ski Bar, a Morning Coffee Bar as well as a thrill ride: A ski ramp in the middle of the desert! Our bar is open every afternoon till late night and offers not only drinks, but entertainment, fun games and fire.You can also ski!We will have also events (see WhatWhereWhen) and ski-races.
landmark: Ski Ramp and the big "Apres Ski Injury" neon sign

name: Under the Big Top
description: Come visit our camp and enjoy talks and teachings of Qigong energy healing and various other modalities. Relax on the many couches in our chill space with introspective music in the background and fall into some fun and deep conversation about qigong and the meaning of life. Try out some of the dozens of hammocks hanging from an intricate and interesting hammock structure. In the mornings stop by for some yoga in the shade!
landmark: Long white 3 tipped tent and hammock structure.

name: Camp Shit Ain't Right
description: Wyoming-based with international flair - campmates from Wyoming, Canada, New Zealand, Russia, Australia, Ukraine, UK Germany, Netherlands... aaaand I'm definitely missing some. Come visit for public lounge, food, movie night, clothing boutique, large-scale, shitty punch and more!
landmark: Large painted canvases with our name on it.

name: Tac-O-Cat
description: We are Camp Tac-O-Cat. We cook tacos for the masses and enjoy serving libations and great conversation. We offer shade, a misty breeze and we have a few gear-heads who like to solve problems. Our camp is made up of Burners with deep roots in playa culture and a few we have newly adopted. People will likely be pulled in by heckling when they pass by, and some of the best connections have come from luring our new friends in from the street. We enjoy cracking people out of their comfort zone and immersing them in dusty happiness.At sunset Monday, Wednesday and Friday we will be offering tacos. Our tacos are playa-famous and have a special grilled tortilla. We have vegetarian options as well.Last year we brought out 1,000 pounds of cold beer and plan to do the same this year.
landmark: Massive antenna with a lighted taco on top

name: Hibernaculum
description: Care to get shot in the box? Get dizzy on the Bat Go Round? Savor Bat Bacon? How about a late night movie or licking your lips with Bat Blueberry Pancakes? At the Hibernaculum, serendipity rules! Know what a Hibernaculum is? Come find out.
landmark: Black & White Bat Go Round with bat head & wings

name: 706 Tribe
description: Where scattered stories meet - a diaspora of makers and dreamers, kindred spirits building home in the nowhere.Ink in the wind. Roots in the dust. Home in each other.
landmark: 706 Tribe flag with a dog cartoon

name: Signing Wanderers
description: Silence can be surprisingly loud when hands start talking. Visitors are invited to learn American Sign Language, play visual communication games, and experience Deaf culture in a lively and welcoming space. Try flirting without words, tell stories through signs, and discover how much can be said without speaking. Come join the fun and let your hands do the talking.
landmark: Looking for "Signing Wanderers" neon lights sign

name: Camp Blowjob
description: Camp Blowjob is where you can let loose and get your leaf blown at Burning Man in a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! We aim to provide a fun atmosphere where all are welcome!

name: Loadie Camp
description: The home of the iconic Shark Car. Loadie Camp is a hive of Mutant Vehicle visionaries and builders, contributing over 10 different Mutant Vehicles of varying sizes. Come meet the builders and learn more about the Mutant Vehicle process.
landmark: Clearly marked Loadie Camp Bar facing the street

name: Atomic Pussy Photo Lounge
description: Come visit what is easily the 3rd best Bar/Lounge and Photo Booth on the playa. Returning this year is Weir(d) Wednesday, when we'll be serving up a hero dose of the Grateful Dead all afternoon. Also returning this year is our twin-tip, reverse camber Shot-Ski (for those playa face shots), the Elaine Benes Dance Experience (dance classes for dance-introverts) — and of course the photobooth, photo art, and photo gifts. Noon-6pm M-T-W-Th-F. Lounge space is 24 hrs.

name: HeeBeeGeeBee Healers
description: We are BRC's long-standing oasis for nurturing, grounding and healing. Stop by to hang out and chill, take a class, or to receive a healing session for the mind, body and spirit.

name: Wasted Sunshine
description: Frozen Lemonade FOR ALL AGES! Fantastic insults! Booze for consenting adults. AC Lounge chill zone.

name: Camp Summer Camp
description: We are a San Francisco-based camp that celebrates the whimsical spirit of Summer Camp. We want to revisit the connection, growth, and playful wonder that comes with those magical childhood weeks. Think back to those golden days of campfire singalongs, friendship bracelets, and endless play?our mission is to teleport you right back to that delightful, wonder-filled time of your youth, but reimagined on the Playa.
landmark: bedazzled 'Camp Summer Camp' sign

name: Black Rock City Welding & Repair
description: Welding, repair, adjustment and general tinkering help. Come on over to use our tools to repair your stuff or get our help repairing what's broken. We repair bikes and all sorts of other things. Enjoy an adult or NA beverage at the Crowbar - our shaded walk up and sit down Bar.
landmark: 10' foot high large shade area and bright sarongs

name: Ataraxia
description: We're a safe space to: Chill. Laugh. Dance. Meet. Experience. Learn.

name: Mo's Mini Martini + Erotica Camp
description: Mohammeds serves the coldest martinis and the hottest erotica on the playa. Come and join us for an ice cold martini in a REAL martini glass and, if the spirit moves you, write down your own true erotic tale in our 400 year old book filled with the daring do's of other Black Rock Citizens. We open after lunch at 1:00pm and close when the camels go to bed, around 1:00am.

name: BurningShip

Join us at "BurningShip," a cruise ship full of immoral crew that's currently stranded in the desert! We'll be your booze directors, providing you with drinks, smiles, and fun events. Learn how to salsa dance, smoke a premium stogie, and let's get "Knotty!" Come with no expectations and leave feeling full. Full of love, hugs, laughs, and WTFs. And most importantly long lasting Burning(friend)Ships.

name: Pink Lightning
description: Pink Lightning is the home of the Burning Man Ultramarathon, and all things running at Burning Man: the 5k, the beer mile, the naked mile, easy mile, and more! Come to run an event or support an event. We also love all things PINK!

name: Metal-Morphosis

name: Candyland

Enjoy a sweet treat from one of a dozen retro decorated candy dispensing machines.After choosing your favorite vodka flavor, get in line at "The Claw" for an opportunity for more treats, and some x-rated sex toys for those over 18.CandyLand is open every day from 11am - 4 pm for Candy treats, and 1- 4 pm to play "The Claw" to win fun, safe sex toys!

name: Combat Zone

name: Red Nose District
description: Red Nose District (RND) has been in existence, in one form or another since 1998. In 2013, we resolved to keep our hearts, minds, and noses RED from now until the end of time! RND has roots and participants in LA, SF, Santa Fe, NYC, Las Vegas, Pacific NW, Canada, Israel, France, & various states & countries around the world. Our members are involved in (or are lovers of) the circus arts, & work to bring our skills & talents to the playa in forms that allow for immersive & participatory experiences for citizens of Black Rock City. Notable past projects/activities include: High Chair Stilt Bar, PedalBump, Muse, Fire Wire, Wheel of Fortune, Zenobia Blanca stilt limo, Mega Mega, Bounce Back, stilt lessons, 30' swings, & circus variety shows of all forms! Come find us on the playa!
landmark: Big Top Circus Tent with Light up RED NOSE signage

name: No Stairway To Heaven
description: Musicians and wanderers gather here for open jam sessions where anyone can join the circle with instruments, percussion, or pure curiosity. Our signature event, Jam Battle, invites players into a friendly one-on-one improvisational showdown inspired by dance battles and musical conversation. Throughout the week visitors can relax in the lounge, share moments of spontaneous music, and if you're lucky, you'll find our White Dwagon Ramen Cart gifting fresh bowls of ramen to hungry travelers. Come listen, play, and see what happens when people surrender to the moment.
landmark: Illuminated NO STAIRWAY TO HEAVEN sign and stage

name: Indigo's Speakeasy

name: HealAF
description: HealAF is your sanctuary for physical and mental recovery on the playa. We offer air cupping sessions to relieve your exhausted muscles. Simply lie down on a comfortable mat and tell us your areas of concern. While the air cups work on your physical tension, our practitioners provide soothing sound healing to wash away your mental fatigue. Stop by to heal from the inside out and get back to your burn completely refreshed.

name: Camp Bean Water
description: Beans, flicking, roasting, steamy dripping love, room for cream ? our secret steps to the finest cup of coffee. Bring your brewtiful self over to Camp Bean Water to enjoy a cup and let us show you the full potential of a coffee shop. All cups of coffee our baristas serve-up are made to order and come with positive affirmations. Looking for something to fill your now stimulated colon, our cooks can fry you up mouth-watering arepas. Love and good vibes are abundant in our cafe, so drip on in. We're open every weekday morning. We have special evening events like arepa night and a special sunrise opening.
landmark: "Camp Bean Water" large painted sign.

name: Inappropirates

There may be puppets.Also, our coffee bar will be periodically taken over by the mutinous Priva-tea-ers for piping cold ice tea! Join and walk the plank (with your pinkie out)! Times TBD!

name: The Enclave

We are united by a passion for art, design and bafoonery. The Enclave brings a spicy hot mess of Playastani energy to Black Rock.
landmark: Enclave sign on Moroccan tent w/ lanterns & flags

name: Barbie Death Village
description: Barbie Death Village is a delight to the eyes and the mind. Our camp features the Infamous Barbie Art - 1500 Barbies marching into the Barbie Dream Chipper. Barbie's street fronts are full of a range of interactivity! Swim up to our Barbie Swim Up Bar for a drink, enjoy our artistic Barbie-based silliness, stay for one of our many events which range from Pewter Casting, Liquid Light Show, Midnight Toast, Morning Mimosas (Sat), and so much more. Keep an eye out for and take a ride on our beloved Mutant Vehicle: The Barbie Whorehouse (It is not just a Whorehouse, it is a Whore Home.).
landmark: Hoard of 2000 Barbies

name: Twats Your Gender?
description: An LGBTQ led camp inviting participants to explore creativity, identity, and connection through playful interactive experiences. Visitors can screen print personal items with the address of something meaningful and unique to this year's theme. Guests can also create whimsical insect artwork by stamping marbled paint from their bum to create wings onto a small canvas and adding bug bodies and details to design a one of a kind creature. Art can be taken home or left to dry in our gallery and collected later. Our intentionally provocative camp name is meant to spark conversation. Through humor, creativity, and participation we hope to encourage curiosity, foster understanding, and celebrate the radical inclusion that makes our community so powerful.
landmark: Lit-up TYG & Sky Bar with mirrored tiles signs

name: Afterglow
description: That wonderful feeling that lingers long after the experience has elapsed - a feeling that only occurs when the mind, body, and soul has been ever so stimulated. Our gift to the Playa and to its dear citizens is Afterglow!
landmark: Lighted wooden arch w/ "Afterglow", blue carpet

name: M*A*S*H 4207th
description: Attention all personnel! Come visit the MASH 4207th - best care anywhere! Relax during the day with ice cold PBRs and the best martinis on the Playa. Enjoy the shade of our vintage tents and the company. Return at night for a break from the chaos of the burn with nightly showings of MASH TV episodes.
landmark: 10' tall by 6' wide MASH sign on our frontage

name: Pookah Lounge/SNAFUBAR
description: Pookah Lounge is a legendary dusty Burner hideaway glowing with Christmas lights, hookah, art, music, and excellent humans. Thrills and chills await but the best part is YOU. Come in and stay awhile.SNAFUBAR (the Better Beverage Bar) is an irreverent MASH-style camo-netted field bar for dusty wanderers in need of hydration and questionable advice. Stay in school - we'll mix you the best drinks on the playa.
landmark: Big camo monkey hut, L-shaped bar w/camo netting

name: Horny Camp
description: Horny Camp is an arts & crafts camp with a cheeky, sexy twist. Our crafts can be appropriate for everybody, from children to the childish (but pervy) at heart. Our main craft is horn making; we teach our guests to mold polymer clay to create little horns to wear on their heads. We also offer bar night events, and have an art gallery called the Gallery of Cocks that honors all things chicken, as well as other art. Visit the camp at hornycamp.com for activities list and photos of prior year's activities.
landmark: purple rope light around the corner of our camp

name: Burning Band Camp
description: This is the home of the itinerant Burning Band, here to provide you with an earful of music. Well, two earfuls, really...
landmark: Burning Band flags

name: Hydration Station
hometown: Salt Lake City, Reno, New York
description: Come and get energized ! Jägermeister Bombs (And tequila and vodka ) daily from 2-4pm Sunday - Friday!! Water and Gatorade and shade available during the heat of the day!!
landmark: Hydration station sign Unshaded structure

name: Oral Fixation
description: Popsicles!! Come one, come all, to partake of our tantalizing treats!! Suckle your way through the pearly gates of bliss. We've doubled our offerings to maximize your oral pleasure. Don't miss out!!
landmark: 4 foot round red lips and teeth that says ORAL inside the mouth

name: Popsicle Bahrrr
description: Ahoy matey! Welcome to Popsicle Bahrrr, a pirate- and beach-themed camp where sun-weary seafarers gather for friendly parley over ice-cold popsicles.Drawn in by the beacon of our lighthouse and music from DJNEW, wanderers can find respite from the desert heat beneath our shade canopy and relax in the Popsicle Bahrrr lounge. Inside, guests can unwind on inflatable seating while enjoying or playing our colorful, popsicle-themed piano.Being the generous pirates that we arRrrre, we share refreshing popsicle booty with visitors daily from 2?5 PM, Monday through Saturday. Popsicle Bahrrr is a cheerful gathering place for mariners, mermaids, and hearties of all ages. Ahoy!
landmark: 24ft tall white lighthouse

name: Naked Heart
description: Naked Heart is devoted to the full embodiment of the divine feminine. We offer amazing experiential and experimental workshops that allow you to feel your feminine heart, your radiance, your inner goddess. This work requires the masculine as well; Everyone is welcome. At Naked Heart we recognize the need to embrace both the light and the dark in our journeys. When we pursue the light we use movement, the senses, sensuality, sexuality and connection. This beckons us in and brings the light of awareness back into the bodies we have vacated. To go there fully requires confronting our shadows. We embrace those as well as we dive into shame, fear, anger, unsavory memories from this life and past lives, and disempowering images of our bodies. Welcome home.
landmark: Massive Steel Entryway

name: Bitchin' Braid Camp
description: Come for the braids, stay for the bar parties. Please grab a partner or find one in the braiding lounge to make a plan for a style that will last the week. Braiders on hand with all the supplies and skills to get you taken care of, including mirrors to check out your sweet self on the way out. No hair? NO PROBLEM. From 10am to sunset we have have hosted bar parties, new faces, new specialty drinks, new outfits and new music every two hours. Want to be apart of our camp's 10 year tradition, head over right before sunset to grab a bevy and enjoy a special treat as the sun starts kissing those mountains. Miss you already, so swing by.
landmark: Blue Camp Sign in Front of our Shade Structure

name: Mouse House
description: You know who loves hammocks? Mice love hammocks. If you also love hammocks, you might be a mouse yourself! Come to the Mouse House to get in touch with your inner rodent. Vibes so chill you might find yourself trapped.
landmark: Glowing "Mouse House" sign, hammocks under shade.

name: Flybynyte
description: Serving exquisite coffee drinks at the Airport from 8am-noon, Mo-Sat.Come and enjoy our live music and Rainbow Roots Cafe atmosphere while waiting for a flight.Mo-Fri 10am-noon we will have aviation ground school. Our instructors will give you an introduction to aerodynamics, weather, radio communications, avionics, airspace and all things aviation. We can go as easy or as deep as u like - let's learn about flying in a playful way!
landmark: ctr of the airport village Café with yellow shade

name: DeMentha
description: Mojitos, Music, Shade, Mist & Dancing served up with a warm DeMentha welcome.
landmark: Two DeMentha signs at the corners of our frontage

name: Latica
description: We are a very diverse camp that will exemplify radical inclusion. This camp will be mostly populated by latinX individuals from Venezuela, Mexico and various hispanic upbringings along with some strong allies.
landmark: Large blackboard on the front with our camp name

name: Unitopia
description: A welcoming oasis of music, creativity, and connection. Our camp features a large shaded lounge where participants can relax, meet new friends, and enjoy playful daytime gatherings. Throughout the week we host morning yoga, coffee and music sessions, workshops, and our signature Unicorns and Spritz dance party. Our music art car SoGnarwhal occasionally docks at camp for special performances with DJs and cirque acts, bringing energy and celebration to our stage and dance floor. Whether you come for music, conversation, or a moment of rest, Unitopia invites you to step inside, share the space, and experience a little magic in the dust.
landmark: 10ft illuminated unicorn statue

name: Habitat for Insanity
description: We create novel burner technology and use it to bring new experiences to Black Rock City. This includes shave ice machines invented by camp members, HVAC/refrigeration adaptations for our new installation "The Tundra," and geodesic dome design by one of the Burning Man old school masters.
landmark: Giant white igloo

name: Midnight Roast
description: Late Night Afterhours Coffee + Music! The ONLY coffee service after midnight.
landmark: Giant rotating coffee mug and big red sign

name: Better Together
hometown: Zurich, Tel-Aviv, San Diego, New York
description: Better Together Camp is where sparks fly and connections are made, literally, we're not responsible for any Playa-induced lightning strikes. Our Speed Dating isn't your average meet-and-greet; it's all about real conversations, radical self-expression, and a little bit of magic. Whether you're a Burning Man newbie or a dusty veteran, we've got a spot for you to connect, laugh, and maybe even find your Playa soulmate (or just a good chat). In our camp, everyone's welcome, and everyone's encouraged to be their weird, wonderful selves. Come for the speed dating, stay for the unforgettable memories, and remember: we're better together.
landmark: Better Together neon light sign

name: The Alphabet Cookout
description: A welcoming neighborhood gathering space rooted in cookout culture and the joyful spirit of the Alphabet Mafia. Stop by our shaded lounge and bar to relax, meet new people, and enjoy music with a focus on house and dance traditions connected to Black and queer communities. Throughout the week we host listening sessions, neighborhood happy hours, and casual social gatherings that invite participants to step off their bikes and connect with one another. Expect warm vibes, good conversation, and a little bit of DC flavor on the playa. Come hang out and help turn strangers into neighbors. We're serving culture, not food.
landmark: Yard sign w/ camp logo, a grill w/ rainbow flames

name: Vagabonds & Tagalongs
description: A camp for wanderers and wanderlust! Vags and Tags brings together an ever-expanding nationwide community of burners to co-create a space where everyone can feel at home. Come by and see for yourself why we've won the official BRC award for best friends on playa since 2012!
landmark: various Vagabonds & Tagalongs signs!

name: Best Year Yet
description: Providing the best hot drip coffee on playa every morning. Come enjoy a cup of Joe, a game of cribbage (or learn cribbage) and pay a visit to our magical gaseous eggplant!
landmark: Rainbow camp banner "Camp Best Year Yet"

name: U.F.O.
description: U.F.O. is an oasis by day to pamper yourself and relax in a cozy, shaded environment with great music. At night we turn up the bass and the fire. Lots of personality.
landmark: Large shade structure with about 20 couches

name: Snow Cone Zone
description: We provide Snow cones at Center Camp Monday thru Friday 12 to 3pm.
landmark: look for Snow Cone Zone sign

name: Branding & Booze
description: Bring your own leather and leave with a piece of playa-forged art! Use our cattle irons to brand or our stamping machine to stamp Burning Man-related images (like the man or city map)! We will have pre-cut leather for those without an item to bring. Enjoy our homemade liquors, chill in our shade, listen to our music, and play our Barn Games. Look for bright blue shade!
landmark: Bright blue shade structure, Branding&Booze sign

name: Stag Camp
description: We invite anyone and everyone (drama-free), including singles, couples, and small groups from all walks of life. We have no strict regimen of things to do or fees to pay. Everyone contributes as much as they like, with radical self-reliance a camp cornerstone. If you're looking for shared showers, meal plans, kitchen shifts, etc., we're not the spot for you. We all just come and hang out, creating a community among ourselves that is unique, fun, and will be whatever you make of it!
landmark: Red Fire Truck and Zipline

name: Lit AF
description: Stumbling around the playa in the dark like a total darkwad? Come get Lit AF! We'll help you add fairy lights to your bike, backpack, or outfit. Stop by for a workshop, spare batteries (AA or CR2032), or to donate extra lights or batteries to the cause. And if you need lights while you're out and about, our Darkwad Patrol may just find you and save your poor darkwad soul.
landmark: 10 foot LED sign with lightning bolt + sun rays

name: BRC3PO (BRC 3:00 Post Office)
description: Set in a giant rural postbox, the Black Rock City 3:00 Post Office (BRC3PO) provides postal services to the citizens of Black Rock City. We offer authentic, one-on-one, creative interactions that range from the side-splittingly silly to the supremely sublime. We also provide an array of curated Burning Man postcards and postage to send those postcards anywhere in the world - as our gift to the citizens of Black Rock City.. Imagine the intersection of immersive improvisational theater, spontaneous talent show, soulful conversation, and stifling yet corrupt bureaucracy. You never know what will happen next at BRC3PO -- YOU could be what will happen next at BRC3PO, if you pay us a visit!
landmark: Giant white postbox with BRC3PO sign and red flag

name: The Pink Spot
description: The Pink Spot is an art car support camp with The Big Bunny art car, Dj driven holding up to 40 burners. We will leave camp every evening around dusk, please come by for a prefunk and hop on for a thorough throw down!
landmark: Heart lights on large pole & pink frontage lights

name: Here
description: Here-n-Burn Drive Thru: The playa's best breakfast sandwich and wedding drive thru.
landmark: Red Here Sign and Red Flamingo Arrows

name: Camp [No Name]
description: An international camp hosting DJs, yoga, workshops, theme parties, a bar for the thirsty, cozy lounging, bar games and flogging/kink dungeon. Specializing in dubious advice and questionable antics.
landmark: Street bar w/ mesh siding & camp sign on top

name: Camp Kerosene
description: Black Rock City's premiere laser engraving camp. Solar powered gifts from the playa.
landmark: stripper pole bike trailer

name: The Key Camp
description: The Key = Believe. We have a key for you to open any door. During our interactive event, "Fortune Key Hunting," we will help you discover your key and guide you on how to use it to open new doors in life.After you explore your key, we will serve cold Japanese green tea and offer you a choice of a henna tattoo of your Kanji or a Kanji sticker.
landmark: Japanese Flag and Malaysia Flag! Red & White Noren

name: IHOTT: After Dark
description: IHOTT (Intergalactic House of Time Travelers) is back with a twist! This year we welcome IHOTT: After Dark, an elevated, bespoke cocktail and ramen based night time version of your old favorite time travelling camp! Grab a cocktail in our glassware from our bartender, or sit down for the best meal you'll have all week!
landmark: 16' LED Hourglass, Large White Tent, Billboard

name: Quarks and Recreation
description: Games for Progress! Play! Scientists vs. Valkyries! Discover! Nuclear Fusion Bocce-Golf! Learn! The modern wonders of the Atomic Age! Your local Quarks and Recreation department invites you to experience our comprehensive catalog of nuclear-inspired games, physics trivia, labyrinthian bureaucracy, and definitely-not-radioactive "drinks" at the elusive h-bar. (Void where the strong nuclear force is inhibited; the electromagnetic force may apply).
landmark: Parklet with gatorade fountain

name: 17 Virgins
description: Invites you to the transdimensional portal. Come explore our 250' long tunnel to another universe! Who knows you may find a hidden doorway to the party of your dreams.
landmark: 17Virgins Owl and the 250 FUCKING FOOT LONG TUNNEL

name: Celestial Tea Garden
description: Welcome to Celestial Tea Garden Camp, a vibrant, women-led, multicultural oasis celebrating the rich diversity of culture in our vibrant zen tea dome amidst the dusty canvas of Burning Man. We are multi culture camp bringing asian traditions to the playa. Our camp is a sanctuary where ancient traditions meet modern playfulness, all dedicated to fostering a deep sense of community, understanding, and radical inclusion.
landmark: LED Signs and Giant Stretch Tent

name: Steep?
description: GOOD JOB! You made it to Burning Man. Now come playfully question existence with us at STEEP?. Explore you inner child with games, heckling, random acts of wonder, authenticity, connection, and... DRINKS. We love them. With alcohol, without alcohol, and often featuring plant extracts and ALWAYS made with love. Come Drink in the Love at camp STEEP? ya weirdos.
landmark: A large, white, Morrocan stretch tent and signage

name: Fatwatt
description: Experience Ego Death, an interactive electric chair.
landmark: Fatwatt camp sign and Ego Death electric chair

name: badlands
description: Badlands is a live music open jam camp. Formed in 2011, we have always had a drum kit (or 3), amps, guitar, bass, keys, and a PA with microphones available for anyone that wants to come by and play. All levels of musicianship (within reason haha) are welcome!! We are open from 3-7 Mon-Fri and oftentimes have random night jams too! We have topless bartenders and bottomless drinks at our bar and a comfy shaded area with games and couches to relax, enjoy music and get out of the sun.
landmark: Badlands flags and mailbox in front

name: The Fluffy Cloud
description: Home of the The Fluffy Cloud! A giant 360-degree immersive sound and light installation towering 3 stories tall and equally wide, the Cloud is a one-of-a-kind art amplification platform hosting a variety of musical interactivity throughout the week. From world-class DJs to interactive jukebox nights, to sound baths, join us under the Cloud every day of the week to get your taint-shaken by 200,000 watts of overhead sound, light and magic creating a 360 space purpose built for connection.
landmark: The giant UFO-looking Cloud and 360 spinning laser

name: Brainiac Camp
description: Brainiac Camp and the Burning Man Philosophical Center: Where Principles Collide and Confusion Is a FeatureWelcome to the resurrected Philosophical Center...not a department, not a brand, but a sandbox of inquiry and absurdity. Here, we do what philosophy does best: take your Burning Man-related discomfort, ambiguity, and unresolved contradictions... and roll around in them with delight.Have a conundrum? A dilemma? A principle-on-principle conflict (say, Radical Self-Expression vs. Civic Responsibility)? Bring it.
landmark: Naked Heart sign on the corner

name: I Love Elephants
description: I Love Elephants Camp is a gathering space celebrating art, animals, and connection. Our open Living Commons invites participants to explore interactive installations devoted to the creatures people love, from elephants to wolves, bees, ravens, and more. At the heart of the camp is the Gaia Dome, inspired by the spirit of Ram Dass, featuring visionary art, conversations, tea gatherings, and immersive projection experiences. Throughout the week visitors can join workshops, paint wooden elephant keepsakes, cool off in our misting oasis, and gather for music, storytelling, and art under the desert sky. Everyone is welcome to participate.
landmark: huge geodesic dome

name: Bloom Camp
description: Join us at Bloom Camp, where we help burners thrive - not just survive.Bloom is a portal to human flourishing, centered around our climbable art installation, Bloom Pyramid by Gregg Fleishman. From there, we open space for transformative conversations and workshops exploring art, culture, consciousness, and human potential.By day, come by for our signature mimosas and fresh smoothies.By night, we come alive with DJ sets, live music and link ups with Art cars.Come Bloom with us!
landmark: Brown and beige geometric pyramid and orange shade

name: Northwest Mist
description: World famous misting tent that is like walking into a rain forest on playa. Where we come together to provide a cool oasis for dusty travelers. We open before event opening so that the builders of our great city and art have somewhere to cool off, regenerate and talk to other builders.
landmark: Front sign with national flags

name: ImagiMorphia
description: Welcome to Camp Imorgimorphia, a space where creativity and transformation converge. Inspired by the concept of "morphing," we invite you to explore and express your evolving self through art, interactive experiences, and collaboration. Join us for immersive installations, transformative rituals, and workshops focused on personal growth and creative expression. Whether you're seeking self-discovery or community connection, Imorgimorphia is a space to shed the old and embrace the new. Come evolve with us on the Playa!
landmark: Large shades with sign ImagiMorphia

name: Bioluminati (Bike Mutation)
description: Unadorned cyclists beware-- The Style Enforcement Officers will be back in person in the dust to issue citations for kinetic-aesthetic violations! But fear not: the Bioluminati Bike Mutation Station - is THE destination for bicycle decoration and transformation. We gift all manner of non-moopagenic materials and accoutrements for mutating your mobile mount into something magnificent! We are open Monday through Friday from 11-2ish hosting interactive bike decorating activities. We have a spray paint area, lots of duct tape, toys, dolls, barbies, non-moopy materials, all helping to make the playa a more fun and colorful place to be!On Tuesday night, we will have a night bike DANCE PARTY!! with lights to decorate bikes and a DJOn Saturday a.m. we will be having a bike mutation ride parade!
landmark: Bike Mutation Signage

name: Dustfish
description: DUSTFISH, serving Love and Pho all week.
landmark: Red bar and red shade with a crane behind.

name: Johnny Tacomas at The Last Resort
description: Here at The Last Resort motel we pride ourselves on our 5 star attitude and 1 star accommodations. Busted shoe? Empty stomach? Flat tires? Tired hoofs? Take a load off! We might possibly have what you need. Please take a number, have a seat, and someone will be with you shortly.You can grab a bite at our playa renowned flagship diner, Johnny Tacomas. The menu changes hourly to offer a unique and unpredictable dining experience. When we're not at the desk, you can catch us cruising on Inky, Clyde, or Pacman, floating through the night like ghosts in hot pursuit. If you see us glowing in the distance, chase us down and hop on before we vanish into the maze of the Playa!
landmark: Arcade themed booth, 20 ft tall white trailer

name: Dusk
description: Psychedelic techno/tech-house inspired by the original sunset parties in Venice Beach, CA.
landmark: Big orange sphere in the sky

name: Fingerbang
description: Fingerbang is a rowdy crew of cheerleaders, athletes, and coaches who love to play, dance, and cheer for YOU! Come grab a megaphone and heckle from the top of our Bleachers. Join us for Hoppy Homecoming, naughty cheers, riotous games of Burner Family Feud and Porn Spelling Bee, cold drinks and dancing at the Go Fuck Yourself Saloon, and our Cheer Gear and Couture Jockstrap Boutique. Don't miss our truly epic Wednesday Pep Rally, complete with pom-poms, whistles, cheering, dancing & general mayhem.
landmark: Fingerbang Sign

name: Xoxo
description: Welcome to your oasis on the playa! Kick back on our loungers, sip icy-cold refreshments that rotate daily, snack on coconut pancakes, and get ready to make some awesome connections. Whether you're shaking it at our parties, stretching at our yoga class, or enjoying sunset views over BRC from our scaffold, there's no shortage of ways to meet new friends.With friendly people, chill vibes, and a whole lotta love, XOXO is all about making meaningful connections. We've got beats that'll get you dancing, interactivity that'll make you laugh, and an atmosphere that's pure magic. Come for the pancakes, stay for the vibes!
landmark: 2 story scaffold with, XOXO sign & red led border

name: Duckbutt
description: Waddle on over and quack yourself up with our ri-duck-ulous games.
landmark: Bright green DUCKBUTT sign

name: Pirate Camp
description: Pirate Camp is a diverse group of experienced burners providing Black Rock City with the finest frozen alcoholic refreshments. Are you too hot and parched to go on? Looking to make new friends? Stop by any afternoon from 1-4pm and hoist a mug with the Pirates. Margarita, Mai Tai, Daiquiri or Pina Colada.
landmark: 4 22 foot flagpoles,5 foot pennants and LED lights

name: Sobremesa
description: People arrive for a drink or a taco and somehow stay for hours. Inspired by the Mexican tradition of the sobremesa, this camp recreates that moment after the meal when conversation, music, and laughter keep the table alive. Expect a cozy lounge, tacos from the comal, a communal table that sometimes becomes a dance floor, and plenty of late-night carajillos. Come sit, share stories with strangers, and linger a little longer than you planned.
landmark: shade with treenets and lightnets & Big long table

name: Skyhorse Carousel
description: An amusement ride and a piece of art which celebrates human culture and cosmology from ancient to modern times, creating an experience with aspects of both art and play. The horses of the carousel are painted like figures from myth and legend that relate to the sky, bearing, guiding, and embodying the Sun, Moon, and stars for mortal civilization down below. You might spy one of the fiery steeds from Apollo's solar chariot, the Jade Rabbit in the Moon, or even the Paiute Bighorn who became the North Star. So come take a ride through the sky yourself, and recapture some of the magic and simple delight of childhood.
landmark: carousel

name: Lobe
description: Hypothesis: Scientifically rigorous yet playful participation enhances your burn.Intro: LOBE invites you to experiment with our placebo bar, sci-art and brain-inspired activities.Specific Aims:Aim 1) Are you drunk!? Our speakeasy The Double-Blind Pig serves placebo-controlled refreshments. While you sip, ask the local (inebriated?) scientists all your burning questions (results may vary)Aim 2) Can we tickle your brain!? Play with our interactive neurotech, mind-stretching games, and discover the neuroscience of your favorite drugs!Aim 3) Ready to blow your mind!? We're not just nerds, we're artists too! Study our scientifically inspired pieces co-created by neuroscientists and friends.
landmark: A fully illuminated red LOBE sign and Bedouin Tent

name: Slutt Putt
description: 24-hour Mini-Golf... with a Naughty Twist! Get strokes off your game for committing various 'slutty' acts posted at each our whimsical holes! Swing by the clubhouse for an Arnold Palmer or John Daly during our bar hours, or just relax and enjoy the lounge any time day or night. Innuendo, retina-searing color, and genitalia-themed decor abound. Kindness and consent mandatory-- clothing and class optional.
landmark: Neon putt putt course with blacklights at night.

name: Barbots: Baby Needs A Break
description: Feeling dusty, crooked, or cosmically misaligned? Does Baby Need a Break? The Barbots have you covered. Wander in for pop up bar hours, spa style pampering, karaoke, champagne saber lessons, and our famous Struggle Bus for anyone whose Burn has gone sideways. Recover at Tuesday Bruncho de los Muertos, branch out at Wednesday Cosmic Treehouse Happy Hour, realign your dusty axis at the Day Spa, or bounce through the Cosmic Portal of Doom. Expect strong drinks, shady lounging, and plenty of questionable life decisions.
landmark: Pink BARBOTS flags, Snuggle Dome, and Struggle Bus

name: Chicken Dragon
description: Our camp is home to our mutant vehicle, Chicken Dragon - Hatchery Gone Wrong. Our hatchery has tried to obtain and hatch dragon eggs, but there have been issues, resulting in creatures that look a bit more like chickens. Visitors to our dungeon will see that we are hard at work trying to produce new dragons or chickens, we are not sure what we will get next. Our best hatchling grew large and protects our castle. His fire comes from his comb though, not his mouth. Nothing has gone quite right in the hatchery, but dancing in the dungeon and on the top of the castle will make up for our dragon-less frustration! Our vehicle will be available for exploring, dancing or possibly guest DJing when it is at camp or on the playa.
landmark: Castle with large Chicken Dragon Head

name: Burntown
description: Don't call it a comeback, we been here for years! Burntown is back again ready to ROCK the playa. Come try the Rope Bridge of DEATH. Savor many exotic tobacco and herbal snuff varieties in our SNUFF Emporium. Shop for that special something in our General Store. Relax and enjoy our Art Gallery, which will have all sorts of artwork and guest speakers throughout the week. At Burntown, expect the unexpected!
landmark: 100ft long rope bridge.

name: Honey Puddle
description: Honey Puddle gives you that warm, sweet, exhilarating feeling of being enveloped by love and friendship. And music and mead anddancing and light. We're not a quiet camp, we're not a not-quiet camp. We're just right...and we'll be here when you want us. We fit likewarm pajamas.
landmark: shimmering golden fabric and fire-breathing portal

name: Camp Random Pants
description: Need pants? We got you! Take a pair or leave a pair. Relax in our Dome, grab a drink from the bar and enjoy some tunes. Come by for our 10am morning yodel and mimosa social!
landmark: Large dome with pants!

name: Black Rock Disc Golf Club
description: Black Rock Disc Golf Club has a mushroom-themed disc golf course which embraces fun, games, friendly competition, collaboration, and creativity. We provide a place where folks can join together and throw one of the custom stamped discs loaned out at the camp. You can win one at one of our tournaments or events! The course is accessible 24/7, and discs glow in the dark so don't hesitate to swing by late night/early morning for a round. We also have some mushroom hazards on the course! We have tall ones, small ones, ones that glow, and ones that show you what disc golf is all about. It's definitely a psychedelic experience to walk through, even if you aren't in the mood to play a round. Just make sure to listen for the call of, "FORE!".
landmark: Disc golf baskets, mushroom sculptures, blacklight

name: Bar Mactropolis
description: We are a full-service Bar. All are welcome. In the morning, we serve coffee, extra libation, and blood Mary's! For the rest of the day come by for a blended drink that you can blend with our custom-made blender or enjoy a cocktail or beer. Our music is chill and our bartenders the best!
landmark: Large U Shaped Bar with a Light Canopy

name: ICU:  Impromptu Crafters Union
description: Suffering from crafter withdrawal? Visit the ICU for a daily dose of creativity in the shade, cuz making Art cures what ails ya! Craft offerings change daily.
landmark: Inconvenience Store and Shed with rooftop deck

name: Desert Healers
description: A welcoming sanctuary will provide a great refuge for those seeking to rest, meditate, decompress or rejuvenate.Experience Reiki Sessions with Desert Healers.
landmark: Rumb shape gate with Desert Healers logo

name: Amma
description: Meaning: "Mother", we create and hold space for everyone. This is our offering. A communal oasis. A home. A place to be curious and feel nourished. To reset and share our gifts. All are welcome. All are free. All are one.
landmark: Amma neon lights sign, flags and bedouin tent

name: Hair of the Dog (HOTD)
description: HOTD (Hair Of The Dog) is the longest running bar at Burning Man. We hold a piece of the original fire. HOTD gives raw performances and spontaneous acts and entertainment powered by you! HOTD is a donation bar ran on participation and gifts by burners like you! If you bring the booze and the music, then we supply the music and the booze!
landmark: Large orange letters in the sky: HOTD

name: Tossed and Sauced
description: Tossed and Sauced -- a few tossers and some fun-loving saucers are making pizza. We will have pizza on three scheduled days and a couple of pop-up parties. Bring good vibes and a napkin.
landmark: Large lit Tossed & Sauce sign

name: Camp Equilibrium
description: Equilibrium has been established as a destination to represent the pinnacle for the collective first world culture in which we live: vacation. Adhering to a strict belief that our shared time together should be one of joy and relaxation, we seek to strike the all too difficult balance of hard work and play.It is here that we have constructed a series of spaces and activities to ensure that all who step through our threshold experience the relaxation, camaraderie, and playfulness that we all deserve outside the hectic worlds of which we live the other 51 weeks of the year. "Because it's vacation for fucks sake.".
landmark: Alternating Red and Yellow Flags on the street

name: Lollypopolus
description: Lollypopoluis is a theme camp based in Portland Oregon with campers from Portland, Boise, Montreal, CA and Tokyo Japan. We are focused on Self Care and provide the Self Care Pharmacy for those items you may have forgotten or didn't know you'd need. Join us in the Circus tent for music, food, beverages and connection!
landmark: Giant Circus Tent with Lighthouse beacon on top

name: Yes Please
description: Yes: adv. — Used to express affirmation, agreement, positive affirmation, or consent.Please: adv. — Give pleasure to or to be pleasing to; give satisfaction.Yes Please is the answer to every question. Come chill in our calm and revitalizing sanctuary, dance with new friends, and experience our inclusive oasis of sex-positivity, queer empowerment, and love. Be sure to visit our infamous Non-Monogamy Advice Booth.
landmark: Camp flag/sign, yellow Advice Booth

name: Art Car Camp
description: On Playa since 1994a Place to gather and get your issues resolved To reunite with old friends and make new onesGandhi's Garage for mechanical issuesBarter Bob's Lost Camp Supplies for GearLady LaLaLa for seeing your Tomorrow Today through her many skillsCatch a ride on the Mighty Zenith's little brother TV MV.
landmark: tan dome with Red lit Eagle head on top

name: Twilight language
description: A collective of creators on a mission to realize conceptual visual art and cultivate energy around it. Our passion is to create bold, interactive, innovative, and novel experiences. Or maybe it's just the world's best pizza party...
landmark: Neon, lightning bolt and diamond totem

name: Whynauts
description: Come enjoy our Cosmic Cabana Series (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday Afternoons): Whynauts' signature afternoon oasis sanctuary from the playa's heat. Each day features a unique theme aligned with the Axis Mundi concept - from grounded human connection to celestial artistic offerings. Step into a sanctuary designed to restore and soothe: by being nourished with hand-fed frozen grapes, delicious quesadillas, and refreshing celestial coolers (sparkling lemonades) while forging connections with Whynauts alien hosts and fellow travelers.
landmark: Bright pink neon sign that says "WhyNauts"

name: Astral Outpost
description: Astral Outpost is a place where the ethereal meets the earthly.
landmark: Stretch tent and Astral Outpost neon sign

name: Camp Bare Tentacles
description: We offer a simple mix of bodywork, basic hospitality, and low key communal space. On Monday and Thursday afternoons we serve hot dogs/vegan dogs and easy tropical cocktails, giving neighbors a chill place to pause and refuel. After dark, we maintain a small fire pit where people can gather, warm up, and unwind. We also offer massages on Tuesday and Thursday. Come by anytime and fly one of our kites! Aloha!
landmark: Inflatable tentacle

name: Abstininthe
description: The friendly bar on the playa, providing our special drink to the thirsty of BRC since the last millennium. Come try our many flavors and enjoy the music, ambiance and conversation of our neighborhood bar. Now serving non-alcoholic shrubs.
landmark: Large "Abstininthe" sign, lit at night

name: Amulet
description: Whether you seek magic or inspiration, join us at Camp Amulet for a morning pineapple pancake, and find out where and when our next Amulet pop-up will be. At our Amulet table, you'll be gifted a brass dog tag; pre-stamped with the Burning Man symbol. Our highly skilled Amulet Counselors will guide and inspire you to make your mark, and answer the great pressing questions of your life as you customize your Amulet. Using metal stamping tools you can add names, numbers, symbols, astrological signs, and Viking runes. After you have all the answers, we'll put your Amulet on a necklace, keychain or bracelet for you when you're finished.
landmark: two 15' tall Yellow vertical "Amulet" flags

name: Dome on the Range
description: Yeehaw! We're your Dome away from Home! Slingin' mystery drinks and curious cures for all that ails ya. We're the weird neighborhood waterin' hole you keep comin' back to. Whether just starting your night or wandering your weary way home, come saddle up to the bar; we've got a cure for all that ails ya.
landmark: Black and White Saloon

name: Camp Castaway
description: A welcoming, shaded, interactive neighborhood lounge where participants of all ages can stop in, engage, and connect. Our primary gift to Black Rock City will be freshly prepared micheladas, a traditional Mexican beer cocktail made with beer, savory Bloody-Mary-style mix, and chili-lime salt on the rim. We offer life size games, lively conversation, and will gift Nevada pendants one day during the week.
landmark: Camp Castaway sign, large Castaway box, brown tent

name: Camp Butter
description: Not only a camp of deliquescent souls. It is a movement... a way of sliding through life with a groove at your sails.Equipped with DJ's, Butter-Inspired drinks, and a universal deep desire to churn ~ We're here to spread a simple message..."Talk less, slide more" ~Come see the WORLD'S BIGGEST BUTTER STICK !!
landmark: world's biggest butter stick!

name: Giraffè Caffè
description: We blend the invigorating spirit of Burning Man with the universal love for coffee. Each day, we serve up an eclectic mix of fun, innovative coffee creations that awaken the senses and fuel the soul. From espresso-infused adventures to creamy concoctions that defy the ordinary, our camp is a haven for coffee enthusiasts and curious souls alike. Join us for a cup of joy, connection, and creativity as we celebrate the magic of Burning Man one sip at a time.
landmark: 30 foot LED pole

name: NetsaH
description: Explorers and curious souls, every shared energy is etched into eternity.
landmark: Large structure with a military camouflage roof

name: Dust Circus
description: We are a multicultural and multinational group of people with various backgrounds and lifestyles who decided to create a special space on the Playa. Come to us to have fun and participate in all our activities - Jousting game, New Year celebration, Video-Art Installation. And do not hesitate to hop on our beautiful Mutant Vehicle, the ShroomVroom when you see it gliding on the Playa, let's experience the beauty of the Playa altogether.
landmark: Dust Circus LED Signage, a green beacon at night

name: A-playa-mask
description: Breathe easy with the Maskman's quality N-95 Dusk Masks with the non toxic psychedelic Burning Man logo. And don't forget our Breathe Easy nose plugs, BM Stickers, and Pins.
landmark: The large A-PLAYA-Mask sign

name: ChillVille on the Esplanade
description: A fire-powered bar and gathering space where participants don't just watch the fire — they play with it. Guests can trigger towering bursts at the bar with the push of a button, shape flame through sound with the fire-reactive theremin (Theratiz), and step into the action with the ChillVille Spitfire, a flame photography experience that puts you in the shot. The ChillVillean Man comes to life with operator-triggered bursts, drawing in onlookers. Nearby, the Fire Chandelier offers a constant ambient flame where people gather, warm up, and lose themselves in the experience. DJs, music, and interactive effects create a shared, high-energy fire playground. During the day, a shaded lounge offers workshops, massage, and open space for community-led experiences.
landmark: The ChillVillean Man, 10' steel figure with fire

name: Powerhouse
description: PowerHouse is the on-Playa home of the Sunbelt Rental Power and Heavy Equipment service teams for Burning Man DPW and dozens of Theme Camps.
landmark: Green Shipping Container with Green/Yellow Flag

name: Bungalow
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Bungalow sign and orange velvet couches

name: Through the Looking Gl.ass
description: Ever wondered what it's like inside a colon? Now's your chance. Through the Looking Gl.ass is an immersive, walk-through colon exhibit that takes you on a journey through the human digestive tract - complete with glowing lights, and gurgling sounds. Step inside, walk through, and come out the other end with a new perspective on your gut health. Outside the exhibit, leave a message on our community Gut Feelings wall, take a screening pledge, and grab some cheeky swag. Open 10am to late night all week. No appointment necessary - just walk right in. We promise it won't hurt.
landmark: Large pink inflatable colon structure

name: Gears & Beers
description: If your Art Car, Mutant Vehicle or Mobility device needs repairs, welding or diagnosis, we're your on-playa repair camp happy to try and get you safely burning again!We have a curated inventory of often-needed parts in-stock plus raw materials, specialty tools and field experience, we'll fix your clapped out rig and get you back on playa for everyone to enjoy!Repair Shop is open during build week, Mon/Wed/Thurs. Hours vary and mechanics may be out on field repairs. Walk-in only. No working during drinking hours.Our dive bar serves ice-cold microbrews on tap paired with 80's New Wave music, Bar is typically open afternoons and evenings so please come over for repairs, or a beer... Or both!WE DON'T DO FUCKING BIKES!
landmark: Bright trailer with "Gears & Beers" facing street

name: Juicy Rootz
description: Welcome to Juicy Rootz, where the fruit is juicy, the vibes are juicier. Swing by and meet us, the delightfully playful, slightly unhinged, and always heart-centered Juicies! We're serving up two workshops/parties where you can get your hands sticky making wearable art out of dried, resin-soaked citrus. That's right—your new accessory is made of fruit. Come for the fruit, stay for the unfiltered joy, the spontaneous dance-offs, and when you're dehydrated from all that wiggling, we've got you covered with non-alcoholic electrolyte drinks at our "Juice Bar".
landmark: juicy rootz sign, and faux fruit entrance

name: Sparkle Love
description: Come experience a little Sparkle Love in our beautiful oasis Tiki lounge, enjoy a cold drink and make new friends. We are a colorful and eclectic crew of sex positive, queer friendly, Sparkle Lovers and Burning Man family with an international flair. Cold drinks, hot friends, sexy games, groovy beats, rainbow colors all around.
landmark: Sparkle Love marquee sign, pink and blue fabrics

name: Celestial Bodies
description: For 22 years, Celestial Bodies has been your friendly, all inclusive, gay bar on the playa. Brining you fun, daily events in a welcoming environment.
landmark: Large bar blue walls with space scenes on panels.

name: Cozy Dinosaur
description: A safe and cozy place to party, relax and meet new friends!During the day, come escape the elements in our cozy shade structure where we'll be serving ice cold flavored seltzers. Kick back on our comfy seats, take a moment to reflect, or join one of our talks.Come by in the evening to listen to music and dance at our nightly party.
landmark: Large Bell Tent w/ Dinosaur Sign

name: RedNeck Regal Theatre
description: Total white trash movie nights; complete with our best white sheet hanging for a screen. BYOLC (Bring Your Own Lawn Chair) or blanket. What will be showing? WHO KNOWS? Maybe it's a musical night? Maybe it's a black and white version of Creature from the Black Lagoon? Maybe its cartoons! We make no promises. All we promise is that it's an outdoor community movie screening at its best! If the alcohol kicks in, we may even pass around a microphone and do a BMST3K! Come join us!

name: Camp PlayApology
description: You eff up, we fix it! Black Rock City's first "Custom Apology Delivery Service" offers Playa-friendly flowers, Burner-centric cards & singing "SorryGrams" for BRC residents looking to make playAmends. We also have cards for other occasions. Grab a Sorry Spritz, peruse our catalog and make someone's day cards that say everything from "I'm So Sorry" to "You're Awesome!" and "Happy Burn Mitzvah!".

name: Terrible Turtle
description: A camp at the meeting point of artificial intelligence, creative practice, and the felt sense of being alive. We bring together technologists, artists, and seekers who believe the most interesting questions about AI aren't answered in labs, they're answered in ritual, in conversation, in community. What happens when a machine reads your cards, or a workshop on consciousness runs at noon in the desert? We think something shifts, and the playa is the right place to find out. AI tarot sessions, daily workshops, a live playa podcast, and a participatory art installation open to all of Black Rock City - a long-term experiment in what comes next.
landmark: Tents w/ yellow & purple banners. Turtle flag

name: Roasted Breauxs & Coffee Heauxs

It will be possible for thousands of people to participate. Drawing materials will be provided and stools will be available for young and disabled persons. Come by any time day or night!

name: SonicBoom Saloon

name: SoulSound
description: Step into SoulSound, where rhythm meets ritual and every soul becomes part of the tribe. Guided by sound and spirit, we gather like modern day Vikings around the pulse of music. Move through sound journeys, tribal dance, and moments that awaken something deeper within. This is a space of strength, connection, and shared energy where strangers become family and the beat becomes your compass. Come curious, leave transformed.

name: Kurenivka

Home to the vibrant Blue Bull art car, we bring together Ukrainian cultural energy, welcoming vibes, tea, music, and interactive moments for passersby and participants alike. We aim to create a camp that feels alive, open, and memorable — a place where people can pause, connect, and experience something both playful and meaningful.

name: Cheat Codes

name: RhythmWave
description: Where the dust meets the soul. We provide a 2,000-square-foot barefoot sanctuary dedicated to the art of Conscious Dance. Utilizing a sprung bamboo floor beneath a cooling canopy, we host daily facilitated 'Waves' that invite participants to shed their playa personas and dance their inner truth. This is not a place to be seen; it is a place to be felt. We offer the tools to move through what is stuck, find your center, and return to the city more embodied and alive.

name: Heart Fusion
description: Heart Fusion invites you to step through its pulsating hearts into an LED-lit bell tent of reflection, mindfulness, and wonder each evening. Join us to share a relaxing beverage, and take a break in the immersive LED tent. Daytime activities throughout the week will provide additional spaces to relax under soothing sounds, stretch and recover your body, and create with your fellow BRC citizens in guided craft activities. Come find your connection with others, relaxation in your own mind, and creation with those around you!
landmark: Lit Heart Totems & Bell Tents

name: Black Rock Yearbook
description: Every year at Burning Man, since 2007, we set up a professional shooting gallery and photographers to give out playa names and take your Black Rock Yearbook Photo! Hosting the archive for tens of thousands of Burners online at blackrockyearbook.com.

name: The Astral Social Club
description: A home on the playa for experimental, ambient, acoustic, classical and celestial music. Indulge in our house made elixirs and tinctures at our non-alcoholic bar; let your consciousness slip through our transdimensional portal. Elevate and expand.

name: Soon to be Infamous

name: Team Human Base Camp
description: A far-flung conglomerate of artist, loonies and weirdos from California, Oregon, Texas, Indiana and Australia coming together to provide an interactive and unique space for live music, DJs, performance artist and speakers to share their offerings. name: Best Butt

name: Lituanica Birds
description: We are Lituanica Birds Camp, a community that travels across the ocean to Black Rock City, bringing with us a cascade of ideas, energy, and love. Inspired by the freedom and grace of birds, our camp is a home to the endless journey of exploration. At our core, we believe in the beauty of connection with nature, others, and with oneself. Our camp offers welcoming spaces where every visitor is invited to embark on a personal voyage of discovery. Through a variety of activities and experiences, we encourage everyone to celebrate the natural world, self and each other. Stop by Lituanica Birds Camp to find a community where warmth meets wonder. Here you'll find a sanctuary for reflection, connection, and the shared joy of exploration.
landmark: Bird flying over the camp. Bright in red at night.

name: Lovana
description: Step into a lively corner of Chinese street-food hospitality on playa. Expect rare regional comfort food, shared seating, drinks, and a warm place to pause, gather, and connect with strangers. Draw a Blessing Card, leave a Love Note, and stay a little longer than you planned. Come for the aroma and curiosity, stay for the conversation and human connection.

name: NYC Community Container

name: Sundowners
description: "Sundowners" comes from a South African friendship ritual we host Monday to Friday at sunset. A safari themed art car and a South African shebeen speakeasy anchor our public offering, alongside dance and cultural programming rooted in music, movement, and social exchange. Our creative center is Afrofuturism, imagining a positive and inclusive future through speculative art and technology, reflecting the diverse backgrounds and practices of our community. We see Burning Man, as the planet's largest temporary city, as a fitting context for this expression.

name: The Carrot Club
description: Our camp is focused on health and happiness; health through fresh vegetables and fruits at the Black Rock Farmers Market in the mornings and happiness and festivities at the Carrot Club in the afternoons. Enjoy tasty, fresh produce to feed the body, refresh the spirit, and nourish the soul! One of the best parts of exploring anycity is checking out the farmer's market- and Black Rock City is no exception! Come try one of our wide array of fresh fruitsand veggies!In the afternoons, join us for fresh and icy smoothies (boozy or not) as well as occasional fruit and vegetable-based cocktails at the Carrot Club.

Come hang out at COOLSVILLE.

CMW is ready to greet you with a smile, music, dancing, or maybe just a view of the city from our raised platform. From sunrise to sunset (and beyond), you can almost always pull up a barstool for some friendly conversation, and an ice cold (hard or soft) beverage.

Pay homage to Our Lady of the Shaven Beaver, where you can experience your playa rebirth. climb our tower or use the couch swing, get a faux-scription from our camp 'doctors' for whatever ails you, and visit The Museum of Dildonts (items you don't want to put in your body).
