landmark: 20' tower, couch swing, woman giving birth mural

name: Gianni's Fellas
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Italian Flag, Camp Name Sign and Camp Founder Flag

name: Hippocampus
description: Dust off your goggles and follow the scent of sizzle to Hippocampus, where the griddle is hot and the coffee is bottomless! We're serving up fluffy flapjacks and radical connections to fuel your morning art adventures, so bring a plate and leave with a new playa family. Once the sun climbs high, return for Liquid Courage Karaoke to gift your wildest, dust-filtered vocals to the desert sky. Whether you're flipping cakes or belting out anthems, your participation is the magic that makes this camp come alive. Join us in the dust - where the syrup flows as freely as the songs!
landmark: Giant Seahorses entry gate to shade area

name: Redhanded
description: Has your period caught you red-handed? We've got your back! Stop by our elegant Victorian period lounge for refreshing drinks (N/A options available), and precious period supplies while enjoying fun live events. Got dust in curious places? We'll help you freshen up sustainably. Need extra care? We offer support when you're bleeding or just having a tough day. Oh, and we've got pee funnels, because nothing feels quite as empowering as peeing standing up like a boss. Come sip, vent, and refresh with us at Redhanded!
landmark: White canopy shade with red curtains, wooden sign

name: We < 3 CamPINK!
description: Join in our Family Reunion! We have large yard games for day and night play, Dj sets and our signature CamPINK! Karaoke after dark. Drop by our fabulously monochrome camp and tell us how PINK it is while you play tic-tac-toe, connect4, LED bocce, cornhole or glow Jenga. Or have a fancy cocktail while lounging in a shaded hammock enjoying our hospitality and PINKness. Everyone's a WINNER at CamPINK! Spin the recycle-regifty bin and take home a pink prize, or leave a suitable pink thing for the next playa player. Really feeling the moment, need more PINK in your life? Check out our thread rack to see if there's some new PINK fit waiting for you. We're all FAMILY at HOME on the Playa and everyone is PINK on the inside, right? Come join our Family Reunion in the Dust!
landmark: "camPink!" camp sign

name: Giraffelot
description: Like Lancealot, Camelot, you know?imagine walking through the dusty roads of Black Rock City and coming across a Renaissance Faire? but giraffes.
landmark: 2x big fire-breathing giraffes. and other giraffes

name: Playa Pinups and Fine Art Fatales
description: We are a camp consisting of Photographers, Models, Muscians and Artists dedicated to capturing the beauty and diversity of the citizens of Black Rock City, while offering an opportunity to enhance personal expression through the creation of several types of art.
landmark: Playa Pinup & Fine Art Fatale Photo Gallery Sign

name: Discrace
description: Do you know how much beer can fit inside a frisbee? Join us to find out, play ultimate frisbee, and other fun competitions with fellow burners!Ultimate Frisbee is an inclusive, spirited community based around a self-officiated "sport", with events primarily organized by players themselves and gifting each other silly things. Sure feels a lot like Burning Man to us.We're here to share ultimate frisbee with Burners, and also maybe drink those 54 ounces of beer. See you on the Dusty Disc(o) Playground!
landmark: Playa Name Booth with shade structure & gong stand

name: Armageddon Bike Camp
description: It's not the end of the world, it's the safe word! Think Armageddon for all your bike needs. We've been providing Bike Love Bike Repair on-playa for almost 20 years, and we offer professional bike repair daily. Or fix your own bike at our Public Bike Repair station, 24x7! We also host great parties, don't miss our Wednesday afternoon Alley Cat Race and After Party with Funny Bike Demo! Our well-stocked BoozeBar opens on (polite) demand. Blend yourself a refreshing frozen beverage on our Blender Bike while you're there! Our 28ft dome 'living room' / shade structure provides the perfect hang-out space, no matter the weather. Open to visitors 24x7. Drop in any time!
landmark: 28 ft dome with blue/orange/yellow parachute cover

name: Champagne Lounge
description: Welcome to the Champagne Lounge! Amidst Black Rock City's hustle, our oasis offers luxurious relaxation. Step into our elegantly adorned shade, sip champagne poured by less than knowledgeable bartenders, and recline on plush playa-tech or mingle with fellow Burners. As the sun sets, enjoy twinkling lights and ambient music for a magical atmosphere. Cheers to the extraordinary!
landmark: Large wooden champagne bottle in front of camp

name: Battle Born Burners
description: Come play, drink and lounge with us. The only bar on the playa with Nevada-tude!
landmark: Battle Born Burner Banners

name: Tour de Chance
description: Êtes-vous chanceux? Ride the the Playa's largest French-themed bicycle-powered carnival game for marvelous prizes! But vélo beware, some are risqué.
landmark: Tour De Chance LED sign & 10ft tall roulette wheel

name: Deep Eat
description: Get ready to Deep Eat with delicious food and feast your eyes on Lucifera, while enjoying respite from the playa.
landmark: Giant semi-circular light structure

name: Cloudy AF
description: Feel the thunder as we BUFF and FLOG your muscles at Body Werkz, get foggy in the Steamy AF sauna, get wisped away in our evolving sprinkles of frosty bevies, drift away in a dream in our cloud pit!We are dedicated to raising the hearts, body and souls of the broader Burning Man community through our art, events, and welcoming space. We dew take our fun quite cirrus-ly.It's never been this cool to throw so much shade!!
landmark: Cloudy Sauna

name: Paper Cranes
description: At our camp, we strive to create a home on the playa - a place where our campers feel just as excited to return after a long day as they are to dive into our interactive events. We keep it simple but meaningful: serving up PB&Js, letting our DJs set the vibe, and coming together each night for a family meal you won't want to miss. At the heart of our tradition, we invite visiting burners to write their wishes on paper cranes, which we bring to the Temple - a ritual that embodies the spirit of our community.
landmark: Large LED Paper Cranes sign and a large star tent

name: Abominable Base Camp
description: Home of the Yeti Mob. We host a welcoming base camp for BRC citizens--providing cool daytime vibes and an immersive lit nighttime environment. ABC will have live DJs, parties, workshops, a book nook, and a bar for custom infused vodka tasting. Come get abominable with us.
landmark: Snowglobe entrance with a colorful tree of flags

name: Shangri-Lounge
description: Camp of amazing humans who support the Shangri-Lounge bicycle-drawn mobile martini bar. If you can find us in Deep Playa late at night, we'll serve you the finest cocktail you've ever had while you relax in intimate conversation with new friends under the stars.
landmark: Shangri-Lounge HQ sign

name: A Touchy Subject
description: A shady spot to relax, confess, break the ice, forget about a postcard, meet a friend, or get away. Brought to you by those shady folks who didn't serve waffles.
landmark: Camp Sign: Coffee Cup with rising steam

name: Molotov Cocktail
description: Our shaded bar/chill space offers welcome respite and comfort for the dusty and thirsty.We will be bringing a variety of home brewed and concocted alcoholic beverages for the citizens of Black Rock City.We offer a variety of games including cribbage and ten thousand/farkle.
landmark: Lit up wooden Molotov Cocktail sign up top.

name: Happy Hour
description: Hard day on the playa? Unwind at Happy Hour, where you'll be greeted by one of a kind refreshing spirits served with smiles! Enjoy our lounge, bar, and dance floor! Start your day with Happy Hour!
landmark: Cubish in Front 10x10 room will be on the frontage

name: Chatterbox Camp
description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant cacophony of creativity with the Chatterbox Art Car. This rolling masterpiece serves as a mobile platform for spontaneous conversations, fueled by the energy of the playa. Adorned with mesmerizing humans and pulsating with music, the Chatterbox invites participants to engage in dynamic dialogues, forging connections that transcend boundaries. Join the journey aboard this mobile marvel and experience the magic of community, expression, laughter and exploration!
landmark: Chatterbox Dome with Signage

name: Burnstream Court
description: Burnstream Court is a group of Airstream owners who recreate a 1960s trailer park, Black Rock City style. We almost always have fun daytime events happening that you can join in with. And we give away grilled cheese sandwiches midday M-F.
landmark: 1950s lighthouse beacon high up on a scissor lift

name: Emergence with  Buddha Lounge
description: Facebook Emergenceartcar.
landmark: Buddha Lounge branded logo RV

name: 2 girls 1 camp
description: We're slinging slushies—The No.1 (Yellow) and The No.2 (Brown).Fiber-spiked for flow, booze-spiked for fun.Join us in the Center Camp Oculus for traditional coconut oil wrestling—thumbs welcome, dignity optional, hilarity guaranteed.
landmark: Neon poop emoji

name: The New Barbarians
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Barbarian Tower or Playa Del Soul art car

name: Ignited States
description: Ignited States is all about our states of mind, our states of being, our states of consciousness. It's about lighting up our worlds. It's about igniting and fanning the flames of our creativity. And sometimes, it's about igniting the fire in our bellies with a shot of fireball.- Ignite your artful state by making a flag to illustrate the state you're in - Ignite your wakeful state with beverages and bad advice- Fireball Friday Happy Hour ignites your ready-to-party state- Ignited your playful state with our ring toss game, Heads of State.
landmark: Ring toss game next to the well lit carport

name: Deep C
description: Deep C presents: HypnoDrome — a dazzling 26-foot dome lit by over 25,000 LEDs! Step into the light and get lost in an immersive sea of color, rhythm, and movement. By day, it's a shaded oasis to relax, chill, and connect. By night, it transforms into a vibrant beacon of sound and light—perfect for dancing, lounging, or just being hypnotized by the show. Come drift in the Deep.
landmark: "Deep C" sign and large LED dome

name: Orgy Bus Camp
description: Orgy Bus Camp provides a safe and clean space for play parties on the playa. All of our parties have an opening ceremony where we practice consent and boundaries, as well as a fun and interactive opportunity to meet other guests. Our parties are at 3 PM and 11 PM daily.
landmark: Kissing Booth and the Purple RV

name: Black Rock City Municipal Pool
description: Looking for a place to cool down and relax? The Black Rock City Municipal Pool might be the place for you! There's something for everyone: come by for a refreshment and shady misting during one of our Open Swim sessions, swing through at night for a bit of poolside lounging in peace, or put your dancing boots to good use at our Spring Break party! Access to our Spa is supposed to only be available for members, so stop by our Membership Office and fill out your application. Want to book the pool for your next event? Reach out with a request and let's make a splash together!
landmark: Membership Services office & 16ft towers with sign

name: Palinka Lounge
description: Palinka Lounge offers a welcoming respite for Burners new and old around the globe, we offer a comfortable environment for Burners to take a moment to relax, have a drink, introduce themselves, and learn about what it means to be a burner (or learn about Hungarian burners) gaining from our camp-members Burning Man knowledge. We do this not only through sharing a drink, but also by engaging in activities together such as arts/craft, games or trampoline.
landmark: The large wooden gate and red tent

name: Never Sleep Again
description: Inspired by the vibes of Berlin nightclubs and the global underground party scene, we bring deep, groovy beats to an intimate dance floor enclosed by lush chill spaces with beds, couches, cushions, and pillows for when you need to reset. Drift between dancing, lounging, sharing a drink, playing games, and getting lost in moments with other burners. Our space pulses with sound, curiosity, mischief, and radical self expression. Look a little closer and you'll find our space is full of creative details and hidden surprises waiting to be discovered. Come as you are, stay as long as you like, and get a little weird with us. Always love. Never sleep.
landmark: 6' round LED Infinity Mirror w/4 face profiles

name: SophistaPirate Cove
description: Word travels about a Pirate port on Esplanade, a place the SophistaPirates built when they decided to make something worth staying for.During the day, it's a place to settle in: shaded lounges, games at Kracken's Trap, a stop at Captain Cooks, and stories shared at the Thirsty Pearl.But it doesn't stay quiet for long.By night, the ship wakes up. Music, fire sails, and projection art take over, and the Cove fills with movement.With music, workshops, wandering performers, and 24-hour access, there's always something happening... or about to.
landmark: giant lit wooden camp with 3 fire sail poofers

name: Stardust Lounge
description: Enter an interdimensional portal that leads to a magical experience comprised of love, silliness, and sparkly things! Stardust Lounge is an eclectic pit stop for dusty travelers on their inter-playatary journeys. The three sections of the camp--the Lounge, Spa, and Wedding Chapel--offer visitors a fun blend of rituals, games, and opportunities for self-care.
landmark: Stardust sign, lit at night and glorious by day

name: Halloween Camp
description: Halloween Camp presents brings out the inner child in all of us BOO-urners, taking us back to the delights of that special day, where anybody can be anyone. Stop by our Diskull Lounge for a moment of respite, dance, and connection!
landmark: Bedazzled disco skull on the dancefloor ceiling

name: Cinderbox
description: An art support camp for the Resilience Art Collective. We are part of a HUB with our two dear sister camps, Fingerbang! and Chico Urban Area - come find us for a visit! We are proud recipients of a 2026 BRC Honoraria Grant for our placed art project, Resilience, a larger-than-life flaming tardigrade which will be waiting somewhere on the playa to welcome you!
landmark: Large red and white Fingerbang! flags

name: Society for Temporal Preservation
description: The Society for Temporal Preservation consists of time travelers tasked with preserving the fabric of spacetime. Space time is like a cat though, it takes care of itself. This is good, because now we can leave a bowl of food out and ignore it while we visit Black Rock City. We serve as ambassadors of the temporally free, working to introduce Black Rock City to the magic (science) of time travel.Our goals include:- Exposing burners to the wonders (AND HORRORS!) of time travel- Instilling a sense of hope and responsibility in regards to an individual's place in time- Getting the anti-matter out of the carpet. That stuff is STICKY.
landmark: Blue flags and blue signage, light up bar at night

name: Camp SnuggleFunk
description: Step into a world of pure playa funk, where every moment is infused with vibrant energy and creative flair. This camp offers inviting relaxation zones to unwind and recharge, alongside dynamic dance spaces where funky beats keep spirits soaring. Engage in playful activities ranging from spontaneous art jams to quirky games, all designed to spark imagination and joyful connections. Here, originality is celebrated, boundaries are respected, and everyone is encouraged to let loose and embrace the rhythm of the desert. Join a community dedicated to fun, freedom, and unforgettable experiences under the bright Nevada sun.
landmark: Lg wt party tent Camp SnuggleFunk polar bear sign

name: French Manila
description: Our camp is inspired by the melting pot of different cultures and backgrounds of our camp members who are from America, Canada, France, and the Philippines. Our founding crew met in Manila and San Francisco many years ago and we bonded over art, good food, and exploring these cities together. As our family grows over the years, one thing stays true, on playa we love hosting late afternoon themed happy hour parties with scoops of interactivity mixed in.
landmark: French Manila sign in the front of our camp

name: Good Question
description: What can you expect from our camp? Good Question!Stop by our shady oasis to deepen your connection with your friends and loved ones, or meet a new friend entirely in a cozy, intimate atmosphere. You'll leave feeling more connected to others, and having formed a deeper connection with yourself.Come by in the afternoon when we will be serving tea, Dosas (Indian breakfast like a crepe) and batch tea cocktails, or stop by late at night to warm yourself by the fire. Additionally, we will be hosting 24/7 self-guided deeper connection activities in our cozy frontage. There are no wrong answers, only Good Questions!
landmark: 5x characters: "G", "O", "O", "D", and "?" signage

name: Coffee and Pasties
description: Bringing organic peculator coffee / nitro cold brew back the Playa with great things to add like Whiskey or Irish cream and of course all the colorful pasties! And please come sit by our fire!
landmark: Our gorgeous fire pit out front for all to enjoy!

name: SnowKoanSolar
description: Snow Koan Solar serves snow cones daily, hot dogs very late at night now and then, and provides solar-based power for a number of camps in our HUB. We also have a public charging station where smaller items can be charged.
landmark: Solar Array in front of camp. 100 panels

name: Second Rodeo
description: Howdy, y'all!Second Rodeo welcomes any and all participants to enjoy cheeky and fun rodeo-themed activities, offerings, and wild hoedowns! If it ain't a party you seek, we also specialize in providing self care amenities to those seeking respite.Let us prove to you that this isn't our first rodeo! Come as you are, every one of y'all!Yeeeeehaw!
landmark: Hexagonal shade structure with Second Rodeo signs

name: Camp Tidy
description: Enjoy a proper cuppa at tea time and peruse our extensive collection of literature in the Tea and Porn lounge. Recharge yourself and your devices with our solar powered charging station.
landmark: "Tea and Porn" carport structure on frontage.

name: Alma Borekas
description: Moroccan atmosphere with Middle Eastern influence. Traditional chilling area and an open bar serving signature cocktails from 12 PM to 2 PM. Our legendary Borekas will be served on Tuesday, and mint tea will warm you up at night.Our welcoming seating area is for YOU to relax or go partying, depending on the hour.
landmark: Big white tent with colorfull banners.

name: Flying Pegasus
description: Fulfilling Fanciful Flying Ferry Function (for a Fucked-up Flat-Foot)Wire-art Pegasus 'flying' mutant vehicle presenting in MOBL form providing fanciful transportation and refreshments.
landmark: Wire-art sculptures that are well lit at night.

name: Chain Reaction
description: Bike acting up out on playa? Pull up.We're a laid back bike repair camp helping people get rolling again from 11am to 6pm every day. Flats, loose chains, brakes acting weird, or just need air, we've got you. No appointments, no stress, just swing by.Need a break from the sun? Hang out for a bit, cool down, and kick it with us while we work. Good people, good energy, and a spot to reset before getting back out there.
landmark: Chain Reaction sign and flag

name: The Island
description: A French-speaking camp sharing the spirit of Polynesia at Burning Man. Come discover a warm and relaxing space inspired by Tahiti, with traditional monoï oil massages, cultural touches, and an inviting island atmosphere.

name: Hot Noodz
description: Stop by for diy noodles, possibly leather branding and ink stamping.
landmark: Hot noods banner

name: SolarPlus
description: A free solar-powered community charging lounge offering e-bike, scooter, and device charging to all citizens of Black Rock City. Powered entirely by renewable energy, our shaded lounge is open daily with hosted shifts, welcoming anyone who rolls up with a dead battery. No fees, no VIP access just a genuine gift to keep Black Rock City moving.
landmark: White 10x20ft carport "SolarPlus" sign LED lights

name: Healing Foot Wash Life Truth Love
description: Life, Truth, Love: Come sit under our cooling shade canopy and get your feet washed, dried and moisturized in a tranquil and calming environment. After you have received this gift, you are invited to participate as well. We are actively building world peace and community.
landmark: silver shade structure, blue banner, flag w/ feet

name: Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha Bar
description: Whisky is out- Kombucha is in. The Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha bar is a place to cool down, relax, unwind, and drop in with good conversation and a cold non-alcoholic beverage with your fellow burners. Come with an empty cup and we will fill you up and help you feel at home with the most quaffable drink on playa.
landmark: Field of Mushroom Artwork and Kombucha Sign

name: Illumination Village
description: Illumination Village is an eclectic gathering of camps, held together by history and shared resources. You will find within the village, much like the microcosm of Burning Man, art and interactivity everywhere. Step into a glowing neighborhood where fire, light, music, and human connection collide. By day, find coffee, tea, a public steam bath, workshops, and welcoming spaces to rest, learn, and meet new friends. By night, the frontage ignites into a walk-through Fire Carnival of flame sculptures, interactive art, DJs, and spectacle that runs deep into the night. Dozens of LED installations keep the Village alive until sunrise, making it a beacon visible from across the playa. Come wander, participate, and see what happens when hundreds of creators build one shared world together.
landmark: Lady Liberty Sculpture and Fire

name: Phonic Bloom
description: Join us to experience a sound-reactive light show. Sing, play instruments, or just relax and enjoy a synesthesia-inspired experience in a relaxing and intimate environment.
landmark: geodome with vinyl cover and sign over entrance

name: Burner Buddies
description: We are a relaxed LGBTQI+ camp known for Genital Printmaking based on a traditional Japanese technique, plus throwing some fabulous cocktail parties.
landmark: Metal towers with a disco ball

name: Monkey King Camp
description: A playful cultural playground on the Playa filled with DJ sets, music, interactive art, games, drinks, Asian inspired food gifting, and Monkey King energy. Come explore our Dragon Pillars, catch live sets from DJs and artists on our stage, hang out in our lounge spaces, share tea, snacks, and good vibes, and jump into spontaneous moments of fun with fellow Burners. By day and night, our camp is designed for discovery, connection, and mischief in the spirit of the Monkey King. We are also developing the Monkey King Multiverse, an innovation project with map based camp information to help Burners find camps, connect with each other, and navigate Black Rock City more easily. Come recharge, dance, play, and be part of the adventure.
landmark: Monkey King sculpture & Dragon pillars

name: Camp Synthesis
description: Embodies the melding of three things: Synthesizers, Sake, and Sushi. Here's the concept: People who like producing music with synths, midi instruments, drum machines, etc., hanging out, jamming, teaching others to make music, performing live sets, share Japanese food, and sharing a drink. Daytime events: come jam on synths. Bring a synth or come play around with ours. Following the Food/Bar (takoyaki/soba) nights, we will host DJ sets from global random DJs who don't post their sets on social media. Come train human intelligence with us by generating analog signals.
landmark: Japan + Brazil flags, camp sign with name of camp

name: Black Rock City Shipyard
description: Where good vibes meet great times!Sip cocktails, savor glitzy hot dogs, and sway to groovy beats in a chilled lounge atmosphere. Cruise in, kick back, and let the party float you away.
landmark: white tent with disco balls

name: The Club
description: A Joker-run casino parody where nobody wins money but everyone risks becoming part of the show. Play two games - Twenty One My Ass and Deez Roulette. Bring a joke, a story, or something strange with you. Welcome to a casino run by people who should not run casinos.
landmark: Large elevated LED ace-of-clubs sign

name: Uncle Larry's Misguided Burners
description: Home of KART Radio on 88.3FM! Listen to live music while getting weird on the streets of BRC!
landmark: Janky Carport streetside, Led tower at night

name: Camp Scone Fucker
description: Come get Sconed with us. 9 unique flavors to try throughout the week and ice cold tea to wash it down. All while grooving to our camp DJs R & B, House, Rock, and Lo-Fi beats. Come chill out in the shade with a glass of ice tea or partake in our playground. Maybe we will have a fun surprise or two.. or three?
landmark: Checkerboard scone oven

name: Camp TeaPunk
description: Stop by our Steampunk inspired tea/coffee/cocktail tent and chill for a bit. With victorian furniture, plush rugs, a cuddle puddle, small library and games you're sure to feel welcome as you prop your feet up and relax. Looking for something more upbeat? Our "Teabag Olympics" might be for you. With relay races in high heals, granny panty competitions and other hilarious happenings, you're sure to find fun and laughter, all while listening to an array of DJ beats. Our campers are the family you wish you had, we welcome you to stop in and say hi!
landmark: big sign and bell tent

name: Vivarium
description: Step into a playful, welcoming front porch living room where conversation, comfort, and curiosity come first. Expect a mix of sensory delights, language lessons, music jams, whiskey and bad advice, and late-night grilled cheese hospitality. This is a camp for lingering, laughing, learning something unexpected, and connecting with strangers who may not stay strangers for long. Whether you stop in for a workshop or just need a soft place to land, you are welcome here.
landmark: tall green and blue flags out front

name: Camp Sweaty Betty
description: Can't tell which is dustier - body, mind, or soul? It's probably your hair. Friendly neighborhood hair washing salon - stop in and get yo'self correct head to foot - hell, bring a partner and we can teach them how, too. Plenty of gossip, probably a little therapy.Open Monday - Friday 11:00 am - 3:00 pm.
landmark: Blue dome w/ camp sign

name: Nom De Plume
description: We are a tea lounge that has yerba mate brewing the entire event in our circus tent. Come by to kick it, chill, and lounge. Relax while thriving, and drinking tea. The way life should be. We have a variety of other teas available throughout the week but always have yerba mate brewing. Sit down and hydrate while you start or finish your day. Yerba Mate Dub starts every day at 10:30am. Classic dub sounds from around the world as time turns elastic. Come have some tea.
landmark: White 3 peak circus tent with a red stripe on roof

name: Black Rock Yacht Club
description: We share our love of sailing by offering instruction, and use of our fleet of wind-powered rigs.
landmark: Orange wind sock, Red BRYC banners on tall masts

name: StarFist
description: Infamous international tea service Mon-Sat 2-5pm serving a delightful selection of hot and cold infusions from around the world as we pamper and delight our guests. Offering a refuge from heat and dust, unparalleled hospitality and secret surprises for the lucky few. Morning meditation/yoga sessions most days at 11:11am and our fascinating evening StarFist Lecture Series, exploring a range of thought-provoking topics and stirring debate in our sumptuous StarFist Lounge.
landmark: two containers and flags lining the road

name: Honkers Harbor
description: Calling all curious birds, early risers, and soulful squawkers.If you've been flying solo or searching for your flock, Honkers Harbor might be your next cozy nest.We're a neighborhood sanctuary for honkers, wanderers, and high-flyers - rooted in connection, ease, and a little morning magic.Perch beneath fluttering fabrics. Start your day with a warm breakfast or a hydrating refreshment. Settle into a soundscape that drifts between mellow, mindful, and playful.Come as you are - sleepy, sparkly, or somewhere in between. Stay for connection, conversation, and a place to land before the day takes flight.We invite you to gather, nourish, and share a little magic - one honk at a time.
landmark: Neon Pink LED Sign - Honkers Harbor on it

name: Camp Delicioso & Creperie
description: Hungry! Hung over? You've been hankerin' for something warm in your belly? Swing on by Camp Delicioso and Crêperie, where you'll find an International collective of foodies who'll entertain and serve you the best damn OG French crêpe in Black Rock City. EST 2007 We've got sweet and savory flavors that'll satisfy even the most discerning Playa palate. And while the crêpes are cooking, and the coffee is grinding, we'll serve up a saucy dance music set too! 9ish to noonish Tue, Wed and Thu. If you miss us giving you crêpe, come on over anyway. We have various events happening throughout the week Tue - Fri.
landmark: Giant RED Lampshade that towers over 15ft

name: Camp Byte This
description: This is BYTE's fluffy camp! Come by and dance with us, play on our immersive art, explore our mutant vehicle "Petabyte" and lube up your tappin' toes with our signature drinks at our furiendly bar. Warning: you may receive really cool gifts, hear the best music and feel the furry best vibes!
landmark: 4x4 pink furry cube w/ mirror dome eyeballs

name: Camp Wwit
description: CAMPWWIT is place to ask yourself the question, "Wait, What's In This?" We explore the playa experience through snarky reflection, encouraging internal monologue and external dialogue through games, drinks, and music. With everything going on during the burn, we hope you can reflect on what's going on inside you with others to help bring these playa lessons out into the default world!
landmark: Frontage saying Wait, What's in This and neon sign

name: BRC Ski Resort
description: With great powder comes great responsibility. Black Rock City Ski Resort's EXTRAterrestrial hosts welcome all earthlings to join us for in the apres-ski experience of a lifetime. Send it on the dance floor with Frosty the Snowman Discoball and our iconic DJs, kick it and recharge with a SNOW CONE.
landmark: 40 foot tall SKI RAMP and the GONDOLA

name: Scotch & Hop
description: Oh My Fur & Whiskers! You're late! You're late, for a very important date! Come follow the White Rabbit into our garden, where you can journey down a whimsical Acculturation Path with glowing & mesmerizing flowers & sparkly things. See where the rabbit has gone, Down The Rabbits Hole, to get some enlightenment and inspiration for your life! Enjoy our Tea Party, day or night, where you may encounter some personalities like Queen Elizabeth, Mr. T, Ice-T, or some Tea-Rex's! Who knows?! We offer restorative libations of all types during the day and Hot Toddies to warm you up on your nightly adventures.
