landmark: Glory Hole Wall + Fermented Lawn Gnomes

name: Misters & Sisters
description: We are a fun daytime camp, offering two main activities, 1) overhead water misters, accessible all week from dawn to dusk, operated by staff or self-service, and, 2) a DIY Essential Oil body spray activity from noon to 3 p.m. Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday (with Friday as backup for bad weather).  We have 26 different essential oils to choose from and will show you how to mix base, medium and top notes to create your own fragrance. Our oils are therapeutic grade.  Give your senses a spa treatment!
landmark: Misters & Sisters sign and overhead water misters

name: Cinematic Regrets
description: Step into an immersive, fully enclosed space-themed cinema where the playa disappears and the cosmos begins. After sunset, we screen iconic sci-fi films paired with thoughtfully curated popcorn and cocktails inspired by each film. Come dressed for the galaxy or barrow from our costume closet to ear your ticket and join the experience.
landmark: Large hanging camp name sign in LED.

name: Freeloader Pizza Kitchen
description: Freeloader Pizza Kitchen (FPK) is a small art effort that emphasizes high quality coal fired pizza at Burning Man. At FPK, we love fostering a sense of community by sharing and making pizza with intention. Our ethos is that good things happen when you put in hard and heartfelt work. But it doesn't always turn out the way you planned and sometimes things get burnt!
landmark: Freeloader Pizza Kitchen sign. "FPK"

name: Mad Tea(se) Party
description: Mad Tea(se) Party is a circusy sound camp and interactive lounge. We offer Victorian era living room ambiance, nightly tea service, yoga/acroyoga workshops and more! Since 2019, Mad Tea(se) has hosted it's flagship Wednesday evening Cabaret Show under its iconic, striped circus tent.
landmark: Red & White Circus Tent & Mad Tea(se) Sign

name: Mobility Camp
description: We offer Oh Shiny! Tours for anyone who wants to get out and explore the incredible art. We give priority to people with physical disabilities. We also provide crutches and wheelchairs for anyone who gets injured on the playa. Public charging station for Medical Equipment. Stop by and check out our obstacle course!
landmark: Crutch Sunburst with silhouettes of disabled Man.

name: Camp Just Ahead
description: Come spin our big WHEEL OF INDETERMINATE IMMEDIACY to choose a short, fun activity to do with us!These activities create will human connection, encourage radical self-expression, and send you away with a smile. Some are silly playa games, others could be mildly naughty, and others are thoughtful conversation-starters. All can be adapted as needed for age, ability, etc. We will also (with consent) gift some photos of the fun too, delivered in a private online gallery afterward.Activities will be updated through the day and across the week, so come by more than once!Afternoons Mon-Fri, see our site for details!
landmark: monkey hut and the big spinning wheel

name: Luminos
description: Come make a gourd lantern with us! We provide the gourds, tools, and know-how to help you make a beautiful gourd lantern that you can take home with you.
landmark: 30 foot dome with gourds hanging outside of it.

name: Titicaca
description: Come and join us on the mystical shores of the exotic Lake Titicaca and enjoy our mountain hospitality.
landmark: Giant black circus tent with all the scooters

name: The GASS Co.
description: A camp of artists and fabricators quietly (and sometimes not quietly) building something strange and wonderful for deep playa.
landmark: White billowy shade structure with white camo net

name: DayCare
description: Burn Scouts are the OG rad scouts, sometimes audacious, always fun, lovable and welcoming. Scouts honor!
landmark: Baby Strollers Parked Out Front

name: Rippers Row
hometown: Austin, New York, Los Angeles, Dallas, Miami
description: A high-energy music and dance theme camp bringing the heat from sundown to sunrise. Based out of Austin, TX, we host DJs and artists from around the world on a proper dance floor built for one thing: getting loose with strangers who are about to become your people. Each event is a full production experience with sound and lights worthy of the playa. Whether you stumble in deep in the night or catch the sun cracking over the mountains at one of our morning sets, Rippers Row will be ready for you. Home of the mythical GatorWalrus. Long May They Reign!
landmark: Tunnel entrance with RIPPERS ROW in LED letters

name: Kosmik Dust
description: Please stop by and play Fire Skee Ball! with your friends and campmates! Check out our other technological interactivities such as our High Striker and Theramyd. Take a spin on our Tipsey Totter and Merry-Go-Round!
landmark: Illuminated orange Kosmik Dust rotating star sign

name: Kinsey Walhberg Field Lab
description: Welcome to the Kinsey Walhberg Field Lab. This groundbreaking camp, developed by the esteemed Lindsey Kinsey and Remy Walhberg, stands at the vanguard of art analysis, offering training for those interested in their unique and comprehensive framework that transcends conventional critique methodologies. Enter KWASI-3. KWASI-3 is not just an assessment tool; it is a revolution in understanding art. Our instrument delves deep into the realms of artistic creation, exploring various dimensions such as Dimensional Topology, Activation Shape, and Materiality. This multidisciplinary approach allows for a holistic understanding of art, enabling critics, artists, and enthusiasts to engage with artworks on a deeper, more meaningful level.
landmark: Kinsey Walhberg metal sign

name: Hyperspace
description: We are a small LGBTQ camp that loves volunteering our time with different Burning Man departments. We were previously known for UFO lounger pods and blacklight minigolf.
landmark: green and orange HYPERSPACE sign

name: Swirl Support
description: Basecamp / garage for Chosen Yogurt.
landmark: A Pink Swirl Support Sign, or Chosen Yogurt

name: Enchanted Booty Forest
description: We love hearing that we're the most welcoming camp on playa, and we hear it a lot! We offer whatever our campers feel called to offer, so it's an eclectic mix of things including workshops, grilled cheese, dance parties, mini golf, and more. Come visit us, but be warned you might never want to leave...
landmark: Large Aluminet Shade Structure supported by Truss

name: Kaleidoscope
description: Step into a world of color and indulge your caffeine addictions at Kaleidoscope, where we bring people together over exquisite single origin coffee sourced and roasted by our campmates, prepared and brewed in front of you at our bar, one cup at a time. Our vibrant, welcoming space adorned with low tables, cushions, and ambient music, invites you to slow down, savor the moment, and encourages you to engage in meaningful conversations with your fellow Burners.Finally, don't miss the opportunity to climb our iconic 26 ft crow's nest lookout tower. This unique structure offers a high vantage point to take in the sights and sounds of Black Rock City.
landmark: Moroccan 50ft wide cafe tent and 27 ft tall tower

name: Dusty Dillas
description: Experience the Wild Wild West at Dusty Dillas, a Western themed bar and quesadilla saloon. Here you'll find comfort in assless chaps, refreshing libations, and some cheesy goodness. Come on down for a dusty good time and a chance to spin the wheel to determine your luck in the dust.
landmark: Saloon doors & Dusty Dillas signs

name: Pepperland
description: Pepperland is your Playa home for the newbie and the veteran.We are a mellow camp with a Beatles vibe that will send you on a Magical Mystery Tour.We have a lot of workshops we do in camp, so many to choose from! You can also just stop by and relax in the Octopus's Garden and chill out!
landmark: Yellow Submarine Flag Large brown inflated Walrus

name: Playa Glass
description: Would you like to make jewelry from the playa dust? Grab a pair of welding goggles and harness the energy of the sun to melt the playa into glass. We provide the instructions, tools, and supplies, you cast your artistic aspirations into glass.
landmark: Metal 'Playa Glass' letters signs and white tent

name: Homeslice
description: Drop in for a cheerful "Slice of Home" - Playa-style. Participate in our Experimental Grilled Cheese Theatre, climb the sky-high HomeSlice Tower's inverted pyramids, or re-engineer your Playa duds and gear at our Radical Alteration clinics.
landmark: 30-foot hourglass-shaped wooden climbing tower

name: Zazen
description: Come by and relax in our shade, race our slalom course, and grab a cup of Elvis Espresso every morning. We are a open and welcoming camp excited to meet new and old burners and share the magic of Black Rock together!
landmark: Large illuminated archway says Zazen at top

name: Skrambles**!*
description: Born from chaos and tempered by confusion, now a respectable bar and lounge! Home of the best Bloody Mary on playa (accepting all challengers) and the shrine to Elijah Wood.
landmark: palm trees

name: Awkward & Tawdry Lounge
description: Part bar. Part lounge. Part sing. Part dance. Part chill. Part Shoot Your Balls Off. 100% Awkward & Tawdry.
landmark: Starlit Bar and Shoot Your Balls Off

name: plop!
description: Welcome to our wild and whimsical dancefloor in the shade, where the vibes are as sexy as they are hilarious! Picture a vibrant space filled with young, adventurous souls ready to unleash their inner party animal. plop! is a playground of creativity, featuring DJs spinning the hottest house & techno beats that will keep you dancing until the sun goes down.Costumes are a must here - think playful, provocative, and downright outrageous! Whether you're rocking pasties, neon tutus, or something kinkier, you'll fit right in. Join us for one of our daytime dance parties or evening happyhours filled with laughter, freedom, and a sprinkle of mischief. This is the place to let loose, connect with like-minded individuals, and make memories you won't remember.
landmark: Huge LIQUOR sign

name: Groove Oasis
description: Groove Oasis is your refuge in the dusty desert to rest or move your body. We are hosting dance workshops and parties throughout the week so check the playa schedule and come get your groove on!
landmark: "Neon" Lotus Heart Logo Sign

name: Siren's Cove
description: A veteran group of Burning Man friends that have gathered over the years. We have been on many adventures across the world to Rejoice in the wondrous village that is created annually in the high desert dry lake bed.A bunch of Land lubbing Unicorn, Pony lovers and for Water lovers, Mermaids and Aquatic animals.
landmark: Sirens Cove surfboard Sign , and unicorns

name: Mutant Ninja Burners
description: Are you looking for a place to kick up your dusty boots or maybe somewhere to warm up during the cold night? At Mutant Ninja Burners when you cross our sewer rat picket fence you're one of us! Don a headband, dance and groove to some wubs. Learn some sick nunchuck skillz. Warm yourself by the fire pits. You'll be rewarded with friendship, acceptance and a hot slice of pizza if you come by during one of our wubby, dubby pizza parties. Cowabunga!
landmark: white and red checkered table cloths, sewer rats

name: Zeniza
description: A warm pocket of ritual, music, and hospitality where strangers become companions. By day, we gather for mate ceremonies and guided mezcal tastings rooted in storytelling, curiosity, and connection. By night, we open the space for shared celebration with music, food, drinks, and a welcoming energy that invites people to linger. Come by to reset, connect, and leave with a new story.
landmark: White neon sign "Zeniza"

name: Matcha Mama
description: A daytime oasis serving handcrafted matcha lattes and meaningful connection. Stop by for a refreshing drink made to order, then settle into our shaded "Spill the Tea" lounge for conversation, reflection, or simply a moment of rest. With rotating flavors and a calm, welcoming atmosphere, this is a space to slow down and be present. Whether you stay briefly or linger a while, you're invited to connect in whatever way feels right.
landmark: Green-lit matcha bar with Matcha Mama sign

name: LEGENDARY Playground of the Gods
description: The Legendary Playground of the Gods is a place for learning, authentic connection, and celebrating life. This is a place to remember that we are all Divine, Infinite & Immortal beings simply wearing the disguise of being human. Come and find an oasis from the desert, find rest in the shade, get frozen treats and feast on a week of inspired offerings in workshops, classes, music, and entertainment designed to feed your soul. Welcome Home.
landmark: Big Colorful Dome

name: Astral Lab
description: Enjoy a different sound on the playa this year. Immerse yourself in psychedelic trance soundscapes that blur the lines of party and ceremony. Astral Project with us in our interactive musical playground. All beings, All hours, All welcome.
landmark: Red Dragon Fire Shade Structure and Goa Gil Alter

name: Sakenoma
description: High class lounge with bowling (leave your pedo billionaires at home). Providing a 4 star SAKE experience.
landmark: Tori gate, blue Growers semi with sign

name: NYC Deli
description: NYC Deli will be be serving Seinfeld-esque laughs and scrumptious New York Deli breakfast food 10am-12pm Monday through Saturday during the Burn. Bacon Egg and Cheese is most popular but we also have vegan, veggie, kosher and gluten Free breakfast sandwich options too! Coffee and water served. Like last year: there is an air conditioned public picnic area to enjoy your meal! In addition to the food: NYC Deli also offers Siberia! Siberia is a 100-person public cooling center kept at 70 degrees 10am-5pm Monday through Saturday. Most burners use it to sleep or quietly socialize. There is no programming: just ocean noise playing over a speaker. Ice is available! Siberia is NYC Deli's response to 2022's 104 degree heat.Please stop by! ???????
landmark: NYC Deli Rats & Banners

name: Janky Barge
description: Janky Barge is an art car and all the people who made it. We cruise around the desert and have fun and play music we like. You should get on! We'll give you a ride to wherever we were already going.
landmark: U-Shaped Shade Structure with Tan Shade Cloth

name: Camp Fucking Magical
description: Nestled in the quiet city street, our cozy camp is a haven of relaxation and connection. At its center, a giant cuddle pit swing invites visitors to sink into plush cushions and gently sway under the open sky, offering a peaceful escape from the noise and hustle of the outer city. Nearby, an enchanting bar glows with soft, colorful lights, serving drinks and innovative food delights. The camp's serene atmosphere, combined with its playful elements, creates a perfect spot for relaxation, laughter, and meaningful connections.
landmark: CAMP FUCKING MAGICAL on the bar and trampoline

name: Book Club
description: Book Club is proud to open its doors to serve the citizens of Black Rock City. Join us in the evening for shenanigans, whimsy, and the slowest service you'll find on any side of the playa. Bring a book, read one of ours and get comfy for a while.
landmark: A series of roughwood a-frame structures

name: Hodge Podge
description: Hodge Podge - Come chill in our cafe. Come sip on espresso drink! Bring your own milk and we will make you a latte. Sporadic horse racing, doodling, and poetry fights.
landmark: Wooden Deck with sleepy eyes on the leftside

name: Camp Darling
description: Our camp's mission and mantra is to provide a space for decadent, wine-soaked, slightly feral joy. Come enjoy allergen-friendly charcuterie and wine in our shaded picnic space while connecting, sharing stories, enjoying the sunset with old and/or new friends, and keeping it gay. A bacchanal of frivolity, deliciousness, and delight. It's camp, darling.
landmark: Irish flag, pride flag, and Camp Darling sign

name: Joie de Vivre
description: At Joie de Vivre, we're all about bringing the joy — even when the dust is thick and the tacos are hotter than the weather. Swing by in the morning for a rotating mix of movement, writing, or a card reading. Stick around for Taco Tuesday (yes, it's real), and spin the Wheel of Feels — our 24/7 interactive art piece — for a little unexpected magic.
landmark: Joie de Vivre arch

name: Cosmic Llama
description: The Cosmic Llama Guardians are sworn to protect the ancient secrets of the Dali Llama lineage. The Cosmic Llamas have been charged with creating the highest vibrations of Harmony & Resonance?Without our camp offering beats, music, rhythmic dance (and llama puns)?the Cosmos would fall dangerously out of balance! In the whimsical world of Cosmic Llamas, every step resonates with rhythm, every word hums with harmony, and every heart pulsates with cosmic frequencies. Together we weave the melodies of unity and vibrations of joy that reach the farthest corners of the cosmos, one llama leap at a time!
landmark: bright colored flags and the Cosmic Llama archway

name: Uli Baba & the Horny Thieves
description: The Finest Flesh Market in Black Rock City! In addition to the Ten Principles, our guiding inspiration is hospitality. We are always honored to serve our guests, even while subjecting them to cruel humiliation, voluntary servitude, and wanton drunkenness. Our gorgeous Moroccan tent is lushly furnished with wall-to-wall rugs, benches, and more pillows than you can count. Ours is a hard-working group of camp mates who come together to create a Moroccan oasis in Black Rock City. Auctions always Tuesday through Thursday at 2pm!
landmark: Moroccan tent; Uli Baba's sign; painted camels

name: fruitPOP
description: Founded in 2019, fruitPOP is a LGBTQ-centered theme camp dedicated to radical self-expression, inclusivity, and pure, unfiltered queer joy. We create a vibrant, consent-driven space where playful absurdity meets delightful connection. Whether you're a longtime fruity member or a first-time guest, you're part of our ever-evolving, radically welcoming community. Join us, participate, and let's make magic together on the playa!
landmark: Neon décor, fruit lights & underwear chandelier

name: Shitty Wood
description: We (sometimes) have wood. We burn. Established 2007.
landmark: Silver tarped 10x20 structure right along the road

name: Next Year on Luna
description: We explore the question: as the shifting systems around us shape our experiences and our lives, what does it mean to maintain our essential humanity and ultimately to remain, or become, ourselves?
landmark: 24' geodesic sphere; sea serpent+lighthouse mural

name: Snack Shack
description: Home of The World Famous Black Rock City Hotdog Eating Contest. Floggin' and Doggin' since 2022.
landmark: Snack Shack sign

name: PlovKraft
description: We cook delicious PLOV and serve it together with crazy music on the UFO stage!
landmark: Big PLOVKRAFT sign

name: Nudibranch
description: Mutant vehicle support camp with radical inclusion in mind.
landmark: a sign that says "nudibranch"

name: Pink Heart
description: Pink Heart welcomes all Burners with open arms and open hearts! Whether you're seeking refreshment, connection, or a moment of reflection, our camp is here to nourish your body, mind, and spirit. Rehydrate with ice-cold water, indulge in our beloved vegan coconut ice cream (served Tuesday and Wednesday from 1—4 PM), or unwind with soothing buffer massages at our Vibration Station.Find your way home through our iconic Pink Heart Arch Beacon, or rest in our lush pink cocoon of shade, complete with soft fur couches and welcoming smiles. Share your journey, process your transformation, or simply bask in the beauty of Black Rock City from our vibrant lounge. This is your space to pause, connect, and be seen.
landmark: Pink fur couches & glowing pink heart arch beacon

name: Harmonic Convergence Camp
description: Come by for our Welcome Pumaccinos on Monday or Farewell Pumaccinos after the Temple Burn. And if you're looking for a good party before the Man Burn, then stop by our College Football Tailgate & Viewing Party. And we will do Group Hands-On Energy Healings on Tuesday and Thursday mornings...we can teach you how to do it.
landmark: camp sign

name: MindShark
description: Stay out of Mindshark, we're glad to have you! We serve questionable drinks with confidence, blast music you didn't ask for, and light up the night with fire and LED absurdity. While you are staying out of MindShark you may participate and spectate as brave souls attempt our infamous bar games, flow with our LED dome, or trigger columns of flames to the beat of the music. Equal parts bar, art piece, and bad decision factory?this is MindShark. Enter freely. Leave slightly worse.
landmark: giant flaming sign that says MindShark

name: Atlantis
description: Returning from the dust with mezcal, myth, and music. Our lounge is open 24/7. Two DJ parties to incite dance rituals. By day: tea, meditation, and rest. By night: light, rhythm, and strange delights. Come curious. Stay so long that you forget why you came.
landmark: just look for the 7 foot tall disco trident

name: Do Baskets Dream
description: We are the art support camp for the "Do Baskets Dream on Shore or Sea" art piece on playa!
landmark: 50 ft white stretch tent (Kaleidoscope Cafe)

name: The Pleasure Dairy
description: Finally, what you've been waiting for! A Burning Man Camp that reimagines the little-known historic phenomenon of pleasure dairies! Think Marie Antoinette but in the Wild West. A place where you can never have too many cows or cow puns. At high noon be udderly refreshed by dairy-alternative craft cocktails at our bar, The Tits, and spend some time in the shade nourishing your connections at our message-in-a-bottle service. After sundown, explore our LED cactus garden and kick up your boots in our cozy lounge. Moo-la-la!
landmark: cacti, western fences, & pink saddled cow

name: Camp Seem to Leave
description: Your sticky home away from home. We humbly welcome you, and the dusty pile of tetanus you rode in on. Drop by for a life-changing cocktail & leave with a side quest.
landmark: colorful geodesic hammocks out front.

name: My Favorite Things
description: When the dust hits, we turn to our favorite things?cooling, comforting, and slightly questionable. Stop by for a reset, a little delight, and maybe something you'll pretend you didn't love as much as you did.
landmark: 3 gates, middle one says: My favorite things

name: Drink and Drive-In
description: At our camp we condone drinking and driving-in to enjoy a movie and a drink with us! We have chairs, and games, and whit. If you've got nothing else to do, and you've had a few too many, PULL UP.
landmark: Big blue lockers with a lady body on top.

name: Nipple Crime
description: Nipple crime is a Reno based theme camp dedicated to memorable experiences. Come have a drink at our extensive home-brewed bar. Friday's Sensual Hotdog eating contest is our biggest event and won't disappoint. We are mostly a day camp but often have small parties well into the morning.
landmark: Red and white

name: Venice Red Light
description: A roaming tribe of artists, musicians, and delightful weirdos building a playground of sound, art, and human connection. From deep sonic journeys in our dome to unexpected encounters in our lounge, we create a space where strangers become friends (or lovers) and nights stretch into sunrise.
landmark: Dome with a red V on top

name: Shuttlecocks
description: We're bringing Badminton back. Our playa court is open from 3pm into the evening from Monday to Thursday for pick up play. Come on by, grab a racquet and have a go! Don't miss our Tuesday BADminton cheeky happy hour at the Outer Lounge and Thursday evening tournament where you can challenge your fellow burners. Whether you're showing off your killer smash, whacking a few birdies, or relaxing with a refreshing Pimms cup and a cool misting, there's something for everyone.
landmark: Disco shuttlecock sculpture and badminton court

name: Jail of Hedone
description: A lush red lounge and stage devoted to Hedone, the Goddess of Sensual Pleasure. Guests are "charged" with ridiculous crimes, tried in a theatrical court, and sentenced to spin our giant Wheel of Fate for playful, consensual "punishments". Expect the finest DJs, engaging theatrical performances, a misted dance floor, along with a stripper pole, a comfy sea of couches and pillows, and a bar serving ice water, refreshing cocktails, and horseradish?infused vodka, 4?7 pm daily.
landmark: Lit Greek temple w/ camp flag

name: Kidsville
hometown: Kidsville honestly does not have a home town.  We started on playa with families from all over.  We are truly from everywhere, however if we have to pick a hometown: Our Mayor is from Austin, TX.
description: Kidsville is a playful family village where young Burners and their grownups can find adventure, community, and a touch of magic on playa. With trampolines, playgrounds, kid friendly treats, daily activities, and plenty of opportunities for fun, Kidsville is a welcoming home for families with Burners under 18.
landmark: Rainbow Flags around the camp

name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience
description: VICE is an all inclusive, lgbtq-centric Burning Man Theme Camp returning for the 24th consecutive year to offer cool icy beverages during the heat of the day as well as several other activities for our fellow participants. We encourage diversity, participation, and acceptance and welcome new members from all locales and walks of life.
landmark: a large bus with VICE on top + big inflatable cups

name: NumbSkulls
description: Support camp for NumbSkull.
landmark: Lit "NumbSkulls" sign

name: Drawn Inn
description: Drawn Inn is a studio space and lounge where you are both the artist, and the art. Come flex those artistic muscles at our Figure Drawing classes and even try your hand at being one of our models! We will have open studio hours. And, themed events where we offer whimsical props, body paint and creative atmosphere to help you become your most inspired self.
landmark: Large bell tents with amber light and flowy fabric

name: Rabbit Hole
description: It's whatever you want it to be!
landmark: Illuminated rabbit curiously perched in front

name: dust & stars
description: WE WELCOME ALL WHO DARE. this is dust & star's twelfth year as a theme cult. that's right: we're a cult. since the dawn of us, we've donned black robes and warned other burners the endless night was on its way. to tell you the truth, we're starting to think the night not actually be endless. ln fact, the horizon is getting brighter...and from what we've glimpsed, there's a breathtaking new dawn on the other side. literally breathtaking, and shiny. blinding, even.
landmark: twin neon beacons and twinkly stars

name: Maison Phi
description: Maison Phi is your beautifully chaotic oasis in the dust where hydration, pancakes, yoga, and late-night dance floors all coexist in perfect imbalance.By day, come get revived at our Cucumber Water Station, reset with yoga, cool off with popsicles, or hang at our card games and pancake mornings.By evening, we serve up our iconic Dirty Chicken Martini Soup and roll out for golden hour art car rides with Fibonacci, our spiral-powered art car and cosmic counterpart?because Maison Phi and Fibonacci are two sides of the same frequency.By night, Phi Frequency takes over, music, movement, and connection under the stars.The House of Balance, Growth, and Natural Harmony and a bit of Chaos!
landmark: A bunch of LED lights with the symbol of Phi!

name: Mystopia
description: Step out of the sun-scorched wonderland into our cool haven. It's an icy oasis, an ice cream paradise, and a sanctuary for all. We welcome everyone: friends, partners, parents, children, individuals of any race, orientation and identity. Stop by our burner family and experience the rainbow of diversity. Come play with us, sit down and watch some drag/burlesque, dance with a stranger or simply relax on bean bags surrounded by refreshing mist.
landmark: Large Rainbow Sign under large circus tents

name: Hotel Lobby
description: With a lavish chandelier, bellhop service, concierge desk, a lux hotel bar, and a buzzing karaoke lounge, you'll be treated to 5-star service and a dusty bev in a welcoming and weird Hotel Lobby.
landmark: Large white archway, chandeliers, and neon sign

name: Udder Nonsense
description: Something mysterious has appeared on the playa. A herd of cows, extraterrestrial, or possibly escaped from Fly Ranch, has set up camp, and they want you. Come climb the Milk Tower for panoramic playa views, race mini cow RC cars through our obstacle course, or slip on a pair of cow headphones and lose yourself in the Moo Lounge Rouge silent discow experience. Three times this week we throw our signature Happy Hour Cow Parties: milk-themed drinks, costumed servers, and a cowbell that rings every time someone orders non-dairy. By day look for the giant cow-print dome. By night, follow the glowing cow windsock in the sky. It's a cowspiracy. Have you herd? Come find out.
landmark: cow-print dome and rainbow-lit scaffold tower

name: The Den
description: That magical place where you can explore fun and play, where you can connect deeply with a person and never see them again, where you can talk philosophy, politics, science... or just be horny! In the den, anything can happen if you want it to. Stop on by and hangout at our bar and sample our World Famous Love Puddle Punch, if you are lucky you may get a spanking from our Love Paddle. Or just relax on our comfy couches!
landmark: Blue flag w/ pink heart, wood wall paneling

name: Religious As Fuck
description: A mix of Christian clergy, lay people and friends who want to bring a wide open welcome to BRC citizens, as they wish. Our mission is to offer affirmation, blessing, and spiritual support to Burner folx through Christian sacraments, ritual, prayer and conversation. We provide decomodified and non-judgy Christian spiritual practice and hospitality.
landmark: Religious as Fuck fabric banner & large labyrinth

name: 8-bit Bunny
description: Our steam sauna is open every day. Sweet out the dust and leave cleaner than you have ever been on playa. Feeling adventurous? Spin the wheel at our bar for a drink. Rabbit ears encouraged, but not required.
landmark: Giant pixel bunny

name: MUSE (Maenad University)
description: The Maenad University for the Study of the Esoteric (M.U.S.E.) is a tribute to the deity Dionyus and offers a temple space for offerings as well as for our interactivity which ranges from spiritual to silly. We offer a 24 hour labyrinth for visitors to use as well as a kiosk which will host a variety of camp run and visitor run interactivity. We are a very welcoming group and you are free to say hi and chat with us when we are out and about.
landmark: MUSE sign on RV near back of camp

name: Illuminaughty
description: Look up and follow the LED Ball to Camp Illuminaughty where naughty meets light. Join us on Tuesday and Thursday from 9pm until 2am! DJs will help save your life in front of our brilliant 18' Penrose Tile Wall. Drop by any other time for pictures with the art, perfect shade and drinks from the always going bar!
landmark: Forty foot tower with 8 foot ball of light atop.

name: Black Rock Academy
description: Black Rock Academy is a collective of artists and crafts-people. The collective works together to create art through different mediums year round through community engagement. We are often approached at Camp Black Rock Academy with the question of, "So what do you guys teach?"Personally, I dont think the important question is, "What do you guys teach?" But rather, I would follow up with, "What are you willing to learn?".
landmark: chalkboard that says "black rock academy"

name: It's Only Natural
description: Our camp offers a safe and inclusive environment for individuals wishing to participate in naturism. The space is fully enclosed, shielding participants from cell phones, cameras, and onlookers in the city. Inside, you will find a communal gathering area, with games, music, and a daily cocktail hour. We provide a friendly, non-sexualized setting for anyone wishing to experience nude recreation.
landmark: neon pink "lets get naked" sign

name: The G-Spot & Sloth Sinema
description: Can you find the G-Spot? We are your favorite neighborhood dive bar. Come thirsty, leave happy! New for 2024 we are shifting to an evening offering and opening the Sloth Sinema. Join us for a chill evening of great movies, themed cocktails, and of course, shenanigans! Family-friendly matinees included. Already have plans for the evening? Come by in the morning for "Saturday" morning cartoons and milk and cereal. Just like mom used to make.
landmark: Spinning "G"/Sloth Sinema sign at corner of camp

name: Native Tongues
description: A Native Tongue speaks to the frequency we all share, a common way of communicating with love, empathy & respect. An acknowledgment of the humanity we recognize in each other.And also a kick ass rap collective from the 90's!
landmark: Native Tongues neon sign

name: Owl and the Pussycat
description: We are a small but mighty group of folx whose camp is a safe, welcoming environment for all Burners. We not only value physical comfort as seen by our cozy lounge and dining space, but emotional comfort to promote connection, conversation and reflection with our fellow Burners. We also value a good time! Come by our quiet tea house where you can take pause and meditate. The Owl and the Pussycat is like a warm hug for your Burn.
landmark: Owl and Pussycat flag

name: Last Camp Sitting
description: Is it a porto, is a portal? Only those who look closely will know!
landmark: Elusive Pink Porto

name: Temple Camp
description: We are the support camp for Temple of the Moon, this year's official Burning Man Temple. We are a multinational crew of artists, builders, creators and supporters who have spent all of 2026 bringing this temple to life for our community. We welcome everyone to stop by and learn more about the process of designing and building the temple, and we'd love to hear your thoughts and stories.
landmark: Temple Builders Guild painted 40' trailer

name: A Shack of Sit
description: Do you feel like belting out a karaoke song or letting out your frustrations in our rage cage (uncaged)? Are you looking for a great spot to sit, grab some cold water, and watch the world go by while getting your nails painted, moisturizing your face, and enjoying a percussive massage? Are you looking for the Mensa Camp?Come visit A Shack of Sit; where sit happens. We will be waiting for you in Snowflake Village.
landmark: truss arch, near giant LED snowflake

name: PickleBack Mountain
description: Come by and enjoy our homemade Pickle Back Juice at our Pickle Back Bar. Come through our Saloon Doors in Space, mosey on up to bar, throw down a Pickle Back! Then, for the daring, jump on Gherkin our famous Bucking Pickle for the buck of your life!
landmark: Bucking Pickle

name: Playa Piano Bar and Lounge
description: Playa Piano Bar and Lounge will be featuring live collaborative musical performance along with refreshing beverages every afternoon except Friday and Saturday. Come by Tuesday for Tutu Tuesday Tacos and Tutus from 12-2pmCome by SaturdayFor Pizza Pockets and Music from 12-2Cocoa and music at sunset Monday to Friday at 8 PM.
landmark: Giant dueling piano bar art car.

name: New Desert Outpost
description: We are an eclectic, antique outpost for wanderers and those seeking adventure.
landmark: 3 larger safari tents and tiki lights

name: Stimulation Station
description: Dive into a little oasis for your nervous system at Stimulation Station. Slip on a mask and let the world fade as we guide you Monday through Friday, 12pm to 3pm, through a consent based sensory reset. Expect soothing touch with gentle tools and scratch therapy plus calming soundscapes designed to help you drop in and breathe again. Spot our bold front scaffolding and hot pink Stimulation sign glowing under black lights, then settle into our lounge and neon lit Geodome, open 24 7, to recharge, connect, and tumble into whatever spontaneous magic the night brings.
landmark: Giant HOT Pink "Stimulation Station" Sign!

name: A&mpersand
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: & sign

name: Wok Paper Scissors
description: Welcome to Wok Paper Scissors! Here in Sizzle City you battle for your stir fry. Come one, come all to Wok Paper Scissors, serving stir fry on the playa daily. To get your hands on a bowl of our delicious delights, you must first win a game of rock-paper-scissors! Do you have what it takes when noodles are at stake?
landmark: Chinatown Night Market Stalls

name: Moonlight Collective
description: The Moonlight Collective is part of the Temple Crew hub and will be supporting the Temple of the Moon build. Come visit our bar and have a chat with the Entity. Meet the team that designed the temple this year and share your stories.
landmark: Temple Builders Guild painted 40' trailer

name: Parley
description: Parley is your dedicated conversation camp. Come "Parley" with us during our daily facilitated events or drop in during the day for adhoc conversations on your topic of your choice. Our mission is to facilitate meaningful conversations and bridge gaps between people who might be different from one another. The topics and framing are done in a way that everyone can have an opinion and a voice. During the Parley, ideas and thoughts shall be shared, rapport shall be built and new friends made.
landmark: Lotus belle tent and white flag that says "Parley"

name: Pickle Joint
description: Downtown Black Rock City's favorite magical little hole in the wall. Serving our world famous Pickle-Tini Cocktail since? errp? too long.Let's say well over a decade. Always a sumptuous groove on our dance floor?.or maybe a Led Zeppelin Kazoo orchestra.
landmark: Pickle Sign with circus light bulbs

name: Square One
description: A diverse group united in creating large-scale art through efficient and sustainable designs, inspiring individuals and other camps to burn stronger. Our efficiency-driven approach allows us to contribute more to the community. We modify and use Burning Man?centric shipping containers for our camp activities, including the B&B BBQ and our 35-foot hammock Nest tower. We operate two large art cars: Sparky (Hot Sauce) and Eden. We also provide logistical and power support for various playa art projects.
landmark: 40' shipping containers and a 45' hammock tower

name: Playa Circuit Boogie
description: Here at Playa Circuit Boogie we use circuits and science to spark ideas and bring strangers together, all while jamming out to groovy tunes and enjoying a cold beverage from our bar. Come learn the basics of soldering and circuit building; ride away with your very own light-up pendant and the skills to make an even better one next year. And bring us your broken electronics during repair hours, we'll try our best to get them working.
landmark: Brightly colored triangle flags

name: Hookahdome
description: Enter our silk draped, plush, cushioned, lantern-lit, air-conditioned dome to be whisked away into an oasis from the dust and heat. Let our loving attendants ensure your comfort while we serve you house made organic shisha and tea. Be entertained by a variety of intimate world music and dance performances taking place on the center carpet. Wednesday-Sunday evenings, our outdoor courtyard, illuminated by a ring of torches ignites the dancing flame within us all as world class DJ's, musicians, and performers entertain into the night. Come spin fire or drum at the Fire Flow Jam and Drum Circle, dance the night away to one of our outdoor music and dance performances, and wax philosophical, regale your fellows with your tales, and make friends and lovers for a lifetime inside the Hookahdome!
landmark: Big dome with red hookahdome sign and torch ring

name: Aah Wonder
description: Offers Thai coconut bites (Kanom Krok) and Thai iced tea inspired by our members' favorite experiences traveling around the world. While waiting for your fresh off the griddle treat, step into our shaded lounge space with rugs, pillows, and cool mist fans. There, you can relax and enjoy connecting with new people and playing conversational and hands-on games. All ages welcome!
landmark: Brightly colored Bedouin style tent

name: Camp Safari
description: Determine your fate with a spin of the Safari Wheel. Photo ops, animal hunts, and other dusty games.
landmark: Large animal art pieces, animal fabric flags

name: A Transformation Station
description: Explore, Engage, Evolve: Transformation at A Transformation Station.Step into a space where grounded healing, interactive experiences, and playful experimentation come together. By day, join workshops in breathwork, meditation, movement, and conscious technology, or sign up for one-on-one sessions inside our climate-controlled sanctuary. By night, engage in music, salons, and participatory gatherings that blend introspection with expression.A Transformation Station is designed for those seeking real connection, personal growth, and shared exploration. We offer fewer, more intentional experiences held with care, inviting participants to slow down, tune in, and actively co-create the moment.Come as you are. Leave with something shifted.
landmark: Large, freestanding 'ATS' sign

name: Shoturanga
description: We believe true connectedness isn't found in perfect zen?it's forged in the shaky, sweaty, deeply questionable life choices that happen somewhere between chaturanga and "why is this still plank?" This is yoga for the rest of us: the ones with wandering minds, tight hamstrings, and a running internal monologue that would definitely get us kicked out of a silent retreat. And nothing says connectedness like being gently roasted while your arms tremble. Radical honesty; it's not criticism, if delivered with love. BTW, your hips are sagging, again. Come have some fun. Put on a goat onesie or take a shot. Share the struggle and the miserey. Challenge your balance and your dignity with friends.
landmark: Multicolored camp sign made of block letters

name: Mystic
hometown: Bay Area + Los Angeles CA + Denver, CO + New York, NY
description: Mystic is a legendary theme camp with 20+ years of magic in Black Rock City ? a vibrant sanctuary of interactive art, transcendent music, and soul-expanding workshops.BY DAY: Dive into our Visionary Speaker Series, Healing Modalities, and Mind-Body Workshops inside the iconic Mystic Theater and Mystic Temple.BY NIGHT: Lose yourself in fire dancers, visionary musicians, and boundary-pushing artists at our new Monday Night Celebration Party and legendary Truth & Beauty Wednesday Night Party.Then take it to Deep Playa aboard the Mystic Flyer Experience ? our roving Mutant Vehicle bringing creativity, community, and pure Burning Man wonder wherever it lands.This is your invitation. Come transform with us.
landmark: 16ft LED Arch, CNC Sign, 7x 40' poles wLED ribbon.

name: The Cave
description: To deviate positively is to play with the rules, reimagine the future, build new realities, and break what no longer serves. It starts small: a question, an experiment, a new way of relating - that quietly reorganizes what's possible between us and around us.
landmark: Giant wood structure with cave patterns and cubes

name: The Institute
description: The Institute of higher yearning invites the dusty wanderer to expand their mind into the bottomless pit of knowledge and exploration.
landmark: THE INSTITUTE sign between two geodesic domes

name: Lunar Disco
description: Embrace the cosmic elements in our electrifying dance and party spaces, with interstellar beats and mesmerizing ambience. Connect with fellow stargazers in our ceremonial space, honoring the celestial bodies and the shared human experience. Embark on an otherworldly adventure at Lunar Disco.
landmark: Amazing sparkly camp entrance and sign

name: Havana Nights
description: Experience the essence of a vibrant Latin dance party infused with the relaxed vibe of Miami. Encircled by palm trees, our spacious, shaded dance floor beckons. Relax on our plush, elevated chill pads or sway in hammocks. Savor the night with bottomless, hand-muddled frozen mojitos as world-class DJs deliver an electrifying mix of Cuban and Latin rhythms. Immerse yourself in culture with daily dance lessons and indulge in complimentary cotton candy. Join us on Thursday, from 10 PM to 3 AM, for the iconic 10TH ANNUAL HAVANA NIGHTS, the pinnacle of our week-long dance celebration.
landmark: Palm Trees & 20-ft Lime Green Tent

name: Fauxliage
description: Our fake greenhouse offers a temporary refuge from the harsher elements of the playa. Come take a break in our cool misted space and relax to a nice soundscape. Stick around for some spontaneous DJ sets! At night, look for our 11' LED sign, colorful up lights, silhouetted plants! We'll also have an interactive 20 foot circular LED art piece that has some custom low resolution panels that light up with more participants and pulse to the beat of the music or the movement of the people in the circle.
landmark: FAUXLIAGE sign that is 11 feet long, with LEDs

name: Black Rock Travel Agency
description: The Black Rock Travel Agency is a gang of pilots, aviation enthusiasts, and adventurers who come together every year to serve the airport village and its visitors located at the end of Point5. Yes, there is an airport! BRTA makes it just like you imagine a Burning Man Airport would be. A massive Starport pyramid structure with entertainment and bar underneath with 30 foot viewing platform above? Yes! A super yummy galley serving pancake breakfast and bbq? Yes! Facilitating scenic airplane flights for Burners? Of course! The Agents at the Black Rock Travel Agency are committed to burners having an experience only to be found at the best airport in the world. Start, continue or end your journey with us.
landmark: Starport

name: Ready Playa One
description: A world that we dream up, believe in, and step curiously into, together in Black Rock City. Each day is an adventure to expand our minds, deepen human connection, and creatively challenge the status quo's of the world that we believe in changing.
landmark: The neon lit Asian style Dune meets Mad Max vibes

name: The Fountain (of youth)
description: A longevity-focused camp at BM where we celebrate life and coordinate to fight aging & death.Our gifts to the playa are LongeviTEA, our signature teahouse and the Rejuvenating IV Lounge.We have healthy food (inspired by the blueprint diet), IV hydration raffles, and daily workshops on accelerating longevity, biohacking, wellness, and creating a protopia. Whether you're seeking a soothing cup of LongeviTea or a deep conversation about defying aging and death, The Fountain (of youth) invites you to sip, connect, rehydrate and explore what it means to live vibrantly on the edge of time.
landmark: Fountain (of youth) sign on carports

name: Yellow Balloon
description: A clean and sober camp, offering a space for fun, connection, and wellness without the influence of substances. We host daily AA meetings, wellness events like yoga and breathwork, and interactive art experiences designed to uplift and engage. Our camp is a vibrant community of burners who love to have a great time while staying clean and sober throughout the burn. We welcome all Burners to attend our activities and anyone curious to explore a sober experience to hang out, providing a supportive, inclusive space to thrive. Join us for a unique blend of fun, recovery, and creativity!
landmark: Trampoline, See-Saw and Yellow Balloon signage

name: Dr. Carl's Collection of Depts.
description: Dr. Carl's Collection of Departments returns! Come play our legendary Dept. of Collections game, where we will give you a semi-fabulous prize if you can do, are, or tell us about a thing we list on the board of tiles. Enjoy a homebrew at our Dept. of Dumpster Dive Bar. Learn and play Go in our Dept. of Strategy, enjoy our blacklight Hissing Booth, or let fate decide at our luscious pink Kiss-Met randomizer.
landmark: Walls of tiles, oval sign. Lit up pink and blue.

name: Fun-do Bar
description: Looking to get melty while having a booty shaking good time?! Look no further than Fun-Do Bar! Our delicious Swiss cheese and chocolate fondue paired with ice cold wine is sure to make your taste buds dance! Join us for our dance party happy hour (4p-6p or until we run out!). Our servers will be scantily clad wearing nothing but aprons, so come on down and melt with happiness while shaking your booty to the beats!Soup Sluts will be serving two nights of soup magic for thirsty and hungry Burners. Night 1 (Tues 10p-12a) will be vegan pozole- spiced sauteed jackfruit and hominy, topped with cilantro and lime juice. Night 2 (Thurs 10p-12a) will be vegan tom kha soup.  Nothing like a spicy, hearty and delicious soup to help rejuvenate people for their night out.
landmark: Yellow/Blue Serving Bar labeled with FUN-DO BAR

name: Huǒ Fèng MV Support Camp
description: Hu— Fèng rises as a living embodiment of the phoenix spirit. In Chinese symbolism, the phoenix represents the empress - feminine authority, grace, and sovereign power - while fire embodies transformation and rebirth. Together, Hu— Fèng becomes a vessel for renewal in motion.With sculptural wings reaching skyward and a body glowing like flame, it captures the threshold where destruction gives way to creation. Both delicate and powerful, it moves between elegance and intensity.More than a mutant vehicle, Hu— Fèng is an invocation - a call to rise, shed, and remember the strength within softness. It invites participants into transformation, to embody their sovereignty and emerge luminous, expansive, and new.
landmark: Look for Hu? Fèng rising from the Playa

name: Helioz
description: At Helioz, we worship the Sun god. To honor our god, we roast delicious animals and share them with all guests. Come by in the late afternoon and evening for some tasty treats, and drink a sun-god libation.
landmark: Big HELIOZ sign and bright red/yellow drapery

name: Dreamery
description: Dreamery is a camp to discover, share and experience dreams. It is an interactive space to read and write dreams and fantasies, happy or scary, random and crazy, sensual or sad.What dream would you ask for if you could?If you could go anywhere in a dream, where would it be?At Dreamery, you might also meet someone special. You can see if you want to hang out for just a bit or maybe become lifelong soulmates.Got any bad dreams you want to get rid of? Drop them to the Dreamery Alter to be ceremonially burned at The Temple Burn.Have any happy dreams or exciting tales to tell? Jot them down in The Book of Dreams. Flip through the pages to discover stories and dreams from people from around the world, and you might even find new dreams to call your own.
landmark: DREAMERY roadsign, Star tent, Deep Thought Art Car

name: Serenity Now
description: An oasis in a world of dust. Serenity Now is one of the playa's oldest coffee shops, and for a good reason.
landmark: 24ft diameter aluminet dome with sign in front

name: Giants Workshop Saloon
description: We could be anything—including a dusty saloon run by Giants, come by for our nightly Sunset Socials for a variety of offerings of music, food, and drinks! Our saloon doors are open 24 hours, stop by anytime to see if the bar is open or just to rest your weary boots. A variety of workshops will be happening throughout the week, roll on through and see what we're up to!
landmark: Scaffolding with Giant's Workshop banners (lit)

name: Liquid Spankuary
description: Dusty, parched, and feeling a little too well-behaved? Come get refreshed and red-cheeked at Liquid Spankuary! We're serving up ice-cold, Agua Fresca to cool your core and handmade butt spanks to fire up your afternoon. Choose your flavor and your intensity (from a "love tap" to "full playa-dust cloud"). Our certified Spank-baristas ensure every impact is consensual, respectful, and perfectly timed with your first sip. Come for the hydration, stay for the vibration!
landmark: Look for the stuffed Badger

name: Hard as a Rock
description: A rag-tag bunch of geologists with a passion for sharing geology - including the geology of the Black Rock Desert! Join our geologists for rock talks, get creative with rock painting. Dig up your best rock puns and strike fools gold and other rockin' gifts!
landmark: Turqoise A-frame sign & square labyrinth

name: Cocoon Society
description: A new theme camp operating within the Imagimorphia hub, a returning art support camp. The hub operates under a shared frontage with the Imagimorphia name, and Cocoon Society contributes a transformation-centered public ritual experience as its core offering: the Vinyl Ritual. Participants enter a softened ambient sound environment, choose from pre-made mandala or word/phrase vinyl designs, and slowly peel away the unwanted pieces before transferring the final symbol onto a personal object. The symbolic arc is clear: choose a symbol, peel away what is not needed, imprint what remains. This ties directly into Imagimorphia's metamorphosis theme.
landmark: 40 ft container hung with with UV responsive art

name: Beats 'n Deets
description: Don't lose your shit when you lose your shit. Label it first at Beats 'n Deets. We make labels for all your stuff with a mug shot style photo with you and your camp details on it making it easy for people to return it to you or easy to find at lost and found. And it's a great souvenir. Come join us for drinks in our circus tent with animated projections on the wall and some of the most underrated DJ's on the playa.And debuting this year, The Smile High Club. Towering nearly 20 feet above the Playa, soak in the views-or just be a soak.
landmark: Very large (40 foot) furniture van

name: Baggage Check
description: Check your Emotional Baggage with us. Spend time with us to create a better world for yourself! By writing down your emotional baggage you don't have to carry it with you; use that freed up emotional headspace to cultivate and connect with your future! We'll turn your emotional baggage into ashes and celebrate your newfound self-actualization at the temple burn. Stop by any time of the day or night, lounge in our super comfy dome, treat yourself to our pamper station, get out of the sun, or join a dance party in progress. We have a full slate of events every day - whether it's our Afternoon Oasis Sanctuary, Liquid Alchemy, giant Cuddle Puddle, Consent Workshop, Hypnotising Eye-Gazing Session, or a Topsy Turvy Happy Hour - we have something for you and welcome all with open arms!
landmark: BAGGAGE CHECK marquee and a 25' lit-up checkmark

name: Argonauts
description: Cherish the uncertain, challenge fear, welcome the odd, and seek thyself! The Argonauts bring a unique and infectious spirit which we share across the playa and in conjunction with reenergizing camp activities including our high-noon ArgoDogs. Besides our Argonaut spirit and noontime hot dogs, our gifts include Argonaut dust, sun & fashion bandanas and spiritually-assigned individual Quests for each newly inducted Argonaut for the coming year.
landmark: Bow of our grounded wooden Argo ship and flags

name: Bumblepuss
description: Bumblepuss brings a spa theme to the playa with the addition of the aromatherapy focused Lavender Lounge. Visit and soak in the aromas while you relax in the shade after your Steam Bath from our sister camp.
landmark: steam bath yurt and lavender dome

name: Long Feng Camp
description: Long Feng Sound Camp is a living, breathing immersive soundscape where East meets West in rhythm, ritual, and release.By day, it hums with connection. By night, it ignites. A precision-tuned sound stage draws you into a field of movement and awe, while the Xiao Long Night Market unfolds nearby - a Chinatown dream woven with delights to tickle the senses including games, tea, and unexpected moments of play.This is a place to arrive, to lose yourself, to find each other. Follow the sound and join where East meets West.
landmark: Red neon torii gate with flame towers & stage

name: Roadside Distraction
description: Roll up for a hub of spectacular sidetracks and childlike wonder! With renowned attractions in our Chamber of Wonders, including the soul-searching experience of Burning Man's Darkest Room, fun spins on classic carnival games, and a whimsical Gift Shop, there's something for everyone at Roadside Distraction.
landmark: Structure made of trampolines

name: Stampede!
description: A movement and connection-driven space inviting you off your bike and into the herd. Step into a shaded lounge for yoga, breathwork, and playful, consent-forward interaction. Explore aerial, join spontaneous group moments, or simply land and connect. Come find your stripes.
landmark: Zebra tapestries, 25ft aerial rig, zebra trailer

name: Fomo Playalounge
description: Phasmantis brings snow cones, pop tarts, and dank beats to the playa. Stop by on a hot day and grab a drink and some saucy snow cones to cool off.
landmark: 20x 40 shade/giant green school bus/teeter totter

name: ADHz
description: At its core, ADHz is sound sanctuary built around an Hi-Fi infra-sub audio system tuned down to 19 Hz, wrapped in a cozy & vibrant living-room vibe.DJs/Producers showcase their music through a sound system that produces frequencies which are not just heard, but deeply felt. Settle into deep bass sound baths, watch live painting unfold, or just hang and connect. Everyone is empowered to dance, listen, connect, decompress, and simply be at ADHz!
landmark: 2 x 8ft fire-illuminated pillars that burst fire

name: Opulent Temple
description: Opulent Temple. Sacred Dance to world Class Music.
landmark: Golden Pod booth, 4 large visual screens

name: Entheos Community Village
description: Members of the Entheos Community organize one of the most diverse theme camps placed at the annual Burning Man event in the Black Rock Desert of Nevada. Friends and members of the Entheos Community come from over 43 countries to contribute their effort, skills, and resources to the creation of Entheos @ Burning Man. The camp creates extensive 24/7 interactivity for all ages as a gift to the citizens of Black Rock City, functions as a pilgrimage home for its members, and serves as a nexus to meaningfully connect people from around the world across national, religious, and ideological lines. As part of Entheos' commitment to radical inclusion, we hold a significant portion of our camp capacity open each year to welcome people who are new to Entheos. Come play on the giant Trampoline Arena.
landmark: giant trampoline arena with angled bounce walls.

name: People of Color Camp
description: Bringing COLOR to the playa since 2014!The People of Color Camp is what happens when The Muppet Show gets put in the same telepod as an episode of The Fresh Prince of Bel Air, MTV's The Real World and a debate at the United Nations.We provide opportunity for BIPOC Burners to not only learn about and experience Burning Man, but make it our home. We bring the diversity of our cultures to the playa through events, workshops and simply our presence. We bring our music, our soul, our rhythm, our culture - Unapologetically!We welcome all people of all backgrounds. Stop by! Add some color to your burn! It's always love! :).
landmark: Huge POC sign

name: Bistro Manonio
description: Step inside a small desert bistro where strangers gather around a circular communal table inside a handmade geodesic dome. Inspired by French and Polish traditions, we share simple rustic food, warm drinks, and good conversation with curious wanderers who stop by. Scheduled evenings feature intimate tastings featuring Provençal & Warsawa-inspired flavors. Slow down, connect, and experience the magic of a home cooked meal in Black Rock City at Bistro Manonio.
landmark: Our geodesic dome with our Bistro Manonio signage

name: Solaris
description: Please do not publicly list.
landmark: Paris Metro-style, art deco, solar panel structure

name: Twisted Swan Celtic pub
description: The Twisted Swan and Bacchus! Come for a calm cool after noon or a nice cold pint at night.
landmark: Red door

name: Camp Reno Nation
description: Biggest Little Shit Show On The PlayaGreat beer; Weird PeopleWelcome to the Shit-Rock Saloon V3!
landmark: Reno Nation arch

name: Rubber Armstrong
description: For everything bad, Mezcal, for everything good as well, and if it still does not help, one and a half litres. We are a diverse solar-powered camp made up of members predominantly Aussie but from all over the world, all sharing a love of Mezcal. Join us for a delicious Mezzie Margie from midday to 17:00.
landmark: LED Space Helmet

name: Playa Delicacies Cooking School
description: Playa Delicacies cooking school is an interactive learning experience.
landmark: Playa Delicacies sign, trampoline, green shade

name: Disfunktion
description: Come join in with our wobbly world of Weebles , Music, Fire and MayhemEvenings eclectic music , slushy's, fiery chill out areasMain event Pyjama party with funkiest PJ giveaways and Sounds.
landmark: 2-3 large tripods, flames ,lasers

name: Saints and Sinners
description: Friendly easy-going camp. Kid- and family-friendly button-making and temporary tattoos most mornings. Afternoons offer opportunity to officially divorce an unwanted playa name. Afternoons also offer various adult oriented activities with topics including Shibari rope suspension to presentations on increasing enjoyment of fellatio for both givers and receivers. Someone friendly is hanging out in our street-side shade structure most all the time. Stop in and say "hi!".
landmark: 2 carports w red tarps, lit red; 30' lighted pole

name: Disco Space Shuttle
description: Home of the Disco Space Shuttle Mutant Vehicle and Camp. Board with us at 10pm and take a ride around the Universe and Beyond.
landmark: Disco Space Shuttle MV out front

name: Global Camp
description: Global Camp - Founded in 2018 to support the large amounts of new burners coming from abroad, we come together every year from all over the planet and share in joy, laughter, good times, and share common respect and consent at our home on the Playa. We have many veterans who come back year after year but also we keep the door open to anyone or possibility - If you're a world traveler, internationally minded curious, or want to speak other languages beyond english on playa, then Global Camp may be a good camp fit. We do nightly fun dinners, provide ample shade and structure for everyone to have a burn where they don't burnout.
landmark: Tall purple balinese flags

name: The Sound Garden
description: We are a high vibe sound camp here to delight your senses with a unique 360 degree sound system that will blow your mind. By night we bring you some of the most talented DJ's and artists to create an unforgettable experience of movement, sound and performance. By day we host sound healings, deep house yoga, and listening parties of your favorite artists. We also offer body work, and a few healing workshops in our Garden Lounges.
landmark: Large white tent, elevated "Sound Garden" signage

name: Hack-a-Cola
description: A visit to Hack-a-Cola is a reprieve from the heat empowered by a sampling of a wide variety of unique, handcrafted flavors of soda. Hand us a cup and we'll mix cold carbonated water with one or more of our syrups to make a refreshing soda on the spot. We may even put a scoop of ice cream in your soda to make it a float! We tweak our recipes and invent new flavors throughout the week. Inquisitive visitors can learn how to fulfill their own soda making dreams with the guidance of our knowledgeable, helpful soda jerks. We aim to provide a welcoming space where everyone will feel comfortable to stay a while and enjoy the company under our plentiful shade. You may see our food truck, The Purple People Feeder, in our camp or out and about on the playa.
landmark: red shade, brick wall facade, Hack-a-Cola sign

name: Tetrix Stargazer
description: Home to a bunch of Aussies welcoming you to the humble abode of the Stargazer Artcar. We will be serving up daily disco coffee and snacks from 9am-12pm, so come party with us and then hop aboard the Stargazer Artcar in the evening for a journey out to deep playa from 9pm onwards.
landmark: 4ft wide wooden Tetrix sign

name: T33m0
description: T33MO will get you back on the trackIf your bike is sick, we'll heal it for ya!If you're low on energy, try our refreshing icy slushies while relaxing in our cozy lounge.
