name: Math Camp @ Group W
description: A Safe place to drink and Derive. Share your problems with us.
landmark: 40' tall pyramid with illuminated Pi symbol on top

name: Water Temple
description: Welcome to Water Temple a sanctuary of serenity, connection, and renewal in the heart of the playa. We're a theme camp dedicated to holding space for hydration, healing, and human connection through elemental experiences and desert hospitality.At Water Temple, you'll find:Cold, Kombucha (because hydration is sacred)Guided meditations & sound bathsShade, chill zones, and high-pressure mistingYoga & gentle stretching sessionsWater Temple Speaks- Speaker Series We believe in sacred stillness, playful presence, and radical kindness. Whether you're seeking a soft reset or a moment of peace under the dusty sky, our temple doors are open to you.
landmark: Tipis

name: Mission Country Club
description: Hailing from the sunny Mission District of San Francisco, we invite everyone to enjoy the dusty comforts of our playa outpost. Pull up a bar stool at Flanagan's Pub - open day and night - for a refreshing beverage. Cozy up on one of our couches beneath the ample and breezy shade structure. Let loose on the dance floor. We're a relaxed and fun-loving crowd from all over - San Francisco, Tahoe, Reno, Los Angeles, Washington DC, Boston, New York, Seattle, Portland, Ireland, Germany, Belgium and beyond. Often serving tunes and always serving drink, the Mission Country Club has been calling Black Rock City home since 2004.
landmark: Big "Mission Country Club" banner atop pavilion!

name: Nose Fish
description: Come get coffee from an undisclosed appendage of the Nose Fish itself Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday mornings and stay for the music! This year we're giving away cookies!Bike repair clinics are happening Monday, Tuesday mornings 10:30-12:30 and Thursday afternoon 2-4:30Hella Halo-Halo Thursday 2-4:30 during bike repair - come get a refreshing Filipino shave ice treat! Don't forget your cup or bowl!Electronics Repair M-F 2:00 - 4:30 personal lighting repair/tutoringSewing repair service M, T, Th, & F 2:00 - 4:30: come darn your dazzling duds with our resident seamster/seamstress at our super sewing service!
landmark: NOSE FISH sign, LED lights on curb, snow fence

name: Jungle Oddity
description: A jungle oasis lost in time and space. Stop by to experience our lush soundscapes with musical performances and engaging daily workshops.
landmark: Circular camp sign and geometric star fire pit

name: BigFrankEnergy
description: Come get a hot dog. BigFrankEnergy is Black Rock City's dedicated hot dog theme camp, grilling and gifting franks daily from sunrise runs across the playa to late-night campfire sessions. Daily programming includes The Relish Lab (build your own signature condiment blend), Frank Talks (philosophical debates on the great hot dog questions), Franks and Ranks trivia competition, Hot Dog Couture costume contests, and the Saturday Grand Frank-Off celebration. We believe radical self-expression and the radical gift of a perfectly grilled frankfurter are not mutually exclusive. Find us by the 15-foot illuminated Big Frank Tower.
landmark: 15 ft tall inflatable hotdog

name: Backstage
description: Backstage is an interactive electronic music camp built as a rotating audience-to-artist-to-crew ritual. Part social music installation and part anti-spectator experience, it invites guests into a structured participation loop of backstage creation, onstage performance, and front of house support. Participants create a track in a guided music studio behind the stage, hear it come alive on stage, then help light the next act before returning to the dance floor. We also host live experimental electronic music, dance parties, and late night ambient sets.
landmark: "Backstage" Sign

name: CrazyCamera & Christmas Every Day
description: Where you can make crazy picture, burn the wooden frame for it and celebrate Christmass.
landmark: Huge surfboard above the shade "CRAZY CAMERA"

name: Norms Garage
description: Norms Garage and its Handle Bar is a space full of bike-based furniture and a human-powered blender bar, recycling default world bike parts into new lives and uses on playa. We also host a variety of bike-oriented events, teaching people the delicate art of how to physically and emotionally ride a tandem, jousting on a big wheels trike, how to do the limbo on two wheels, and hosting many other mini-games focused on finding new ways to enjoy and appreciate your playa bike.At the Garage, we can fix almost anything: a contentious relationship, a broken heart, a lost traveler in space or time. We cannot, however, fix your bicycle.
landmark: Real estate sign w/ name+sched + 6 ft EMT bicycle

name: French Maid Brigade
description: The French Maids are a playful, meaningful, health and wellness camp that is excited to offer Ayurvedic Massages, Scented Oils, Yoga, Breathing, Happiness and Art workshops to express any Burners creative skills...Come chill and add to your experience on playa with the MAIDS!
landmark: Red Room Lounge fronting the street - red lights

name: Gaian Airship
description: An immersive journey into the thriving future. We play a game to create a unifying vision of the thriving future around the Time, Water, Fire, Air and Earth elements.
landmark: Flying Gaian Airship above Future Ashram pyramid

name: Highku
description: Push through our glowing torii gate and drop into a solar-fueled zen oasis humming on pure sun power; no roar of generators, just clean, quiet relief. Mist-kissed shade with rippling silk skies and angled tarps welcomes you to endless icy lemonade, coconut water, and a gentle train that chugs surprise gifts...cooling bandanas, glow bits, playa vitamins; straight to your dusty lap. Sink into the vibe with smooth beats, soft programmable LED dreams at night, and spontaneous serotonin sparks through flow, chats, and soul-deep workshops. This is your midday (and midnight) haven to exhale, recharge, laugh, and remember why we come to the dust. Come find your glow, we are waiting.
landmark: Large wooden torii gate with Camp HIGHKU sign.

name: Reverbia
description: An All Live Music Camp with 4 stages, including: The Cosmic Dome (LED interactive) The Jam and Teahouse, The Phoenix Rising Shade Stage, and Reverbia Main Stage. Reverbia features Daily: Calm Inside (breathe, Stretch) ,Live Music Yoga in the Morning...Dance Workshops, Open Mic/ Songwriter Showcase, Concerts in the Shade, Reverbia Classical Music Sunsets and Live Nights, The Reverbia Childrens' Hour, and Late Night Mini Radiance Dome, and Jam and Teahouse. Reverbia also features Dance Performances, including the Production Tommorow, Today. Our Tribute to Lost Musicians honors musicians who passed away the previous year. And the 50th Anniversary of Stevie Wonder's Songs in the Key of Life. Here with guest artist performances.
landmark: Giant Crystal Shade Stage and Merkaba Star.

name: Cicadia
description: This nature and bug themed camp is buzzing with excitement and fun. The sweet sounds of music will draw you in like bugs to nectar. You can rest in the shaded nooks and comfy seats, quench your thirst with cold electrolytes, or dance the night away on the beautifully lit dancefloor.
landmark: Bug wings on shade tiedowns, Big Cicadia sign

name: Toxic Disco Clam
description: In the default world, the Toxic Disco Clam is a real aquatic creature. It uses its luminous lips to attract passing fish... and then it dazes them with acidic snot. We're pretty much the same: we draw you in with dazzling lights and entertaining activities, we ply you with our intoxicating beverages, and we hope you never leave.
landmark: Toxic Disco Clam Sign hanging on shade structure

name: Kentucky Fried Camp
description: Kentucky Fried Campers only need one spice, and that's the spice of life. If you wanna taste it, join us any time of day or night. We begin each morning with the best hot breakfast on playa; a shot of Kentucky bourbon served with a fried baloney sandwich. Afternoons you'll find us relaxing in our Olde Kentucky Dome, crafting, napping, match-making, and lots of watching the Black Rock City whirled go by. Evenings are for dancing, officiating wedding ceremonies and sending folx off on their psychogeography honeymoons. Look for the KFC sign high in the sky and then spot our gingham-wrapped dome. Kentucky Fried Camp; In baloney, united we stand!
landmark: Gingham draped dome and large KFC sign

name: LAF Lazy-Ass Fuckers
description: Come walk through the history of Playa SWAG at The Playa Artifact Museum! We provide a look into past pins, posters, tickets and more, highlighting decades of creativity at the Burn. We host workshops with new artists and friends from years past. All are welcome!
landmark: Playa Artifacts Museum and Neon Chill Dome

name: ReEntry Station
description: A calm, low stimulation space designed for participants returning from deep playa. As you make your way back into the city, step into a shaded environment offering cold water, electrolytes, and a place to pause and reset.We provide a soft landing from the intensity of the playa. No loud music, no pressure, just a welcoming space to reorient, cool down, and reconnect before continuing your journey.Whether you need hydration, a moment of stillness, or simple human connection, Reentry Station is here as a quiet checkpoint between the vastness of the playa and the rhythm of the city.
landmark: glowing white arch + mist canopy

name: Dusty Bottoms
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Red & tan shade structure & yellow lace pants flag

name: Dusty Delight
description: Come cool off with fresh playa-made ice cream while dancing to our incredible melodic techno DJs spinning atop our sexy art car Double-D! Join the festivities Tuesday-Friday 1-5pm.
landmark: Ice cream cone atop our art car with boobs

name: Camp VRC
description: Camp VRC is about capturing and sharing the Burning Man experience beyond the playa by means of immersive 360 D virtual reality (VR) footage. Lose yourself in past year's VR experiences or jump in and help us build a global network to carry the impact beyond the playa. Monday to Saturday, 3-5pm, at the yellow short schoolbus. Also, you might find us POP-UP, to show footage, at other busy events throughout the playa.
landmark: Yellow Short School Bus and Camp VRC sign

name: GDI's - Gawd Damn Independents
description: We're the GDI's (Gawd Damn Independents) and we're all working for the Man. We're Nevada Burners, plus one gawd damn Canuck - all with "Playa MacGyver" skills. So; drop in - late afternoon or late night as you might catch us enjoying a hot coffee or cold one...after work. Walk up; dust off a chair and share your best "There was this one time at Burning Man" story around our fire-pit. We might trade a trinket, a laugh, or one of our stories for your damn effort. We have Burned forever, and we long the days of Cacophonic playa snark; however - if speed past our camp on a 'lectric bike - we'll yelling at you "SLOW the F*** down...". Dusty hugs and squinty eyed smiles back at yah; "In Dust - We can Trust". Peace, Love & Hugs - the GDI's. (insert tools, smiley, dust and campfire "emojis").
landmark: Mailbox with GDI's and 8:14+G on it

name: Mimosa
description: Hey you, yes you our dear friend! I know what you want, or I would say even need. A fresh, cold MIMOSA. Please step by our bar where we will get you what you need.
landmark: Citrus sign in front of the camp

name: Mary E's Lavender Hand Wash
description: Come feel the Lavender Love and wash the day's playa away! A moment of tranquility is sacred in the desert, and we are here to honor that moment with a lovely hand wash & hand massage, leaving you feeling relaxed and happy!
landmark: Big purple hand

name: Fucking Joe Camp
description: Welcome to Fucking Joe Camp! Where everybody knows your name, and we're always glad you came!
landmark: Pole dancing platform / lit orange rotating beacon

name: ClusterF*ck United
description: Dust, Sun, Booze, Bikes, Night, and Noise?it's a ClusterF*ck out there and that's exactly what you'll find here: a ClusterF*ck of activity where chaos meets collaboration in the heart of the playa! Our camp is a vibrant and diverse community of Burners from around the globe, coming together to celebrate the spirit of Burning Man in our own unique and unconventional ways. Look for our brightly-lit ? marquee!
landmark: Silver asterisk marquee & LED asterisk emblem

name: Daydream
description: Welcome to Daydream, a sanctuary in Black Rock City designed for radical inclusion, creativity, and connection. Step into our Dreamers' Lounge, an immersive space to relax, recharge, and meet fellow Burners away from the chaos of the playa. Start your mornings at our coffee bar and interactive talks, then linger in the lounge or cuddle puddle for spontaneous social and creative interactions. In the afternoons, join intimate workshops and reflective activities that spark inspiration. As the sun sets, our lounge comes alive with ambient projection art, creating a visually immersive experience. Daydream is a place to dream, connect, and embrace transformation together.
landmark: The Dream Lounge

name: Spoonful of Friends
description: A camp built around the simple idea that sharing a meal can turn strangers into something closer. We create thoughtful, beautifully hosted dining experiences that bring people together. Long tables, warm lighting, music that invites you in, and conversations that linger.Our camp is a place to connect, and participate. Some come to cook, some to serve, some to host, and some simply to be held by the experience. Everyone contributes to the energy in their own way.
landmark: A long banquet table next two big neon spoons!

name: adult playground
description: Simple human connection. We offer daily sessions including Morning Flow, Midday Reset, and an evening social hour that creates an easy space for people to meet and unwind. Our main attraction is a tall oiled slide that invites participants to let go and play like kids again, with camp members on hand to keep everything safe and fun. On select afternoons we gift authentic fried pizza made fresh in camp. Throughout the day visitors can drop in for stretching, grounding, conversation, or a moment of shade. Adult Playground is a relaxed, friendly space designed to help people reset, connect, and enjoy the lighter side of the playa.
landmark: slide

name: Fantastica Music Healing Camp
description: Reset with us in a space where the magical sounds of live guitar gently guide you into relaxation and inner balance. Here, you can pause, release tension, and simply be. Our camp creates an atmosphere of calm, comfort, and mindful presence. Open to all who seek restoration and a deeper connection with themselves.
landmark: shaded tent camp with sign and a distinctive flag

name: Camp XUZA
description: Home of XUZA Art CarEvery Night XUZA will be out on the prowl, seeking out Art installations to host parties and more.
landmark: XUZA Art Car Sign at the end of XUZA's Driveway.

name: Fjörgyn's Lair
description: The Viking Longboat was a potent symbol of life, livelihood, one's journey through life, the afterlife, and was used by the Norse for transport, in trade, in warfare, and as a burial vessel for centuries.Fjorgyn is a personification of earth in Norse mythology, and the mother of the thunder god Thor, the son of Odin.
landmark: White work truck bed, turned into fuel trailer

name: Camp Questionmark
description: The age of questioning is here! Celebrating creativity & music born from the playa. Bring us your questions and we will give you more back )?(.
landmark: Question Marks

name: Inflatable Wildlife
description: Inflatable Wildlife is the premiere destination for all indigenous inflatables of the playa. With a menagerie of inflatable wildlife, steady stream of danceable beats and wild and wondrous interaction helping to magnify the natural syncopated basslines which undulate through us all, we will be serving Daily Spirits Tastings, Inflatable Goat Yoga, Playa Jewelry Making, our signature, 6th annual Sunrise Pre-Game Party and more.
landmark: Purple Inflatable Wildlife banner, pink elephant

name: Garage Mahal
description: Garage Mahal.
landmark: 20' bamboo poles with Balinese flags

name: Black Rock Roller Disco
description: Every city has a roller skating rink. The Black Rock Roller Disco is the roller skating rink for Blac Rock City. We ae a full service roller rink. We have the skates, the funky music and we're always a funky good time every time.
landmark: Golden Gate Bridge

name: Pacific
description: The underwater home of the mutant vehicle Pacific, Neptune's Chariot. The sea themed camp is welcome to campers to relax in our underwater shade and is here to host 2 dance parties on Tuesday and Thursday.
landmark: 2 Large Seahorses!

name: Dilla's Den
description: We support the Quesadilla Armadilla mutant vehicle so that she is good to go for playa exploring and artistic photo ops. You can often find us randomly at sound cars in deep playa serving quesadillas at sunrise. The Dilla's Den is where we rest and recharge and you can come by to dilla dally with us anytime. See you in the dust.
landmark: 2 large armadillo profiles

name: Cirkus Freaks
description: Cirkus freak, mutant vehicle.
landmark: Red & yellow Cirkus Freaks sign

name: Chivo Loco
description: A vibrant community bringing flavor, music, and warmth to Playa. Sharing our culture through food and connection. Our chill lounge offers a welcoming space with good vibes and great conversations. Everyone is invited to stop by, enjoy a meal, and experience our hospitality. Come as you are?leave as part of the Chivo Loco family!
landmark: Chivo Loco Flag

name: Sozo Experience
description: Open for those looking for inner or outer healing, and for those wanting more of the supernatural! We offer venerative and regenerative meditation, drum circles, spiritual readings, healings, and an experimental "Dopamine Dump" experience. So get some caffeinated exotic coffee with us in the morning, or come to afternoon thought provoking and interactive workshops on surviving in the desert. We welcome you with open arms to join us for a truth ceremony, or check out and do the menu board of spirituality!
landmark: Sozo Experience (banners) dome tent

name: Rebel Camp
description: ESD Support Camp.
landmark: Rebel Flag

name: Rocket 'n Roll
description: Rocket 'n Roll mutant vehicle support camp.
landmark: Old West Jail next to the Rocket 'n Roll MV

name: Ripple
description: The Ripple Effect reflects on the very nature of affecting change: how one small stone tossed into a body of water causes a ripple effect with an almost never-ending forward motion. Camp Ripple is all about tossing those positive stones to impact your own life and those of others one small metaphorical pebble at a time!
landmark: 10x20 Tie-Die with RIPPLE in large letters.

name: Skyting Hq
description: Carries a crew who have travelled from a parallel dimension to support radical inclusivity, roving risk reduction, ecological grief rituals, and sounds from the global majority underground.
landmark: SIGN THAT SAYS SKYTING OR BIG TRUCK WITH BAMBOO

name: Happy Hanuman
description: Get ready for a wild ride with Happy Hanuman, the grooviest mutant vehicle support camp around! We're a global crew of creative crazies, zooming in from every corner of the planet to unleash our wacky imaginations on the Playa with some seriously epic Mutant Vehicles. But wait, there's more! Our camp is packed with fun goodies for you to explore...like our totally awesome calligraphy wall! Picture this: a giant white canvas where you can splash, scribble, and paint with water that magically vanishes as it dries. Swing by, say "hi," and let's make some Playa magic together!
landmark: Light beacon and large Happy Hanuman Logo flag

name: Ray's Fix It
description: Break something? We'll try to fix it! No promises, other than you'll leave with something and we'll have a good time trying. Power tools and expertise available Office Hours, otherwise 24/7 DIY with hand tools, work space, and plenty of materials to MacGyver your issue. Bikes are DIY only, nor do we have mutant vehicle help, though we'll try to point you in the right direction. We are a small mom and pop shop, so for generators and RV help etc., we'll direct you to those specialty camps.
landmark: Ray's Fix It sign

name: Rooftop Frose
description: A view at sunset with a cool refreshing drink for relaxed burners.
landmark: Sign Rooftop Frose

name: Freqz of Love
description: Our camp is a cozy, heart-centered lounge where burners can relax, reset, and connect. We host interactive experiences like breathwork, oracle pulls, numerology, movement sessions, and playful recovery activities for dusty travelers. Stop by to add a message to our wedding and affirmation backdrops, grab some shade, and join whatever is happening in the moment. With ambient music, comfy seating, and a welcoming crew, our space is made for slowing down and meeting new friends. Come recharge and share the love frequency.
landmark: Lighted heart flag over triangle shade lounge

name: Anonymous Village
description: Anonymous Village is a supportive community to help burners stay sober in the challenging environment of the playa and BRC. Members staff the Village hospitality tent and lead recovery meetings in communal meeting space. Recovery Yoga is available daily at 10:30am in the Yoga tent. We offer a daily meeting schedule including meetings of AA (Alcoholics Anonymous), NA (Narcotics Anonymous), Alanon, SAA/SLAA, FA/OA, CoDA, MA, and PIR. We also host sober camping as well as a separate area for Alanon's and recovery friends/allies. We also offer "AnyA" meetings daily that offer an inclusive environment for people recovering from addiction to "ANY" behavior or substance. We welcome curious burners who want to learn about how we burn sober.
landmark: Marquee sign "Anonymous Village"

name: Turbaza Chayka
description: A playful, interactive camp blending vintage aesthetics with irreverent curiosity. Visitors can sip a fine selection of teas while browsing our vintage porn salon, send handwritten postcards through our Post Office of Questionable Taste, and collect stamps or temporary tattoos from the Department of Dubious Markings. Our Badge Bureau issues official credentials for deeply unofficial activities. For those seeking spectacle, the Ice Bucket Fishing Contest offers a lively, crowd friendly experience. In the evenings, our electric bike bar becomes a glowing gathering point with music, light, and connection. Part archive, part experiment, and part social space, the camp invites participation, humor, and shared moments on playa.
landmark: An announcement board with camp's name on it

name: Camp Tell You
description: A regenerative sanctuary on the playa. By day, we offer a regenerative sanctuary of healing frequencies. Mornings start with "Spill Tea over Tea," our daily conversation circle. Camp Tell You is a choice between surviving the playa and thriving within it, an invitation to explore interaction that goes beyond the ephemeral.
landmark: Tarot card art at our interactivity entrance

name: UniverseCity
description: Welcome to UniverseCity, the prestigious Black Rock City College of Arts and Sciences. Our accredited program issues diplomas on any subject matter, however imaginary. These range from the fictional and unlikely to major changes in life direction. Join us on campus and register at the Admissions Office to receive your Letter of Acceptance. Early in the week, attend New Student Orientation activities. Any day, come relax in our verdant Quad, take in lectures of questionable accuracy, gaze into our night time Planetarium. Later in the week we grant diplomas recognizing unique contributions to your field of study during a personalized graduation ceremony. We are a family-friendly camp, welcome all burners to our campus and encourage participation in launching your self-declared education.
landmark: UniverseCity logo signage, ivy columns

name: Pleasant Camp
description: A pleasant place to be.
landmark: Pleasant Camp sign next to our shaded lounge

name: StarPups
description: A daily caffeine fix of cold-brew coffee in the morning and a relaxed space to hang out at throughout the day! Play some games and make new friends in our cafe, toss some bags for cornhole, or test your coordination with giant Jenga!
landmark: LED-lit flagpole with a cute puppy flag

name: Camp LandHO!
description: Sunburnt, mischievous, and gently naughty-cal - a low-rise harbor on the playa where art cars dock, the lighthouse winks, and a sound trailer keeps the night humming. Come for Christina, our flagship mutant vehicle, and stay for Port Hours: predictable hosting windows with tea, small gifts, hands-on demos and low-barrier skill shares. At night the lighthouse and sound trailer host a rotating cast of top DJs, guest selectors and local talent playing flow-based sets that fold into layered vessel decks and late-night flow. We run on participation, consent, radical inclusion and Leave No Trace - builders, DJs and apprentices co-create a playful port of call where mischief is choreographed with care.
landmark: a front yard built from boats and sails

name: Art for Art's Sake
description: A place for one-on-one discussions about art. Come to sit with one other "rando" and talk to each other about "What art means to you", "What art moves you", and "Why art". This camp is open most nights from 8pm to midnight. We are just a few people with a few chairs for pairs of people that wanna talk art.
landmark: sign on frontage stating: ART FOR ARTS SAKE

name: Zero Fucks
description: A consortium of friends who love being weird together, throwing dark techno parties in secret shipping containers, and exploring creative boundaries. We haven't missed it yet.
landmark: Pink Shipping Container and "Zero Fucks" signs

name: Hammered and Sickled
description: Hammered and Sickled is an international camp compromised of members from 30 plus countries of origins. We run a flavored Vodka bar as well as other libations and our mantra is "No one leaves our bar thirsty or walking in a straight line". We offer the weary desert travelers an oasis where they can take a break, relax and kick their shoes off. Our campers come from different corners of the world, backgrounds and offer a variety of insights and opinions to liven up any conversation. We have our in house DJ's spinning lounge and mashups through out the day.
landmark: 30+ Country flags above our lounge structure

name: BAAAHS Station
description: We're the home of BAAAHS: the Big-Ass Amazingly Awesome Homosexual Sheep. You might know us as the 40-foot long rolling disco whose entrance, naturally, is through the pulsing pink sphincter in the rear. Day and night, we graze on the playa...laser eyeballs shining, beloved DJs spinning, dancy people flocking.BAAAHS Station is our central depot where everyone is welcome to kick up your hooves. Come for our daily dance parties, get a view from our four-story watchtower, enjoy a lovely beverage from our friendly bartenders, and meet a homo or two.We're builders, artists, and techies at heart. Our DJ line-up combines world-famous names with up-and-cumming performers, with a focus on featuring queer artists. Our mission - Shear queer bliss.
landmark: 30' tall glowing art deco tower

name: Playa Art Park Support
description: A camp to support the Playa Art Park, a place to enjoy smaller art in a cozy setting.
landmark: Playa Art Park sign

name: Bunny Meth Lab
description: Transcend your humanity and project your bunny personality. Bunny-human hybrids are the future. Come enjoy our Esplanade lounge and relax in large fur daybeds, listening to curated beats and sipping on craft cocktails. Daily sundown events with spontaneous happenstance all week long. Vibrant colors, mystical LED forests, and plenty of places to relax. Find the hidden interactive origin story experience.
landmark: LED forest, 50 foot stretch tent, two white semis.

name: Mesa
description: Join us on our raised sanctuary where the spirit of community, self-expression, and well-being converge. Our vibrant, shaded oasis offers a diverse array of experiences, from sunset drum circles to sunrise yoga sessions, fireside mezcal nights and even late night volleyball (it's lit)! With a dedication to Radical Inclusion, we welcome all seekers to our haven of pillows, rugs, and couches, where connections are forged, creativity flourishes, and transformative journeys unfold.
landmark: Purple glowing sign with a lotus flower + MESA

name: Dusty Dreamers
description: At Dusty Dreamers we believe Burning Man is a dream in which we get for a week the opportunity to be completely free, to let our imagination go wild, to try new things and make new friends and that's why we are building the Home of the Dreamers at BRC. Our core theme is Celebration and Liberation. We are also a European camp, with our burners coming primarily from France, Sweden, and Spain. We are very easy to find, just look out for our 28ft tall Eiffel Tower, et voila!
landmark: Eiffel Tower (28ft tall) lit at night

name: Raditude
description: A collective of Lucid & Light lucky individuals serving up Rad-Attitude Adjustments every DAWN & DUSK with a themed streetside Fireplace Art Piece and an Axis Mundi Reali-Tea Lounge; shoe-free shade and more for all those building, volunteering, and interacting within Black Rock City!
landmark: Flags around a 5’ Stainless Steel Diamond

name: Vitruvian
description: Turn your world upside down at Vitruvian Lounge. Enjoy good gyrations by taking a spin on our Human Sized Gyroscope, and stay to enjoy good vibrations in our lounge with great music and ice cold craft cocktails. Head into the K-Box for Korean-style private room karaoke to sing the night away together from 9pm to sunrise.
landmark: 15 ft tall gyroscope, lit at night

name: Camp Be Bothered
description: We can't be bothered to fill this out.
landmark: White 20' dome covered w/ pink+aqua fabric strips

name: Nipple Pie
description: Welcomes you to join us for our early night parties, whether it is to stomp our dancefloor or to simply sip on a refreshing cocktail in our cozy lounge.At the start of the new night, when our projectors launch their state of the art 3D projections onto our 50ft mural, and when the beats roar up to the busy avenue, that's when Nipple Pie shines the best.
landmark: Nipple wooden dome with bright yellow light

name: ...cats
description: *cats is all about the immersive digital art experience - we gift a high-fidelity LED live visualscape, where we host a roster of visual and sound artists, with a bias towards experimental art forms.
landmark: Cat dome with giant LED ears

name: Raccoons
hometown: Vilnius, San Mateo, Kaunas, Madrid, Kyiv, L.A.
description: Well, as the loveliest trash pandas, we firmly believe that sustainability, alternative energy sources, as well as the 4Rs (Reuse, Reduce, Rethink, Recycle) are crucial in our daily human (and raccoon) lives.A raccoon can be crafty and resourceful, responsible and playful, but above all?curious and friendly.
landmark: Raccoons sign

name: Deep Ohm
description: Deep Ohm is a place for centered connection, friendship, and fun. We enjoy spending time in our cozy home on the playa and invite all wanderers to come rest in our shade and share their stories. We are a theme camp that is focused on creating a safe space for anyone who desires to connect with others in a meaningful way while making origami paper cranes and festive stamps to commemorate your time with us. We also serve delicious drinks all day long!
landmark: Deep Ohm sandwich board sign

name: Chop Shop
description: We are the best BRC bicycle repair shop. We have bicycle repairs, parts and welding.
landmark: The large Chop Shop sign mounted on scaffolding

name: SlöMóth
description: SlöMóth is the birth of night striving toward the light ? a space where all participants become moths, both visually and philosophically. Inspired by post-modernist ideas, our camp blends curiosity, playfulness, and the irresistible pull toward brightness.Spot our mischievous moths by their Fluffy Pink Coats, Wiggling Antennae or at least The Moustache. If we're not in camp, we're flocking toward distant lights or performing a ritual at our beloved installation ? The Moth.
landmark: glowing pink Moth sculpture and lit lounge tent

name: Sol Family
description: Rise & Shine with us every morning 7am - 11amBarista Coffee Service and CafeBy VERY popular demand, Coffee NotSi returns. Barista coffee service. DJ'd zen morning vibes. Extended hours. No complaints.+ New in 2026: Frappuccinos!Sparkling Energy MimosasA refreshing new twist toward caffeinating the playa each morning (with bubbles!). Traditional mimosas/prosecco served as well.Rise & Shine LoungeCome for the caffeine, stay for the vibes. Daily DJ'ed morning lounge space with upbeat tracks, dancing, shade, misters, sofas, hammocks and cafe tables.Charm Bracelet Buffet BarCapture a memory, or create a completely unique playa gift. Make friends and fun custom jewelry.Join us Monday and Wednesday afternoons 2-5 for our Signature Day Parties! DJ's, refreshing icy cocktail bar, misters and more.
landmark: big hex tent, cafe tables, sol family sign

name: Bubbles and Bass
description: Bubbles and Bass is a 100% volunteer run art and music collective that brings joy to burner events worldwide! Our goal is to provide a home conducive to connecting: spiritually, conversationally, energetically. Best known for our sunrise to midday dancing revelry: more Bubbles and Bass makes the playa a magical place!
landmark: Sand-colored shade sails with a warm glow

name: Favela Culture
description: Welcome to Favela ArtCar & Camp, inspired by the spirit of resilience, community, and creativity found in Brazil's most vibrant slum neighborhoods. Here, we celebrate connection beyond social labels and our iconic skull-shaped Art Car is a moving symbol of that message: a reminder that beneath it all, we are all equal. Come dance with us, share stories, and experience a space where differences dissolve into unity, art, and radical inclusion. In the Favela, everyone belongs.
landmark: A large red skull face of Mutant Vehicle

name: Alchemist Bazaar
description: Alchemist Bazaar by PlayAlchemist is a mythic, medieval-inspired city, a living world of winding pathways, hidden courtyards, and immersive encounters. Enclosed like an ancient walled village, it invites wanderers into a realm where discovery unfolds at every turn. Pathways draw participants inward toward a central fire, the beating heart of the city, radiating ritual and connection. Within its walls, low-lit chambers, secret passages, and intimate sanctuaries reveal art, music, storytelling, and ceremony. Each space stewarded by artists offering unique expressions that blur the line between participant and creator. The Bazaar is the feminine counterpart to the Pyramid's order, a place of mystery, play, and transformation, where one may lose their way only to find something deeper.
landmark: Medieval city wall with a Pyramid inside

name: Golden Gate Project
description: The easiest way to describe our camp is like giving directions to someone who's never been to San Francisco - look for the Golden Gate Bridge.At Burning Man, our camp is anchored by a 60-foot-long, 26-foot-tall replica of the Golden Gate Bridge, making it one of the most recognizable landmarks on the playa.
landmark: Golden Gate Bridge welcome sign with posts

name: Rustic WerQ Ranch
description: A camp full of folx who support all artists that make the many art projects happen on playa. Drop by for a whiskey or a water between 730-930p.
landmark: White cargo trailer "Rustic Ranch Fur" in red

name: Node
description: Node is an oasis of epic proportions. Stop by for drinks, vibes and beats. Dont miss our Hip Hop BBQ on Wednesday!
landmark: Glowing pink lights

name: Burning Questions
description: Burning Questions offers visitors an escape to a hammock world surrounded by nature. Here to provide you with a comfortable hang space day or night, come climb into our nets and let us take you away to the beach, the forest, or a field filled with our World Famous Crickets. We are a group of friends from around the globe who are excited to build our small sanctuary for you to enjoy!
landmark: 2-masted circus tent with flags + green lasers

name: Lunars Camp
description: Experience a unique journey aboard our tethered hot air balloon, 75 feet high, with live instrumentals and DJ Sets. Enjoy stunning Black Rock City views and our ground-level dance floor. Join the best show on earth in our Celestial Circus lounge or relax and rejuvenate in our Oracle's Den.
landmark: Hot Air Balloon and well lit perimeter

name: Fire Camp
description: Fire Camp is a home for fire spinners and performers of all kinds. Come by for a fire jam or to play on the aerial rigs & poles, or just enjoy the music and entertainment! Try to find out who the swag keeper is and get your stickers or patch!If the buttons with red lights are on, you can press them...
landmark: 30' x 30' canvas canopy w/ flame effects out front

name: Camp Kinetic
description: Dedicated to Movement Arts in Black Rock City.Afternoon Workshops in Flow Arts, Juggling, Dance, Yoga, and Aerial.Evening Features Performances and Fire Jams.
landmark: wide open front, pointy white shade, scaffolding

name: Snarket
description: The Snarket and Le Gentrifique, the snarkiest businesses in town. We got what you don't need with a cup of coffee on the side. Millions of dissatisfied customers can't be wrong. Come get a mouthful.
landmark: Brick facade building with two streetlights

name: CornHub
description: Do you love corn as much as we do? Come experience the entire gamut of the beautiful vegetable slash grain! Vegetables are a scarcity on the playa, so come join us for our fresh corn daily and build your own flavor popcorn bar to get your fibre on! Pooping is a problem out here, so make sure you get in and out of that little plastic box of a toilet as fast as possible.If you've got your fiber fix already, come hydrate with some iced beverages!After you're nourished and hydrated, climb up our 15' mushroom art piece and pop your head out the top for a view of the playa, if you dare!
landmark: Flag that looks eerily similar to the PornHub logo

name: Magic Paradise
description: Dive into an oasis of wonder, where community and enchantment come together! Enjoy captivating up close magic shows, intimate speakeasy encounters, and daily afternoon treats. Let our skilled team repair your gear, and make your bike stand out with our dazzling decorations.
landmark: scaffolding tower with magic paradise sign

name: Dark Heart
description: Morning community dance followed by small, intimate heart-share pods? Incredible afternoon expansive workshops? Sunset rituals? Fire art? Fire DANCE?!? Nightly temple celebrations of intimacy and joy? Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!Start with our Cafe on the Edge, where you can look forward into the mystery and consider what you're going to leave behind. Take the leap into our Dark Temple, where you can plug into the void and remember what all-is-love really feels and looks like and how to bring that heaven to the heart of the playa - you! Come drop in with our camp of experienced, international burners who are focused on creating a loving, tight community and flowing the love out to all of you BRC citizens! We love you!
landmark: 14 ft lighted arch w/ a red stretch tent behind it

name: Rootist Lounge
description: #RootistLounge & #SirensCove are camps based on the joy of #energy, the beauty of #spiritual connection with self, and others. It's a gathering of open-minded and like-minded individuals where friendships surround you. We are always creating new art, supporting art, art cars, and artists. If you would like to co-create with us, please email us! With a major focus on energy work, healing sound vibrational therapy, #yoga, #workshops, #hughealing, #ArtCars -Art car support, Art project support, and so much more. We are constantly striving to go above and beyond to create a truly magical experience for our participants. We put in our all, dedicating endless hours of our time to creating a beautiful place where everyone can gather and celebrate life through yoga, music, and #community.
landmark: Large Gifting Tree and Obelisks

name: Brain Freeze Camp
description: We will be back again in 2026 serving the coldest frozen margaritas on the Playa. Our amusement center will certainly entertain you and Power to the People will be available to help keep your electrical devices charged.
landmark: The Bar, Usually on corner, with a neon sign,

name: Swing City
description: Swing City brings the energy and vibe of the Original Muscle Beach in Santa Monica California to Burning Man. We strive to provide a safe welcoming playground that can be enjoyed by all ages. Come to participate or just hang out in our shade and watch the various acrobatics available as seasoned professionals and movement newbies alike explore our space.
landmark: 18' Scaffolding Structure

name: Storytime Friends
description: Storytime and Dreamtime co-create magic. Storytime is a larger-than-life Tiffany's banker's lamp, building community through the magic of storytelling and reading aloud across the playa. Pick up a book, sit in a circle, and read to friends new and old. Lie back, listen, and watch the stained-glass lampshade slowly change overhead. Share your own stories, or create a new one together. Storytime is a stage for reading and connection, and a comfortable retreat from the noise, throughout the city and in deep playa.Rest on Dreamtime to inspire, introspect, reflect on dreams past and co-create new visions for the future.
landmark: Storytime Art Car

name: Wild Horses support camp
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Banners featuring past art projects

name: Nobo House
description: Nobo House is an international, quirky Holistic Wellness & Recovery camp that is a place of refuge for playa adventurers, artists, & builders. Our gift is a chill playa spa, that includes a steam room, outdoor gym, dance classes, massages and smoothies.
landmark: Giant Diamond

name: Bisous
description: Welcome to Bisous. We are an experiential theme camp and non-profit co-created by a team with backgrounds in experience design, community building, and history building theme camps on playa.
landmark: Silk Road Courtyard

name: Hush Hush Pony Barn
description: Hush Hush Pony Barn is exciting to bring two offerings to playa: Our beloved Mutant Vehicle made out of reclaimed fence board and our interactivity Gossip & Guillotines. They say you'll lose your head at Burning Man! Come see what the rumor mill and the gallery are all chatting about.
landmark: Guillotine on a trailer

name: Beaverton
description: Camp Beaverton is an intentional, experimental, and experiential Burning Man community theme camp and a legacy sapphic nonprofit organization. Not queer? No fear! We're straight friendly! We are a group of queer women/trans/genderqueer/lesbian/bisexual/heterosexual/etc... or folks who are simply as wayward as the playa is dusty. We celebrate sexuality, self exploration, and respect for one's journey through this life. Our goal is to provide a safe(r), brave(r) space that centers queer women, trans folks, and nonbinary identities on and off-playa. We encourage education, participation, inquiry, conversation, and self-reflection. We extend our goals to the greater Black Rock community by hosting workshops and social events.
landmark: Rainbow Camp Beaverton sign & large Beaver symbol

name: Rogue Nation (SEAWeed)
description: Ever wonder what happens when light listens? Light Echoes is an interactive LED wall that responds to your movement, sound, and presence, transforming you into a living paintbrush. Stop by during the day for a shady lounge to rest your dusty bones, or come back after dark to see the wall come alive. Join one of our workshops to create your own digital art and add it to the wall's growing collection. By the end of the week, Light Echoes becomes a collaborative gallery built by the citizens of Black Rock City.
landmark: LED wall and Black Rogue Nation vinyl banner

name: Mindwerk
description: Come to Mindwerk and ride our slide!! Relax in our shady dome and enjoy a Pomerosegasm, the most delicious and refreshing cocktail in Black Rock City! Climb up to our viewing platform where you can behold a 360 degree view of our beautiful metropolis. Exhilarating egress is provided by a convenient slide. It's been called "just the right amount of sketchy" by satisfied customers. And its polymer surface won't burn your buns!
landmark: Big dome with a platform on top

name: From Mars With Love
description: Home of the Serendipity Mars Rover.
landmark: a big array of solar panels

name: Nordic Paradise
description: Where cold-brew coffee meets an exciting bar and cafe. Explore workshops for body and mind, dance to music, and chill out in style. Join our Qurious Viking party, celebrating all gender expressions. It's an unforgettable experience waiting for you. Welcome to Nordic Paradise!
landmark: Lit midsummer pole, trailers w. camp name

name: Humble Be Art cars
description: This theme camp has no description.
landmark: Humble Be LED lit sign

name: Transcend
description: A place to celebrate the sound of electronic music in all of its forms, a place to "TRANCSEND" mind, body and soul using any beat per minute you can imagine. Join us for this musical journey on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons!
landmark: Neon Jungle Sahara Tent

name: Imagine Nation Art Lounge
description: Remember how you felt when you were drawing on kitchen tables and living room floors? Tap back into a state of mind that embodied the purist creative version of yourself! We encourage our guests to tap into their childhood imagination again through the medium of art, especially drawing and colouring.
landmark: Tractor Trailer Truck with blue and white flags.

name: Organic Fruit & Veggie Camp
description: The finest fruits and veggies to wet your whistle and soothe your soul. Come have a snack and a chat and reset your mind and body.
landmark: Green ORGANIC flags

name: Black Rock Piano Lounge
description: Black Rock Piano Lounge is the place to come and share your talent with a friendly audience. We bring great musicians to the playa but build our lounge for that spontaneous moments where the perfect vocals are combined with the best tuned pianos on the playa. Lets make some beautiful music together.
landmark: All white tent structure with pianos and a sign

name: Nova Heaven
description: The crew that has created Nova Heaven for the past two years are gathering together to bring "Let There Be Light", a new art installation to playa. Come by and say "Shalom". We love you.
landmark: Blue and purple flags saying "We Will Dance Again"

name: Playa Agora
description: A vibrant space of connection, curiosity, and community. We host a full week of interactive workshops, coffee, and sangria, designed to spark conversation, inspire creativity, and bring people together. Come learn, share, and laugh with us as we co-create something meaningful at Burning Man 2026.
landmark: Blue and white sign that reads "Playa Agora"

name: Wrongtown
description: Wrongtown is an international family reunion gathering year round at events around the globe including Burning Man which is the main event! We have members on almost every Continent and from all walks of life.Our goal is to create a community space for our friends and family to experience the playa to its fullest. The camp works together to provide everything needed to survive on the playa including an amazing chill space, equipped kitchen, covered tent city and camp showers. While Wrongtown provides the infrastructure, everyone is expected and counted on to work, to build, strike and keep things running during the event including internal camp operations as well as running interactivity.Providing everything to survive allows our campmates to focus on amazing projects and epic performances.
landmark: 40' Beacon

name: Rum Amok
description: Throughout the week, our shade structure transforms into a tropical bar with a communal open-air studio. We provide the drinks, the brushes and the pigment, you provide the inspiration and the playa magic. Whether you're a master painter or just looking to make a mess, your strokes will contribute to our collective camp mural.
landmark: Large Rum Amok Sign

name: Gender Blender
description: Welcoming home our trans, non-binary, BIPOC, and gender non-conforming community on Playa!
landmark: Gender Blende Flags & Neon Sign

name: Heart of Parkness
description: A lush green oasis in the middle of the desert, open 24 hours a day, anchored by a shade tree, carpet meadow, benches and shade. There are frisbees, chessboards, cornhole, horse shoes, chess, giant connect 4, etc. We provide electronics repair services M-Tuesday and S'mores, Shots and Soul music at sunset, W-Thursday 6-9.
landmark: 15' realistic tree + 20 foot sign: < 3 of Parkness

name: Moon Landing
description: Moon Landing, a celestial outpost of creativity, exploration, and radical self-expression at Burning Man. Our camp is a launchpad for dreamers, builders, and cosmic wanderers?a space where art, technology, and human connection intersect in gravity-defying ways.Inspired by the pioneering spirit of lunar exploration, we craft immersive experiences that transport participants beyond the ordinary. Whether it's through interactive installations, mind-expanding discussions, or late-night moonwalks under the neon glow, Moon Landing invites you to step into the unknown and embrace the infinite possibilities of the playa.Join us as we orbit together in a community fueled by curiosity, collaboration, and a little bit of space dust. The countdown has begun?see you on the moon!
landmark: 10' LED sign with flames

name: Camp PtP - Papillio Ovum
description: Art support camp for placed art installation "Papillio Ovum".
landmark: fuel storage with orange trash fence-type fencin

name: The Veil
description: Empyrean is an immersive, walk-through theatrical experience that invites you into a mystical journey of beauty, darkness, and transformation. Step inside our atmospheric realms where living art, interactive spirit guides, and cinematic staging surround you in a story you don't just watch, you walk through. When you emerge, drift into our luminous lounge, a sanctuary to reflect, unravel, and process the experience in beauty and connection.
landmark: The large white banner called EMPYREAN.

name: Prairie Kids
description: We are the Prairie Kids, The Mutant Vehicle Support camp for the Astral Plain.
landmark: Prairie Kids Home of the Astral Plain sign

name: Vines Without Borders
description: A chill international wine bar and lounge open afternoons and evening daily, gifting great chilled wines and snacks from around the world, served by people from around the world. We celebrate a different wine producing region daily. Great music, fun people, curated tastings and something new every day.
landmark: Bug Light at about 15 feet in the front of our bar

name: You Look Amazing
description: You Look Amazing is not just a camp name, but a state of mind. We LOVE each and everyone of you and want to get to know you better. Our camp is an oasis of wellness at Burning Man. Where mind, body, and spirit converge in a harmonious dance of rejuvenation and exploration. Nestled amidst the pulsating energy of the playa, our camp offers a sanctuary unlike any other—a haven where participants can immerse themselves in a holistic journey of self-discovery and transformation.Join us for yoga, mindfulness, workshops, dancing and the best crepes you've ever had, we promise. They're better than sex. So come, weary travelers, and let us wrap you in dusty hugs and smiles. Tell us your stories and we'll tell you ours.
landmark: YOU LOOK AMAZING sign

name: Camp THREAT
description: Dominating the portos for 6 years or more. Unofficial Headquarters of The Black Rock City Communist Party (BRCCP). Gonzo Decommodification Experts and Proud Purveyors of Bullshit. Sales and Service 100% Guaranteed to soothe the soul and waste the body and mind. Cold looks and warm seats. The whiskey is tolerable and the wine is worse. While supplies last. Conditions and terms apply. We are not a cult.
landmark: Scaffold tower structure - red, black, and silver

name: Lost + Found
description: We are a diverse community, a California-based collective of dreamers, artists, adventurers, and creative doers, that loves throwing fun off-the-wall parties as much as we love connecting on deeper levels. We love to just be, we love to play, curate unique experiences, and faff about - whether it's flow, dance, music, magic, bubbles, movement, fire, food, drinks, art, live jams, deep talks, tiny things or a whole lot of silly nonsensical shenanigans. L+F is a diverse group of eclectic individuals that operates with love, respect and the 10 Principles of Burning Man. We create fun vibes and third spaces together as we inspire others to flow, love, and be their free and fearless selves. We have a habit of receiving lost and found items, including people. ;) Come play and get lost with us!

name: Bubble Lounge
description: A queer-forward, wildly inclusive, bar and chill zone celebrating 27 years on playa. Featuring DJ tower, interactive dance structure, vibrantly lit body wash experience, a chill lounge, and secret room (SSSH!) where you can find reprieve from the chaos. Expect music, mischief, bubbly, and a caring group of folk in equal measure.

name: Xxx-mas
description: XXXmas! A place where things are as random as a wild holiday themed camp is in a dry ancient lake bed in August where people from around the world hangout to celebrate this special time of year together. From our fully stocked pickle bar and ice cream station to 3 foot chess pieces and pictures with some guy we just met who thinks he is the real Santa Clause, this is a place you sure don't want to miss. Open to visitors pretty much 24/7! Stop by, say hi?Yep that rhymed-.
landmark: Christmas decorations, and giant board games.

name: Camp Cul-de-Sac

name: Alborz
description: If you find yourself parched and disoriented, listen carefully. Follow the melody and you may just stumble across camp Alborz. We'll be happy to nurture your body and soul before we send you back off to find the next adventure.

name: Queertirement

name: Burning Globe
description: Thespian? Thespian-curious? Do you have lots of Thespian friends? Well, round here, we call that an "ally" If that sounds like you, come join us for a chalice-full of tomfoolery, skullduggery, swashbuckle...ery and overall merriment. Theatrics! Catharsis! Comedy! Tragedy... catch a show--or be a part of one! We'll make you a fancy cocktail after the performance......if you can find our bar, that is.

name: Kwalq Camp
description: The Kwalq Camp mission is to help young polywogs achieve the best version of themselves by learning how to breath. Ready for the next level? Please stop by and we'll help you achieve your best froggie self.

name: Earth Guardians
description: Earth Guardians are an outreach and communications volunteer group whose mission is to educate and inspire Burning Man participants to Leave No Trace (LNT) at the event. Come see our many bike nature and geology tours, sustainability speakers, DIY workshops, Aztec Burner dances, or volunteer training and gatherings! name: Pink Mammoth
description: We create an inclusive environment of love, compassion, connection, and self expression through dance, both on and off the playa.
landmark: Giant pink shade, flags, and PINK MAMMOTH sign

name: Breakaway Republic
description: Tiny Arms Tavern welcomes all dinosaurs for libations and roar-ing laughter. Open every day, look for the giant T-Rex. Espresso martinis and wine from 9-12 every day!

name: Dusty Bunnies
description: Camp Dusty Bunnies - get a new outfit at the Boutique, taste strange foods at Bunny's Deli, dance and mingle with your new best friends in our Lounge. Plus, watch for Bunny's Pop-up Bistro to randomly appear on the Playa.

name: This Is It
description: This is a camp serving hot & iced tea with offerings of a phone charging station and ASL conversation.
landmark: A big plain white sign saying "This Is It"

name: Camp of the Rising Buns
description: Camp of the Rising Buns is a community that celebrates the many gifts of the sun. Come to our Abuntent to experience the renewal of a new day while basking in the evaporative cooling powered by the gift of the sun's rays. Stop by at sunset daily for Bunset Karaoke + Rising Buns Bakery & Cool Your Buns Snowcones. "Sun's out, Buns out!".
landmark: Large Lotus Bell tent and floating bun

name: The Market
description: Imagine you are wandering through Playa on your way home from a night of adventure or just starting out in search of adventure. Your stomach growls a bit, maybe you feel just a tiny bit thirsty. From afar you see a gathering of carts, lit up and welcoming. What's going on over there? You pedal towards it and stumble upon The Market. You are suddenly surrounded with stands offering their goods. You eat, you drink, and maybe you even get your future told. Get a new jacket! Get hustled in a strangely rigged dice game. You can't help but think - is this the start of your night, or the center of it all?
landmark: 6 bike-towed carts parked, 'The Market' signage

name: Sidequest Sideshow
description: Clownin' around!
landmark: Big Circus Tent Made Out of Tulle!

name: PLUR Pups
description: Human Pup Play (no bio-pups involved!) is a role playing activity that brings play, immediacy, and unconditional affection back to adult life. It came from queer kink culture, but any adult can join! Get on all fours, bark at your friends, play fetch, wag your tail, or just take a nap in a blissful dogpile. The PLUR Pups doghouse is your headquarters for pup culture on the playa. Drop by to learn about pup headspace, (no experience required!), interact in dog mode with other pups at a mosh, or join a skill share.
landmark: Large red dog house, row of fire hydrants.

name: Deoxidized
description: We are a global community of artists, builders, entrepreneurs, and explorers who come together to create a welcoming neighborhood on the playa. Our theme, the Global Neighborhood Oasis, reflects our belief that connection and participation are at the heart of Black Rock City. By day, we host our Soul Series in our shaded Oasis with guided talks, workshops, and reflective experiences. By night, our bar opens, and music, dancing, and celebration bring the neighborhood together under our glowing parachute. Stop in for conversation, shade, or a moment of inspiration and connection!
landmark: 30 ft green tent, with Deoxidized sign in front

name: Hungry Games
description: Step right up and spin our interactive game wheel for a chance to win a hot slice of fresh pizza. You might face off in a quick round of rock paper scissors or score an automatic win to satisfy your hunger. Our entire crew works together to hype up the crowd and keep the ovens firing for these spontaneous street parties. When the games take a break we invite you to sit down and relax at our scheduled foot spa. We will gently wash the playa dust from your toes so you can recharge and get back out to the burn.
landmark: Look for the Irish flag and the Sunflower painting

name: Our Own Devices
description: Home base for Our Own Devices, a massive metal pop-up book unfolding from the playa. Swing by to talk about tall tales, engineering puzzles, and the fine art of using serious skills for deeply unserious things.
landmark: Camp sign reading: Our Own Devices.

name: Church of Chill
description: Come be Chill and enjoy a drink at our misted and shaded chapel. Leave a confession for others to read. Divinity and anhidrosis for all!
landmark: Blue shade structure with Church of Chill sign

name: House of Sammich
description: We serve gourmet, gluten-free, cinnamon-buttered toasted, peanut-butter and jelly sammiches. All that we ask is for you to provide us with a taste of YOUR flavor. Sing us a song..., tell us a joke..., confess a sin.., the dirtier the better. We also provide a moving cuddle puddle which is all about conscious conversations: opening up, connecting, and sharing what's going on inside oneself.
landmark: Trailer that states "The Great Sammich Ride"

name: Your New Friend
description: Supporting the "Your New Friend" deep playa art piece, we also welcome you to drop in and say hello to the idiots gathered here at camp. We would love to hear your Burning Man story, and promise to only make a tiny amount of fun of you.

If you can make it through our 90's cityscape and out the other side to our street meat and Notorious B.A.R. still friends, then you know your relationship back in the Default will be SOLID!

We believe that art car magic can be created with dedication, commitment and basic tools and supplies. We live this dream and aspire to show burners that they can too.

name: Empire of Dirt
description: At Empire of Dirt, we don't just build mutant vehicles...we launch dreams into orbit. Our camp is a hub of performance, creativity, collaboration, and full-on playa absurdity. We're proud to be a returning Burning Man camp based in Oakland, California, with a long tradition of mobile art, DIY ethics, and radical participation.Interactivity is Our Mission.

name: High Maintenance Entertainment

We gave life to Noetica in 2017 and Spark: A Burning Man Story in 2014. Now we keep the Bioluminescent Slug glowing, the drinks flowing, and our doors open to anyone who wants a ride under the stars. High Maintenance? Only in the best way.

Visit the "Imagination Station Piazza" featuring different activities and gatherings daily!

name: Playacuda
description: Home base for Playacuda, a mutant vehicle roaming the playa in search of connection and good energy. We offer a laid-back spot to pause, cool down, and meet fellow travelers. name: Metamorphosis Energy Lab

We believe in the metamorphic power of radical technology, clean energy, and community. Find us by the hum of electric motors and the glow of solar panels.

And we were among the very first burners to bring LERD lights to the playa!

As part of the same community that brought you the Huge Mona Bunny in 2023, the enchanting Mona Mushroom in 2024, and the MONA DIE! DIE! DIE! burn in 2025. We are dedicated to spreading the Mona spirit far and wide.We believe in the power of art to inspire, connect, and uplift souls. Our theme revolves around celebrating art, neuroscience, and diverse world cultures.

name: Helios Hideout

landmark: Beige Shade Structure with the Gritty Garden sign

name: Tree of Love
description: Step into a legendary oasis where ancient strength meets modern rhythm. Our camp welcomes all weary travelers to find shade under our monumental tree and dance in the shadow of heroic man and woman warrior statues. Whether you're looking to catch a high-energy sunset DJ set, admire the prototypes of our open-playa art, or simply cool down with a refreshing drink, we offer a cornerstone of community and creativity. Join us at the corner of the block to recharge your spirit and move your dusty feet. We can't wait to dance with you!
landmark: Big statues

name: Bubblegasm
description: Bubblegasm is a mutant vehicle built to spread the joy of bubbles and lights with all those who ride on her or dance and play around her. Bubbles are a metaphor for life, fleeting and fragile and are a reminder about how precious our time is while we are here, and to make the most of each moment. And like each bubble, each person and their life is beautiful and unique. Bubbles are also temporary and once they pop they become part of the universe, just as we do when we die. When people encounter bubbles it is a like a rare moment of magic. They symbolize our childhood innocence, reminding us of a time when life was simple and carefree. When we see these glass-like orbs dancing in the air they remind us to live in the moment, let go, dance with a stranger, be silly - have a bubblegasm!
landmark: 2 white shade structures with BUBBLEGASM banners

name: Strangelove
description: Fly the Friendly! Come get your altitude and your attitude adjusted in our airliner-themed lounge, where each afternoon you can enjoy the company of your fellow jet-setters while you sip ice-cold draft beer or a signature cocktail and groove to tasty house beats at our 16-foot wing-shaped bar.
landmark: White and blue curved walls with airplane windows

name: Mindseye Bonsai
description: We are a small art support camp of builders, artists, scientists, and dusty travelers from all over the world. Our mission is to bring sculpture to the playa and have a good time doing it. With 10 years of experience bringing art to Burning Man, we love sharing neuroscience-inspired art and curiosity with fellow dusty desert folks. If that sounds like your kind of camp, reach out and come join us.“Become the vision of the mind's eye And carry your flame to the fire Do not wait for the fire to carry the flame to you”.
landmark: 2 meter animated LED eyeball display

name: Tengri Camp
description: A glowing yurt encampment where the wind carries stories, music, and the memory of the steppe. Within warm circular shelters, strangers become guests, guests become family, sharing tea, song, and slow moments of presence under the desert sky. On Wednesday and Friday from 3 to 5 pm, we gift communal meals as gatherings of hospitality and shared tradition. By day and night, we offer a space to rest, create, and reconnect through cultural exchange and shared humanity beneath the vastness of Black Rock City.

name: Renewables For Artists RAT HQ
description: Provides information and resources to artists and camps to support on-playa solar renewable power installations. Ditch the generator, rely on the sun! It is easy, and we are here to help. Visit us on playa to learn more about playa solar solutions, from tiny projects to the Temple. Enjoy a refreshing freezy pop or cup of tea while you rest in our shady lounge. Read up on best practices and solar safety. Charge your batteries. Need some solar panels for use on playa? Come and get them from the Solar Donation Station. Contact a RAT if you need solar support for your art installation. 100% solar = playa resilience! Dust yer panels people!

name: Camp Condundrum

name: Water Suckers

Add a small story, poem, gesture, prompt, or playful offering to the exchange.

name: Central Cafe

By day it is a vibrant social cafe, by night it transforms into an intimate coffee lounge with music and atmosphere.Whether you are looking for your friends or finding new ones, Central Cafe is a place you will keep coming back to.

name: Enrichment.Institute

They are single rider, mutant vehicles, mobile art pieces, a 3 foot square cube, with sound and lights.Remember, the cake is a lie!The Portal Enrichment.institute hosts the Weighted Companion Cube Mutant Vehicles. name: Dinosaur King
description: Welcome to Dinosaur King, where prehistoric power meets the playa. Our camp is anchored by the Dinosaur King art car -- a full-body dinosaur skeleton mutant vehicle approximately 30 feet long and 12 feet tall, fabricated from steel and covered in thousands of programmable LEDs. A live DJ booth is built directly inside the skeleton's body cavity, where performers spin sets from within the belly of the beast. By day, the skeleton commands attention as a towering playa landmark. By night, it transforms into a blazing, glowing creature that pulses with music and light. The art car roams Black Rock City and returns to camp as an open dance floor for all Burners. No tickets, no guest list -- just good music, open space, and the freedom to move.

On the ground, a sprawling shaded plaza hosts daily DJ sets, aerial silks performances, and a community pole that is always open and always going. Bring your whole self, leave your wallet at home.

name: As Above So At Camp
description: We are the support camp for the Honoraria artwork As Above, So Within, a sculptural installation inspired by Persian mythology, mathematics, and fractal geometry. Our crew brings together artists, builders, designers, and fabricators supporting the piece from build through strike. The work explores the ancient idea that the patterns above us are reflected within us, using form, light, and computation. Come say hello, meet the team, and learn more about the artwork on playa.
landmark: Camp flag with name

name: The Pink Hole

name: ARMÉ - Army of Love
description: A camp built around the idea of love as a force that moves people, not a concept. We create a space where connection feels natural, presence matters, and everyone contributes to the atmosphere around them.Our shaded cooling and tea space offers a place to slow down, reset, and share a moment with others in the middle of the chaos.Alongside the camp, we support a large-scale art installation that adds another layer to the experience, inviting people to step into something bigger than themselves.This is a space for real interaction, openness, and the kind of energy you can feel when people actually show up for each other.

name: Seashell Cartel
description: A tiny nautical syndicate in support of the PlayaBoot, a mutant vehicle shaped like a boot with a pineapple on top.  Come for the Boot, stay for the questionable maritime affiliations.

name: Ragnarokk
description: Ragnarokk is the End and the Beginning. It tells a story where destruction is necessary for creation to flourish. It is rebirth, it is recovery, it is rejuvenation, it is a renaissance, it is renewal, restoration, and resurrection. It is what we are experiencing in our lives right now. It is Burning Man. And now, it is us. We are camp Ragnarokk!
landmark: The giant Thor art car and his flowing red cape

name: Airpusher Collective
description: The Airpusher camp is the port from which our fantastical airship begins and ends her voyages.  Join us for music and joy.  Check our event schedule and meet us at camp prior to our published airship rides to playa and beyond.

name: Kaya
description: Home of the Fire Breathing Dragon Art Car, Gon KiRin. Stop by our camp to enjoy music, meet our camp members from around the globe and experience an authentic tea ceremony by tea masters from China. We are a diverse group of burners brought together by our love for art, music and cultural exchange. Feel free to ask questions about our mutant vehicle and maybe catch a ride with us out to playa!

name: White Elephant Exchange
description: The White Elephant Exchange is a waypoint for roving pachyderms from all eras, generations, and originations to gather. We are brought together by our love of our substantial Funkadelephant and joy of celebrations and adventures. Come by to find the Funkadelephant and its growing family, or come find us roaming the wide open Playa.

name: Terrapin Station
description: The Galactic Terrapin lives to take you on intergalactic adventures of epic proportions. You're always "home" when you're with us, so swing by, take a trip and find your own Axis Mundi.

description: Hooter Tooterville is a small art support camp dedicated to bringing fun and original art to the Playa.  This year's art installation is called "Teeny Weeny Hooter Tooter", a fun set of 4 teeters powering two walls of musical pipes and fun things to look at.

name: Wild Tribe
description: Wild Tribe is a camp of professional circus artists and fire dancers.
landmark: Wild Tribe Camp sign

name: AmberDust
description: A retro-futuristic lounge camp built around the AmberDust Express art installation, blending interactive lights, music, shade, and spontaneous social chaos. Wander in for glowing nighttime vibes, unexpected conversations, late-night dancing, and our legendary returning sausage parties. By day, relax in our shaded gathering space; by night, watch the camp transform into an illuminated social playground. Come curious, leave slightly confused and hopefully well-fed.
landmark: AmberDust Express ArtCar

name: Holy Babel
description: The Art of Such n Such is returning to BRC. This time, we are an art support camp, led by Charlie Blackcat Smith who will be working on a collaborative. fire based art piece that will serve as a memorial for Brian Doherty who met a fast fate in March. Brian literally wrote the book on Burning Man titled "This is Burning Man" in 2004. This will be a small camp centered on erecting and managing the memorial art piece and keeping it safe and running during the event. In previous years, this camp has also been known as A.S.S. Camp. Come and find a bunch of crusty Burners here.
landmark: Large White Big Top Tent in the middle of camp.

name: The Mystical Grill
description: A global circle of kindred spirits united by fire, flavor, and story. We gift two styles of traditional Argentinian Asado from our open grill and invite Burners to gather for communal meals, spontaneous storytelling, readings from our camp tarot reader, and soul warming connection. We honor food as a ritual, fire as transformation, and the Playa as our shared home.
landmark: Large Wooden sign w/eye in the center of a pyramid

name: Harmonic Drift
description: Everything is an instrument. Everyone is a musician.Harmonic Drift is a mobile sound installation and open jam experience built on one belief: music belongs to everyone. Our hand-pulled trailer carries 35 gongs, found object percussion, and things that don't have names yet. Wherever it lands, it becomes a stage for whoever shows up.When we're not on the playa or at Center Camp, we're parked out front and open to all. No experience necessary. No wrong notes. At night, the installation glows as a beacon for the curious.Come make noise with us.
landmark: black and white wooden mouse holding our camp sign

name: Camp ASL Support Services HUB
description: American sign language Support services. Centralized services for the Deaf. Spanish speaking services provided as well. Come and flip a table. Come hang out by the fire pit after dark whenever it happens.
landmark: "Valium" tagged on travel trailer

name: D.F.C.B.(Don't Fckn' Care Bear)
description: Welcome to "(Don't)_Care_A_Lot" the official home for the Don't Fckn' Care Bear art car. Please be quiet around here because the little bears are sleeping...
landmark: DFCB Flag at the RV or DFCB camp signage @ front

name: Davey Jones Locker Pirate Cove
description: The Davey Jones Locker is docked in pirates cove this year!  Come climb aboard the top of the ship via the fishy climbing net off the side!  Sing some sea shanties with us, relax in the shade on the roof deck or enjoy some weird wacky and wonderful music, which half comes from boxes of records!  Come come pick some music and play!
landmark: Large pirate ship with mast

name: Resonance
description: An art support camp for the Resonance Tree  which is a large-scale immersive art installation made entirely of bamboo, designed and built by Resonance Studio. It responds to sun, shadow, sound, and movement. Rising seven meters above the playa, the Tree invites people to enter through woven roots, climb through the trunk, rest in canopy nets, and gather beneath a living canopy of shadow and sound.By day, its canopy filters the desert sun. By night, the trunk glows from within, and hundreds of solar bamboo lights hung from the branches shift with the wind, casting shadows across the cracked playa.
landmark: Bamboo tower

name: Icarus Camp
description: Icarus CampA collection of humans from across the globe, who were brought together show all, LOVE.

description: The Tequila Bees are a Hive Like No Other, come see what the Buzz is about.

name: Booboos Gaagoos
description: Step right up to the Inaugural Officially Certified Peer-Reviewed Burning Man Awards, the most rigorous celebration of playa excellence in the known universe. Our panel of wildly unqualified judges reviews your finest achievements, from heroic dust storm survival to best abandoned bike rescue, and awards genuine medals of entirely dubious authority. Pull up a seat, plead your case, and claim the recognition you legally deserve.
landmark: Zebra flags

name: Midas Tear Collective
description: Step into a welcoming French gathering space where conversations flow alongside French wine and cheese. Join us in building a collaborative geometric sculpture using Zometool, an evolving creation shaped collectively throughout the week. At sunrise, gather beneath The Tear of Midas for meditation, reflection, and community sharing circles. Relax, create, exchange ideas, and imagine new ways of living in harmony with the natural world through art, dialogue, and collective creativity.A collection of flags will be hoisted — French, Brazilian, Norwegian, Argentine, Breton, United States, and a pirate flag — visible from the street, as a gesture of fraternity and peace, symbolizing that we stand together in unity.

name: Hushville
description: A welcoming camp with no amplified music or generators. First time burners greeted with joy and mentored with care. We welcome campers from across the world and beyond. We've had people from every continent camp with us in the past. Many activities all week long.
landmark: Hushville City Limits Sign

name: Airport
description: Burning Man's airport rises from the dust each summer to serve Black Rock City Citizens for 13 days, then disappears without a trace. On busy days, 88NV is among the country's 100 busiest airports, hosting charter and GA traffic, free scenic flights, ultralights, and skydivers.

name: Ranger Outpost Berlin
description: The Black Rock Rangers are the core infrastructure for the community during the event. Their strength comes from the diversity of backgrounds and experiences; they are communicators, medics, firefighters and concerned citizens. Rangers are the mediators of public safety and providers of information. The Black Rock Rangers were founded by Danger Ranger in 1992, and are modeled after the Texas Rangers. The key to the organization's success is that the Rangers are not the “other” guys: they are the participants, and work throughout the city and its perimeters to ensure the collective survival of the community. They respond to the ever-changing environment, and address situations within our community that would otherwise require outside intervention. By encouraging and facilitating communication, the Rangers promote awareness of potential hazards, from sunstroke to tent fires to bad weather.
